articles.headline: Mainland Investors Pivot to Hong Kong AI Stocks, Pulling Back From Financials
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that mainland Chinese investors have been reallocating capitalmoving money from one investment to another重新分配資金 away from traditional financial stocks and towards artificial intelligence firms listed in Hong Kong. Southbound funds channelled a record HK$10.6 billion into MiniMax, an AI start-up, during August alone, an inflow that eclipsedsurpassed; overshadowed超越；蓋過 even the sums directed towards established giants such as Alibaba and Tencent. Since becoming eligible for trading through Stock Connect on 6 August, MiniMax has seen mainland investors accumulate a 9.7 per cent stake, with shares surging as much as 22.8 per cent on their first day of southbound trading.

Critics contend that such a concentrated bet on a single, relatively young sector is not without risk. Nevertheless, proponents argue that the enthusiasm reflects a broader paradigm shifta fundamental change in approach範式轉移 in how mainland capital views Hong Kong's stock market: no longer merely a venue for banks and property developers, but increasingly a gatewaya means of access or entry門戶；途徑 to cutting-edge technology. MiniMax and its peer Zhipu AI, both listed in January 2026, rallied by more than 300 per cent by June and were subsequently admitted to the Hang Seng Tech Index, a milestone that cementedmade firm or secure鞏固 their status among the city's most closely watched equities.

By the same token, analysts caution that this AI-driven rally could prove volatileliable to change rapidly and unpredictably反覆無常的；動蕩的 once initial lock-up periods expire and early investors seek to realise profits. It is nonetheless undeniable that Hong Kong's role as a hub for AI listings has been significantly strengthened, offering a timely case study for students examining how technological innovation and capital markets are inextricably linkedconnected in a way that cannot be separated密不可分地聯繫 in the modern economy.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據報導,內地投資者正逐步將資金重新分配,由傳統金融股轉投在香港上市的人工智能企業。南向資金單在八月份已向人工智能初創企業MiniMax注入破紀錄的106億港元,流入金額甚至超越了流向阿里巴巴及騰訊等老牌巨企的資金。自八月六日起獲納入港股通交易以來,內地投資者已累積持有MiniMax百分之九點七的股權,股份更在南向交易首日一度飆升達百分之二十二點八。

有意見認為,如此集中押注於一個相對新興的行業,並非沒有風險。然而,支持者則認為,這股熱潮反映內地資金看待香港股市的方式出現更廣泛的範式轉移——香港股市不再僅僅是銀行與地產發展商的集資場地,而是逐漸成為通往尖端科技的門戶。MiniMax及其同業智譜AI同於2026年一月上市,股價截至六月累計上升逾百分之三百,其後更獲納入恒生科技指數,此一里程碑鞏固了兩者作為全城焦點股份的地位。

與此同時,分析師警告,一旦首批禁售期屆滿,早期投資者爭相套現,這股由人工智能帶動的升浪或會變得反覆無常。然而不可否認的是,香港作為人工智能企業上市樞紐的角色已顯著增強,為學生提供了一個切合時宜的案例,探討科技創新與資本市場在現代經濟中如何密不可分。

cover_text.en: Mainland funds pivot into Hong Kong AI stocks

articles.headline: CityU Orientation Camp Scandal Deepens as Bruised Students' Photos Surface
articles.summary_html:
It is widely argued that university orientation camps, while intended to foster camaraderiebuild friendship and mutual trust培養情誼 among new students, have in recent years become associated with troubling practices. This controversy resurfaced this week at the City University of Hong Kong, where fresh photographs surfacedcame to public attention浮現；曝光 showing male and female students with visible bruising on their thighs and red marks across their backs. The images circulated widely on social media only days after an earlier video, depicting a shirtless male student carrying a woman dressed in red underwear, had already gone viral and drawn public criticism.

Critics contend that such initiation rituals amount to a form of hazinghumiliating or dangerous initiation activities迎新迫害；欺凌式迎新 that normalises physical harm under the guise of tradition. In response, the university has established a disciplinary investigation committee, which is currently interviewing both the camp's organisers and its participants in order to establish accountability. The student union committee responsible for staging the event, known by the name “Messianis”, has since announced its own dissolution, a move widely seen as an attempt to contain the falloutlimit the negative consequences of an incident控制事件的後果 from the scandal.

Nevertheless, commentators point out that dissolving a single committee does little to address the underlying culture that permits such practices to persist year after year. By the same token, it is argued that universities must move beyond reactive damage control and instead implement robust, preventive safeguards — including clear codes of conduct and independent monitoring — if genuine reform is to be achieved. The episode has reignited a broader debate about student welfare, peer pressure, and the balance between tradition and safety on Hong Kong's university campuses.

articles.summary_zh_html:
大學迎新營雖然原意是培養新生之間的情誼,但近年卻屢屢被指與令人憂慮的做法扯上關係。這場爭議本週在香港城市大學再度浮現,新曝光的照片顯示多名男女學生大腿上有明顯瘀傷,背部亦有紅印。這些照片在社交媒體上廣泛流傳,距離早前一段片段曝光、引發公眾批評僅僅數日——片中一名赤裸上身的男學生揹著一名穿著紅色內衣的女子。

有評論指出,這類迎新儀式實質上屬於一種迎新迫害,以傳統之名將身體傷害正常化。校方已回應,成立紀律調查委員會,現正約見活動籌辦人員及參加者,以釐清責任誰屬。負責籌辦是次活動、名為「彌賽尼斯」的學生會屬會其後宣布自行解散,此舉普遍被視為試圖控制事件所造成的後果。

不過,評論者指出,單單解散一個委員會,無助解決容讓此類做法年復一年持續存在的深層文化。同樣道理,有意見認為,大學必須超越被動的危機處理,轉而推行具體而有力的預防措施——包括訂立清晰的行為守則及引入獨立監察機制,方能實現真正的改革。事件亦重新引發社會對學生福祉、同儕壓力,以及香港各大學校園內傳統與安全之間如何取得平衡的廣泛討論。

cover_text.en: CityU hazing scandal exposes bruised students

articles.headline: Pet Dogs Could Be Reclassified as Fighting Breeds During Routine Checks
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that pet owners across Hong Kong may find their dogs reclassifiedplaced into a different official category重新分類 as fighting breeds during otherwise routine licensing and vaccination appointments. According to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department, this measure follows a marked upticka small increase輕微上升 in public reports concerning suspected fighting dogs, prompting officers to be deployed more frequently for on-site inspections. Principal veterinary officer Michelle Yeung explained that identification currently relies on visual assessment, whereby veterinarians evaluate a dog's head shape, stature and overall body structure to determine its breed category.

Critics contend that such subjective, appearance-based assessments risk producing inconsistent outcomesresults that vary or contradict each other不一致的結果, particularly for mixed-breed dogs whose ancestry cannot be determined at a glance. Nevertheless, officials point out that the system offers a practical opportunity for oversight: since dog licences must be renewed every three years alongside a rabies booster vaccination, staff can observe each animal at that time and revise its classification if necessary. Owners of dogs confirmed as fighting breeds are not required to surrender their pets, provided they comply with all relevant restrictions and safety requirements.

By the same token, this policy tightening comes in the wake of a fatal attack last month in Ta Kwu Ling, in which a woman running a licensed dog shelter was mauled to death by an animal in her care, an incident that prompted the government to pledge a review of the legal definition of “fighting dogs” and to submit legislative amendments within the year. The episode illustrates how a single tragedy can galvaniseshock into action激勵；促使採取行動 swift regulatory change, while also raising important questions about public safety, animal welfare and the limits of visual identification methods.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據報導,香港的寵物主人在辦理日常牌照續領及疫苗注射手續時,其愛犬有可能被重新分類為鬥犬品種。漁農自然護理署表示,此措施是因應懷疑鬥犬的公眾舉報個案顯著上升而推出,促使部門加派人手進行更頻密的現場檢查。首席獸醫楊穎詩解釋,現時的品種鑑定主要依賴目測評估,獸醫會評估狗隻的頭形、體型及整體骨架結構,藉此判斷其品種類別。

有意見認為,這種主觀而依賴外觀的評估方式,有機會導致結果不一致,尤其對於血統難以一眼判斷的混種犬更是如此。然而,官員指出,此機制提供了一個切實可行的監察機會:由於狗牌須每三年續領一次,並同時注射狂犬病加強疫苗,職員可在此時觀察每隻狗隻,並在有需要時修訂其分類。被確認為鬥犬品種的狗主毋須交出愛犬,惟須遵守所有相關限制及安全規定。

與此同時,今次政策收緊,正值上月打鼓嶺發生一宗致命襲擊事件之後——一名經營持牌狗舍的女子被其照顧的狗隻咬死,事件促使政府承諾檢討「鬥犬」的法律定義,並於年內提交立法修訂。事件反映一宗悲劇如何能夠激勵迅速的監管改革,同時亦引發有關公眾安全、動物福利,以及目測鑑定方法局限性的重要疑問。

cover_text.en: Hong Kong tightens checks on fighting-breed dogs

articles.headline: Health Authorities Find No Sign of WT1 Jab in Unregistered Vaccine Raids
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that Hong Kong's health authorities have concluded a major operation targeting the sale of unregistered medical injections, following mounting public concern over clinics allegedly offering an unproven cancer-prevention jab known as WT1. Assistant Director of Health Frank Chan confirmed that, despite raids on fourteen premises resulting in three arrests and the seizure of more than 890 vaccine vials, investigators found no evidence that any WT1 vaccine had actually been administered, nor did they identify a single patient who had received one.

Nevertheless, the operation was far from fruitless: among the seized items were roughly twenty types of unregistered injectionsmedical products not officially approved for use未經註冊的注射劑, the majority of which turned out to be vitamin and amino acid preparations rather than genuine vaccines. Critics contend that the very existence of such an underground market reflects a troubling willingness among some consumers to seek out unverified treatments, often lured byattracted or tempted by被……吸引 exaggerated health claims circulating on social media.

By the same token, Mr Chan issued a stark warning that individuals who obtain unregistered WT1 injections could be placing their lives at risk, citing the danger of bacterial contaminationinfection caused by harmful bacteria細菌污染 during improper manufacturing or administration. It is nonetheless undeniable that this episode serves as a cautionary talea story that warns against a course of action警世故事 for the wider public: consumers are strongly urged to verify that any medical product has been properly registered before consenting to receive it, rather than relying on unsubstantiated promises of miraculous health benefits.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據報導,香港衞生當局已完成一次針對銷售未經註冊醫療注射劑的大型行動,此前公眾日益憂慮有診所涉嫌提供一種未經證實、名為WT1的防癌注射。衞生署助理署長陳森美確認,儘管行動突擊搜查十四個處所,拘捕三人,並檢獲超過890支疫苗瓶,調查人員並未發現任何WT1疫苗曾被實際注射的證據,亦未能找出任何一名曾接受注射的病人。

然而,今次行動並非毫無收穫:檢獲物品當中,約有二十款未經註冊的注射劑,當中大部分實為維他命及氨基酸製劑,而非真正的疫苗。有評論指出,這種地下市場的存在,反映部分消費者願意尋求未經證實療法的令人憂慮的現象,他們往往是被社交媒體上流傳的誇大健康聲稱所吸引。

與此同時,陳森美發出嚴正警告,指出取得未經註冊WT1注射劑的人士可能使自己的生命陷入危險,並指出不當製造或注射過程可能帶來細菌污染的風險。然而不可否認的是,今次事件為廣大市民提供了一個警世故事:消費者在同意接受任何醫療產品注射前,應務必核實該產品已妥為註冊,而非輕信未經證實、號稱有神奇療效的承諾。

cover_text.en: Health raids find no one received WT1 jab

articles.headline: Post Malone Postpones Hong Kong Stadium Concert, Leaving Fans in Limbo
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that American rapper Post Malone has postponed indefinitelydelayed to an unspecified later time無限期推遲 the Hong Kong leg of his “Big Ass Stadium World Tour”, originally scheduled for 16 September at Kai Tak Stadium. The announcement, issued by concert promoter Live Nation Hong Kong, offered no official explanation, leaving thousands of ticket holders bewilderedconfused; unable to understand困惑不解 and frustrated just days before the anticipated show.

Critics contend that the abrupt cancellation has caused considerable inconveniencetrouble or difficulty caused to someone不便, particularly for fans travelling from mainland China who had already taken annual leaveused allocated holiday time from work請年假 and booked hotel accommodation in anticipation of the concert. A number of disappointed concert-goers took to social media to vent their frustrationexpress strong negative feelings openly發洩不滿, arguing that such late notice reflects little regard for overseas audiences. Nevertheless, organisers have sought to placateto make someone less angry or upset安撫 aggrieved fans by confirming that refunds will be processed automatically, with full reimbursement credited to the original payment account within 20 to 30 working days, sparing customers the need to submit a formal application.

By the same token, this episode is by no means an isolated incident. It has since come to lightbecome known publicly after being hidden曝光；為人所知 that every remaining stop on the singer's Asia and Australasia itinerary — spanning Taiwan, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, South Korea and Japan — has likewise been shelved, suggesting that the disruption stems from a broader logistical difficulty rather than any Hong Kong-specific factor. Such episodes inevitably raise questions about the resiliencethe capacity to recover quickly from difficulties應變能力；韌性 of Hong Kong's fledgling mega-event industry. Since the opening of Kai Tak Stadium last year, the venue has been positioned aspresented or regarded as occupying a role被定位為 a cornerstone of the city's ambition to become a premier destination for international concerts. It is against this backdrop that repeated postponements have prompted commentators to call forto publicly demand or request呼籲 greater contingency planning, lest public confidence in Hong Kong's capacity to host world-class live events be further eroded.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據報導,美國說唱歌手Post Malone已無限期推遲其「Big Ass Stadium World Tour」演唱會的香港站演出,原定於九月十六日假啟德體育園舉行。由演唱會主辦方Live Nation Hong Kong發出的公告,並未提供任何官方解釋,令數以千計的持票人在演出前僅餘數日之際感到困惑不解及沮喪。

有評論指出,是次突如其來的取消為樂迷帶來相當大的不便,尤其是不少從內地專程來港的歌迷,早已請年假並訂好酒店房間以準備觀看演出。部分失望的觀眾在社交媒體上發洩不滿,認為如此遲來的通知反映主辦方對海外觀眾缺乏重視。然而,主辦方試圖安撫忿忿不平的樂迷,確認退款將自動處理,全額退款將於20至30個工作天內存入原付款帳戶,毋須顧客另行提出正式申請。

與此同時,今次事件絕非個別事件。其後證實,歌手亞洲及大洋洲巡演餘下所有站次——包括台灣、泰國、新加坡、馬來西亞、南韓及日本——同樣已被擱置,顯示今次混亂源於更廣泛的後勤問題,而非香港獨有的因素。此類事件無可避免地令人質疑香港新興大型活動產業的應變能力。自啟德體育園去年啟用以來,該場館一直被定位為香港致力成為國際演唱會首選地點這一目標的基石。正是在這背景下,接二連三的延期促使評論者呼籲加強應變規劃,以免公眾對香港舉辦世界級現場活動的能力的信心被進一步削弱。

cover_text.en: Post Malone postpones Hong Kong stadium show

articles.headline: Rare Large-Scale MTR Topside Tender Draws Heavyweight Hong Kong Developers
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that MTR Corporation's tender for the Tuen Mun A16 Station Package Two property development has drawn keen interestattracted strong attention or enthusiasm引起濃厚興趣 from Hong Kong's leading developers, with the exercise closing on 2 September. Four bids were submitted in total: one each from CK Asset, Sun Hung Kai Properties and Henderson Land, alongside a joint bid from a consortium comprising Sino Land, Kerry Properties, China Overseas Land & Investment and Great Eagle.

Critics contend that the scale of the project explains this robuststrong and healthy; vigorous強勁的 response. The site is designated for a composite development combining residential towers, a podium shopping mall and community facilities, with a maximum residential gross floor area of nearly 250,000 square metres integrated directly above a public transport interchange. Proponents argue that such rail-plus-propertya development model combining railway lines with property projects鐵路加物業 projects remain attractive to developers despite a subdued property market, since guaranteed footfall from commuters helps to underpinto support or form the basis of something支持；作為基礎 retail and residential value alike.

Nevertheless, some analysts caution that the enthusiasm should not be taken at face valueaccepted as true without further examination照字面接受；不加深究, noting that recent tenders for smaller or less well-located sites have occasionally attracted no conforming bids at all. By the same token, this successful tender is likely to be seen as an encouraging sign for the wider property sector, which has struggled with subdued transaction volumes in recent years. It is against this backdrop that the government has continued to championto support or advocate for something publicly積極支持；提倡 large-scale rail-linked housing supply as a means of easing Hong Kong's long-standing housing shortage. Should the tender proceed smoothly, the project is expected to add thousands of new flats to the New Territories over the coming decade, a development that students of urban planning and housing policy would do well to keep abreast ofto stay informed about the latest developments緊貼；緊跟最新發展.

據報導,港鐵公司就屯門A16車站第二期物業發展項目進行的招標,引起本港主要發展商的濃厚興趣,招標已於九月二日截止。是次招標合共接獲四份標書:長江實業、新鴻基地產及恒基兆業地產各自提交一份標書,另有由信和置業、嘉里建設、中國海外發展及鷹君組成的財團聯合提交標書。

有意見認為,項目規模之大解釋了這股強勁的反應。該地盤劃作綜合發展項目,結合住宅大廈、平台商場及社區設施,最高住宅總樓面面積接近二十五萬平方米,並與公共運輸交匯處直接相連。支持者則認為,儘管物業市場疲弱,此類鐵路加物業項目仍對發展商具吸引力,因為有保證的通勤人流有助支持商場及住宅的價值。

然而,部分分析師提醒,這股熱潮不應照字面接受,並指出近期一些規模較小或地點欠佳的地盤招標,有時甚至接獲不到任何符合規格的標書。同樣道理,是次成功的招標,料將被視為整體物業市場的一個令人鼓舞的信號,該市場近年一直受制於疲弱的成交量。正是在這背景下,政府持續提倡大規模鐵路沿線房屋供應,作為紓緩香港長期房屋短缺的方法。若招標順利進行,預計項目將於未來十年為新界增加數千個新單位,這是研究城市規劃與房屋政策的學生應緊貼最新發展的課題。

articles.headline: HKTB to Host First-Ever International Lantern Spectacular This Mid-Autumn
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that the Hong Kong Tourism Board will stage the city's first-ever International Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park, running from 17 to 27 September under the theme of “Reunion”. The event is set to showcaseto display something publicly to its best advantage展示；展現 more than 3,000 lanterns from 20 countries and regions, including silk lantern pieces from Jinju in South Korea, vivid patchwork designs from Brazil, and Polish folk paper-cut crafts.

Critics contend that such an ambitious, internationally themed display marks a departure from the more traditionalfollowing long-established customs or beliefs傳統的 lantern carnivals of previous years. Nevertheless, proponents argue that the expansion reflects Hong Kong's broader effort to reinvigorateto give new energy or strength to something為……注入新活力 its cultural tourism offerings. The centrepiece of the display, an eight-metre-tall installation named “Shadowlight”, draws inspirationa stimulus that generates creative ideas靈感 from Hong Kong's iconic banyan trees, while the adjoining Hong Kong Lantern Galleria will feature over 400 locally handcrafted lanterns shaped like rabbits, star fruit and goldfish, evoking a distinctly nostalgicsentimental longing for a past time or place懷舊的 atmosphere for older visitors.

By the same token, this year's celebrations coincide with the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance, held from 24 to 26 September, in which a 67-metre dragon illuminatedlit up; brightened with light被照亮 by some 12,000 incense sticks winds its way through the neighbourhood's narrow streets. Now in its 147th edition, the dance is inscribed onofficially recorded or listed as part of被列入 China's National List of Intangible Cultural Heritage, underscoring its enduring cultural significance. It is against this backdrop that local commentators have observed a growing tension between preservingkeeping something in its original or existing state保存 time-honoured customs and adapting them to attract younger, more internationally minded audiences — a balancing act that HKDSE students may find fruitful to explore when reflecting on how heritage can remain relevant in a rapidly changing city.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據報導,香港旅遊發展局將於維多利亞公園舉辦全港首個「國際花燈薈萃」,活動由九月十七日至二十七日舉行,主題為「團圓」。是次活動將展示超過三千盞來自二十個國家及地區的花燈,包括南韓晉州的絲綢花燈、色彩繽紛的巴西拼布圖案花燈,以及波蘭民間剪紙工藝作品。

有意見認為,如此具野心、以國際為主題的展覽,與過往較為傳統的花燈嘉年華有所不同。然而,支持者則認為,這次擴展反映香港致力為文化旅遊項目注入新活力的更廣泛努力。展覽的重點展品、一座高八米的裝置「影語」,靈感取自香港標誌性的榕樹,而毗鄰的香港花燈廊則展出逾四百盞本地手工製作的花燈,造型包括兔子、楊桃及金魚,為年長的參觀者喚起一股濃厚的懷舊氣氛。

與此同時,今年的慶祝活動與大坑舞火龍活動同期舉行,舞火龍將於九月二十四日至二十六日舉行,一條長六十七米、以約一萬二千支香枝點燃照亮的火龍,蜿蜒穿過社區的狹窄街道。舞火龍活動今年已踏入第一百四十七屆,並已被列入中國國家級非物質文化遺產名錄,足證其歷久不衰的文化意義。正是在這背景下,本地評論者觀察到,保存歷史悠久的習俗與將之改良以吸引較年輕、較具國際視野的觀眾之間,存在著日益加劇的張力——這正是一個值得香港中學文憑試考生在思考傳統文化如何在急速變遷的城市中保持相關性時,深入探討的課題。

articles.headline: Paul Chan Unveils HK$50 Million 'AI for All' Upskilling Drive for Workers
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that Financial Secretary Paul Chan has unveiled a HK$50 million initiative, dubbedgiven an informal name or nickname被稱為 “AI for All”, under which the Employees Retraining Board will join forces withto combine efforts with another party towards a shared goal與……聯手 major technology firms to deliver specialised artificial intelligence courses for working professionals from November. The scheme forms part of a broader drive to reach 50,000 people through some 200 activities over the next two years.

Critics contend that the pace of change is a genuine cause for concern, warning that Hong Kong risks lagging behindis in danger of falling behind others in progress有落後的風險 if reskilling efforts fail to keep pace with the rapid adoption of AI across industries. Indeed, some commentators have pointed out that current training initiatives, however welcome, reach only a small fraction of the city's overall workforce. Nevertheless, proponents argue that the collaboration between government bodies and the private sector represents a meaningful step towards future-proofingpreparing something so it remains effective in the future為未來做好準備 Hong Kong's labour force against technological disruption.

By the same token, the Employees Retraining Board is itself being rebrandedgiven a new name and image重新命名 as “Upskill Hong Kong”, a change intended to signal a shift towards continuous, lifelong learning rather than one-off vocational training. Cyberport, the Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation and the Hong Kong Productivity Council will jointly deliver a range of tailored modules for students, members of the public and working professionals alike. It is against this backdrop that officials have described artificial intelligence as a central planka fundamental or essential part of a plan核心支柱 of Hong Kong's economic strategy, one that HKDSE students preparing to enter the workforce would be wise to factor intoto take something into account when planning納入考慮 their own career planning.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據報導,財政司司長陳茂波公布一項涉資五千萬港元、名為「AI for All」的計劃,僱員再培訓局將與主要科技企業聯手,由十一月起為在職人士提供專門的人工智能課程。此計劃屬於一項更廣泛推動措施的一部分,目標在未來兩年內透過約二百項活動,接觸五萬人。

有評論指出,轉變步伐之快確實令人憂慮,並警告若技能再培訓未能跟上各行各業迅速採用人工智能的步伐,香港將有落後的風險。事實上,有論者指出,現時的培訓措施儘管值得歡迎,卻只惠及全港勞動人口中一小部分。然而,支持者認為,政府部門與私人企業之間的合作,是為香港勞動力應對科技衝擊、為未來做好準備邁出有意義的一步。

與此同時,僱員再培訓局本身亦將重新命名為「Upskill Hong Kong」,此一轉變旨在標誌著政策方向由一次性的職業培訓,轉向持續的終身學習。數碼港、香港科技園公司及香港生產力促進局將聯手提供一系列度身訂造的課程單元,對象涵蓋學生、公眾人士及在職專業人員。正是在這背景下,官員形容人工智能是香港經濟策略的核心支柱,即將投身職場的香港中學文憑試考生,應將此納入自身的職業規劃考慮之中。

cover_text.en: Hong Kong launches HK$50m AI upskilling scheme

articles.headline: Eight 'Zero-Class' Primary Schools Approved for Merger as Hong Kong's Birth Rate Hits Record Low
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that the Education Bureau has given the go-ahead for eight so-called “zero-class” primary schools — institutions that failed to secure sufficient enrolmentsucceed in attracting enough students未能取得足夠收生人數 to open a Primary One class this September — to merge with neighbouring institutions, while two others will run self-financing classes and a further four are set to be phased outgradually closed down over time逐步淘汰 altogether. The wave of closures and mergers, among them the case of Fresh Fish Traders School joining forces with a nearby institution, is widely attributed to Hong Kong’s record-low birth ratethe lowest number of births ever recorded歷來最低出生率, with only 31,714 babies registered last year.

Critics contend that such large-scale restructuring, however necessary on paper, risks erodinggradually wearing away or weakening侵蝕；削弱 decades of institutional identity and alumni attachment overnight. Teachers at affected schools have voiced concern over job security, while parents worry about the disruption of moving children mid-way through their primary education to unfamiliar campuses. Nevertheless, the Education Bureau has sought to cushion the impactsoften or reduce the negative effect of something緩衝影響 by granting merged schools a three-year grace period during which class sizes are not strictly enforced, allowing time to iron outto resolve small problems or difficulties解決；理順 practical matters such as curriculum alignment and staff arrangements.

By the same token, education commentators argue that mergers alone are but a stopgap rather than a genuine solution to a much deeper demographic predicamenta difficult and unpleasant situation困境. With Hong Kong’s population continuing to age and its workforce contracting, some have called for a more holisticconsidering the whole picture rather than just individual parts全面的；整體的 population policy that goes beyond the education sector alone. It remains to be seen whether the current wave of consolidation will be sufficient to sustain smaller neighbourhood schools in the years ahead, or whether further closures are simply being deferreddelayed or postponed to a later time推遲 rather than avoided.

vocab.sample: The small primary school struggled to secure sufficient enrolment for a second consecutive year.
The programme will be phased out gradually over the next three academic years.
Hong Kong's record-low birth rate has forced several schools to reconsider their long-term viability.
Frequent leadership changes have eroded staff morale at the school.
Extra funding was provided to cushion the impact of the sudden policy change.
The two schools met several times to iron out differences in their teaching schedules.
Ageing populations have left many cities in a demographic predicament.
A holistic approach to population policy considers housing, education and healthcare together.
The board decided to defer its decision on further school closures until next year.
Alumni feared that the merger would weaken the school's institutional identity.
The school will operate a self-financing class to keep its doors open this year.
An ageing population places growing pressure on Hong Kong's healthcare and pension systems.

phrases.sample: The bureau plans to consolidate under-enrolled campuses rather than close them outright.

phrases.sample: A shrinking cohort of school-age children lies behind most of these closures.

phrases.sample: Uncertainty over job security has strained staff morale during the restructuring.

phrases.sample: The grace period buys time rather than guaranteeing the merged school's long-term survival.

phrases.sample: Experts are calling for a population policy spanning more than one sector.

phrases.sample: Repeated zero-class cases signal a structural decline in demand for local schooling.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據廣泛報導,教育局已批准八間所謂「零班」小學——即未能在今年九月取得足夠收生人數開辦小一班級的學校——與鄰近學校合併,另有兩間學校將開辦自資班,餘下四間則將逐步停辦。這一波停辦及合併潮,包括鮮魚行學校與附近學校合併的個案,普遍歸因於香港歷來最低的出生率,去年全港僅登記31,714名新生嬰兒。

評論者認為,此類大規模重組,縱使在紙面上有其必要性,卻有可能在一夜之間侵蝕數十年來建立的機構身份認同及校友情誼。受影響學校的教師表達了對職位保障的關注,家長則擔心子女需在小學學業中途轉往陌生校園所帶來的適應問題。然而,教育局試圖緩衝影響,向合併學校提供為期三年的寬限期,期間班級人數不會被嚴格執行,以爭取時間理順課程銜接及教職員安排等實際事宜。

同樣地,教育界評論者認為,單靠合併只是權宜之計,而非解決更深層人口困境的真正方案。隨著香港人口持續老化、勞動人口不斷萎縮,有意見呼籲制訂更全面的人口政策,範疇須超越教育界別本身。現時這一波整合措施,能否足以維持小型地區學校在未來數年的生存,抑或只是將進一步的停辦推遲而非避免,仍有待觀察。

cover_text.en: Eight zero-class schools approved to merge

articles.headline: Households and Small Businesses Squeezed as Power Fuel Surcharges Soar for Fourth Straight Month
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that HK Electric’s fuel clause charge climbed to 60.7 Hong Kong cents per kilowatt-houra unit for measuring the amount of electricity used千瓦時（度電） this September, marking the fourth consecutivefollowing one after another without interruption連續的 monthly increase since May and pushing the average net tariff up by 1.8 per cent from August. Having surgedincreased suddenly and greatly急升 roughly 1.3 times since March, the mounting surcharge has left many households bracing for heftier bills just as summer’s air-conditioning demand begins to taper off.

Critics contend that the repeated hikes are placing a disproportionate burdena heavy load of responsibility, work, or cost負擔 on small and medium-sized enterprises already grappling with thin profit margins and subdued consumer spending. Business groups have accordingly renewed their lobbyingtrying to persuade officials to support a particular policy游說 for targeted energy subsidies, arguing that without timely relief, some smaller operators could be pushed to the brink of closure. Nevertheless, the power companies maintain that the increases largely reflect volatile global fuel prices and ongoing geopolitical tensions rather than domestic factors, and both operators have rolled out rebate schemes aimed at alleviatingmaking a problem less severe紓緩 the strain on grassroots households.

By the same token, economists caution that unless the upward trend is curbedcontrolled or restricted遏止, the knock-on effect on Hong Kong’s broader cost of living could further squeeze consumers who are already wary of inflation. It is against this backdrop that calls for a more transparent fuel-clause mechanism, and greater governmental oversight of tariff adjustments, have gained tractionincreasing acceptance or support認受性；支持 among legislators and consumer-rights advocates alike.

vocab.sample: The fuel clause charge is reviewed monthly and appears as a separate line on electricity bills.
This was the third consecutive monthly increase in the surcharge this year.
Global oil prices surged after the announcement of new trade restrictions.
Small businesses often bear a disproportionate burden when utility costs rise sharply.
Industry associations are lobbying for tax relief to offset rising energy costs.
The government introduced a temporary energy subsidy for low-income households.

Under the new rebate scheme, eligible households will receive a monthly credit on their bills.

The cost of living in Hong Kong has climbed steadily over the past year.
Calls for greater transparency in tariff-setting have gained traction among lawmakers.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據廣泛報導,港燈的燃料條款收費本九月攀升至每千瓦時60.7港仙,是自五月以來連續第四個月上升,令九月平均淨電費較八月上漲百分之一點八。該項附加費自三月以來已急升約1.3倍,不斷上升的收費令不少家庭在夏季冷氣需求開始減退之際,仍須為更高昂的電費單做好準備。

評論者認為,接連加價正為原已面對微薄利潤及消費疲弱的中小企帶來不成比例的負擔。商界團體因此再次游說當局提供針對性的能源補貼,指出若未能及時紓緩,部分較小型的商戶恐被推向結業邊緣。然而,電力公司堅稱,加幅主要反映環球燃料價格反覆波動及持續的地緣政治緊張局勢,而非本地因素所致,兩間電力公司亦已推出回贈計劃,旨在紓緩基層家庭的壓力。

同樣地,經濟學者警告,除非這股上升趨勢受到遏止,否則對香港整體生活成本造成的連鎖反應,恐進一步擠壓本已對通脹感到憂慮的消費者。正是在這背景下,要求建立更具透明度的燃料條款機制,以及加強政府對電費調整的監察的呼聲,在立法會議員及消費者權益倡導者之間均獲得支持。

cover_text.en: Hong Kong power surcharge rises for fourth month

articles.headline: Three Severe Child Flu Cases Prompt Vaccination Appeal as Hong Kong's Influenza Season Persists
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that the Centre for Health Protection has recorded three additional severe paediatric influenza cases, all involving previously healthy children who had shown no history of travel during their incubation periodthe time between infection and the appearance of symptoms潛伏期. Health officials have accordingly renewed their appealrepeated a request or urgent call again再次呼籲 for members of the public, particularly children and the elderly, to seek vaccination ahead of the Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programme, which begins on 17 September.

Since the end of June, a cumulative total of sixteen severe paediatric cases have been documentedofficially recorded in writing記錄在案, of which eight patients have since recovered and been discharged, two remain in a stable condition, three are classified as serious, two are critical, and one has tragically died. In one instance, two classmates of an affected six-year-old girl subsequently developed mild symptoms, though neither required hospitalisation; the school concerned has since been advised to step upincrease or intensify an effort加強 infection-control measures such as more frequent disinfection and closer monitoring of student attendance.

Nevertheless, with Hong Kong having entered its influenza season as early as late June and activity levels remaining stubbornly highpersistently high despite efforts to lower it居高不下, the CHP has cautioned that the coming weeks — coinciding with the start of the new school term — could see a further uptick in transmission. By the same token, parents and school staff alike are being urged to remain vigilantwatchful and alert to possible danger保持警惕 for early symptoms, to observe good personal hygiene, and to seek timely medical attention, lest a single overlooked case snowballgrow rapidly in size or seriousness迅速惡化；滾雪球式擴大 into a wider school outbreak.

vocab.sample: Symptoms typically appear after an incubation period of one to four days.
Doctors renewed their appeal for parents to vaccinate young children before winter.
The cumulative total of reported cases has risen sharply since last month.
Every suspected case must be carefully documented by hospital staff.
The school stepped up hygiene measures after two students fell ill.
Strict infection-control measures helped prevent the outbreak from spreading further.
Flu activity has remained stubbornly high despite the cooler weather.
Residents are advised to remain vigilant for symptoms such as fever and coughing.

The patient was previously healthy with no underlying medical conditions.

phrases.sample: Officials have moved to heighten surveillance in schools following the cluster of cases.

phrases.en: underline the value of early vaccination
phrases.zh: 突顯及早接種疫苗的價值
phrases.sample: The tragic case underlines the value of early vaccination for vulnerable groups.

phrases.en: contain a localised cluster
phrases.zh: 遏止局部群組感染
phrases.sample: Swift measures helped contain a localised cluster before it spread further.

phrases.en: weigh on an already strained healthcare system
phrases.zh: 為本已緊張的醫療系統增添壓力
phrases.sample: A severe flu season could weigh on an already strained healthcare system.

phrases.en: a stark reminder of flu's unpredictability
phrases.zh: 清楚提醒流感的不可預測性
phrases.sample: The child's death is a stark reminder of flu's unpredictability even in healthy patients.

phrases.en: ramp up disinfection routines
phrases.zh: 加強消毒程序
phrases.sample: Schools have been told to ramp up disinfection routines amid the rise in cases.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據廣泛報導,衞生防護中心新增三宗嚴重兒童流感個案,患者均為一向健康的兒童,其潛伏期內亦沒有外遊紀錄。衞生官員因此再次呼籲市民,特別是兒童及長者,在九月十七日展開的季節性流感疫苗接種計劃前及早接種疫苗。

自六月底以來,累計已錄得十六宗嚴重兒童個案,當中八名病人已康復出院,兩人情況穩定,三人情況嚴重,兩人情況危殆,一人不幸死亡。其中一宗個案中,一名六歲女童的兩名同學其後出現輕微病徵,惟兩人均毋須入院治療;涉事學校其後已獲建議加強感染控制措施,例如更頻密消毒及更密切監察學生出席情況。

然而,由於香港早於六月下旬已踏入流感季節,活動水平持續居高不下,衞生防護中心警告,未來數星期正值新學年開學之際,傳播個案或會進一步上升。同樣地,當局促請家長及學校教職員保持警惕,留意早期病徵,注重個人衛生,並及時求醫,以免一宗被忽略的個案迅速惡化成更大範圍的學校爆發。

cover_text.en: Severe child flu cases prompt vaccination appeal

articles.headline: Hong Kong to Roll Out AI Upskilling Drive as Government Concedes Automation Will Displace Some Jobs
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that the government, through Financial Secretary Paul Chan, has unveiled plans for the Employees Retraining Board to join forces withto cooperate or work together with someone與……聯手 major technology firms from November onwards, delivering specialised artificial intelligence courses to the local workforce. The initiative forms part of a broader HK$50 million “AI for All” campaign expected to directly benefitto help someone in a way that has an immediate, clear effect直接惠及 some 50,000 residents through more than two hundred training events over the coming two years.

Critics contend, however, that the scheme’s scale falls conspicuously short of the challenge at hand: current retraining efforts are estimated to reach a mere one per cent of the working population, even as demand for AI-related skills has accelerated markedlyincreased in speed or intensity in a noticeable way顯著加快, with AI job postings rising fifty per cent year-on-year. Compounding matters, full-time vacancies suitable for university graduates have plungedfallen suddenly and sharply急跌 by sixty per cent since 2022, leaving many young jobseekers questioning whether their qualifications remain commensurate withmatching or in proportion to something與……相稱 the demands of an AI-driven labour market.

Nevertheless, officials maintain that government-led upskilling represents only one prongone part of a multi-part plan or strategy（策略的）一環 of a wider strategy, and have called on employers to shoulder greater responsibility for reskilling their own staff. By the same token, career counsellors are increasingly urging secondary and university students alike to treat AI literacythe ability to understand and effectively use artificial intelligence tools人工智能素養 not as an optional extra but as a core, transferableable to be applied in different contexts or jobs可轉移的；通用的 skill essential to safeguarding their long-term employability.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據廣泛報導,政府透過財政司司長陳茂波公布計劃,僱員再培訓局將由十一月起與主要科技企業聯手,為本地勞動人口提供專門的人工智能課程。此計劃屬於一項涉資五千萬港元、名為「AI for All」的更廣泛推動措施之一部分,預計未來兩年將透過超過二百項培訓活動,直接惠及約五萬名市民。

然而,評論者認為,計劃的規模明顯未能應付眼前的挑戰:現時的再培訓措施估計只能惠及勞動人口中約百分之一,而對人工智能相關技能的需求卻顯著加快,人工智能職位空缺按年上升百分之五十。使情況更加複雜的是,適合大學畢業生的全職職位空缺自2022年以來已急跌百分之六十,令不少年輕求職者質疑自己的學歷是否仍與人工智能主導的勞動市場需求相稱。

articles.headline: Post Malone Postpones Hong Kong Stadium Concert, Leaving Fans Frustrated
articles.summary_html:
American rapper Post Malone has indefinitely postponedput off without a fixed new date無限期推遲 his Hong Kong stadium concert, originally scheduled for 16 September at Kai Tak Stadium as the opening date of his Big Ass Stadium World Tour across Asia. The promoter issued a brief statement confirming that ticket holders who purchased through HK Ticketing, Damai and Trip.com would receive full refundscomplete reimbursement of the purchase price全額退款 within twenty to thirty working days, though no explanation was offered for the sudden change. The announcement, made on 4 September, has sparked widespread disappointmenttriggered a strong negative reaction among many people引起廣泛失望 among fans, many of whom had already booked annual leave, flights and hotel accommodation specifically around the concert date.

It is widely argued that the postponement, which extends to the entire eight-date Asian leg as well as subsequent Australian and New Zealand shows, points to logistical challengespractical difficulties in organising and coordinating an event後勤上的困難 inherent in mounting a stadium tour of unprecedented scalea size or level never seen before前所未有的規模 across multiple time zones and venues. Critics contend that such disruption carries a significant financial cost, not only for the artist and promoter but also for fans who cannot always recover incidental expenses such as travel bookings. Since opening in 2025, Kai Tak Stadium has rapidly become Hong Kong's premier live entertainment huba central location where large concerts and performances are held現場娛樂樞紐, and a high-profile cancellation of this kind inevitably raises questions about the reliability of the city's expanding concert calendar.

Nevertheless, industry observers note that postponements of this nature are not unusual within global touring schedules and do not necessarily reflect on Hong Kong's own capacity to host large-scale events. By the same token, the episode has renewed calls for stronger consumer protectionlegal safeguards for the rights and interests of buyers消費者保障 measures within the ticketing industry, particularly clearer refund timelines and compensation for non-ticket losses. The ripple effecta spreading, indirect consequence of an event連鎖反應 of the cancellation, from disappointed fans to affected hospitality bookings, illustrates how deeply intertwined live entertainment has become with Hong Kong's broader tourism economy, and underscores the importance of transparent communication whenever such changes are unavoidable.

vocab.sample: The stadium tour was meant to open in Hong Kong before expanding across Asia.
Organisers offered no official explanation for the delay.
Fans were left out of pocket over non-refundable flight bookings.
Kai Tak Stadium has quickly become a premier venue for international acts.
The multi-city itinerary across Asia was disrupted by the sudden postponement.
Some fans are considering a compensation claim for their travel losses.
Organisers published a clear refund timeline to calm anxious fans.
Hong Kong's events calendar has grown rapidly since the stadium opened.
Touring artists often adjust schedules at short notice for logistical reasons.

Hospitality bookings tied to the concert date were thrown into disarray.
Short-notice cancellations can damage a venue's standing with overseas fans.

phrases.zh: 橫跨多個時區及場館
phrases.sample: Coordinating a tour that spans multiple time zones and venues leaves little room for error.

phrases.en: shoulder costs that cannot be recovered
phrases.zh: 承擔無法追討的開支

phrases.en: a recurring feature of global touring
phrases.zh: 全球巡演中反覆出現的現象
phrases.sample: Last-minute postponements have become a recurring feature of global touring in recent years.

phrases.en: fail to compensate for indirect losses

phrases.sample: Current rules fail to compensate for indirect losses such as hotel cancellation fees.

phrases.en: strengthen safeguards for ticket buyers
phrases.zh: 加強對購票者的保障
phrases.sample: Lawmakers want to strengthen safeguards for ticket buyers after repeated cancellations.

phrases.en: tie a city's reputation to a single event
phrases.zh: 將城市的聲譽與單一活動掛鈎
phrases.sample: Commentators warn against tying a city's reputation too closely to a single event.

phrases.en: spill over into the hospitality sector
phrases.zh: 波及酒店業
phrases.sample: The cancellation's impact quickly spilled over into the hospitality sector.

phrases.en: demand clarity rather than silence
phrases.zh: 要求清晰交代而非沉默以對
phrases.sample: Fans demanded clarity rather than silence from organisers after the announcement.

phrases.zh: 為整個行業帶來負面觀感
phrases.sample: A single mishandled cancellation can reflect poorly on an entire industry.

phrases.en: leave a city's concert calendar looking fragile
phrases.zh: 令城市的演唱會日程顯得脆弱
phrases.sample: Back-to-back postponements leave a city's concert calendar looking fragile.

phrases.zh: 為忠實樂迷減輕打擊
phrases.sample: A swift refund process can help soften the blow for loyal fans.

phrases.zh: 揭示消費者保障的漏洞
phrases.sample: The episode exposes gaps in consumer safeguards within the ticketing industry.

articles.summary_zh_html:
美國說唱歌手Post Malone已無限期推遲其香港體育館演唱會,原定於九月十六日假啟德體育園舉行,作為其「Big Ass Stadium World Tour」亞洲巡演的首站。主辦方發出簡短聲明,確認透過HK Ticketing、大麥及Trip.com購票的持票人將於二十至三十個工作天內獲得全額退款,惟並未就今次突如其來的變動提供任何解釋。這項於九月四日發出的公告,在樂迷之間引起廣泛失望,當中不少人早已特意為演唱會日期安排年假、訂好機票及酒店住宿。

有意見認為,今次延期不僅限於香港一站,更擴及整個八站的亞洲巡演行程,以及其後的澳洲及新西蘭演出,反映籌辦橫跨多個時區及場館、規模前所未有的體育館巡演所固有的後勤挑戰。有評論指出,此類延誤帶來相當可觀的財務代價,不僅影響歌手及主辦方,亦令未必能追討機票酒店等附帶開支的樂迷蒙受損失。啟德體育園自2025年啟用以來,已迅速成為香港首屈一指的現場娛樂樞紐,如此備受矚目的取消事件,無可避免地令人質疑這個日漸擴展的演唱會日程的可靠程度。

然而,業內人士指出,此類延期在全球巡演安排中並不罕見,亦未必反映香港本身舉辦大型活動的能力。同樣地,今次事件重新引發要求加強票務業消費者保障措施的呼聲,特別是更清晰的退款時間表,以及對非門票損失的賠償安排。是次取消事件所造成的連鎖反應,由失望的樂迷到受影響的酒店訂房,說明現場娛樂已與香港整體旅遊經濟緊密相連,亦突顯在無可避免需要作出變動時,保持訊息透明的重要性。

cover_text.en: Post Malone postpones entire Asia stadium tour

articles.headline: Victoria Park to Host Expanded Mid-Autumn Lantern Displays and Fire Dragon Dance
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong will host an expandedmade larger in size, scope or quantity擴大的 Mid-Autumn Festival celebration this September, with the Leisure and Cultural Services Department's long-running Lantern Carnival at Victoria Park now joined by the Hong Kong Tourism Board's first-ever International Lantern Spectacular, running from 17 to 27 September. Centred on the theme of "Reunion", the new display will bring together more than 3,000 lanterns from twenty countries and regions, including intricately crafted Qinhuai lanterns from Nanjing that are inscribed onofficially recorded or listed as被列入 China's National List of Intangible Cultural Heritage.

It is widely argued that pairing a homegrown tradition with international lantern craftsmanship reflects a deliberate strategy to bolsterstrengthen or support增強 Hong Kong's appeal as a cultural tourism destination while still honouring local heritage. Nearby, the centuries-old Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance, a fixture on the same National Intangible Cultural Heritage list, will mark its 147th edition from 24 to 26 September, with a 67-metre dragon illuminated by 12,000 incense sticks weaving through the neighbourhood's streets. Such events play a pivotal role inhave a crucial and central function in扮演關鍵角色 sustaining intangible cultural practices that might otherwise fade as urban life modernises.

By the same token, the free admission offered to both the Lantern Carnival and the International Lantern Spectacular signals an effort to foster inclusivitypromote a sense that events welcome everyone regardless of background培養包容性, ensuring that residents across income levels can participate in the festivities. Nevertheless, some heritage advocates caution that commercialisationthe process of managing something mainly for profit商業化 of traditional festivals risks diluting their original spiritual and communal significance. On balance, however, the coordinated programme illustrates how Hong Kong continues to negotiate a balance between preserving authentic tradition and cultivatingdeveloping or promoting deliberately培養 a distinctive, internationally recognised cultural identity.

The annual Lantern Carnival draws large crowds to Victoria Park every year.
The fire dragon dance winds through Tai Hang's narrow streets each autumn.
The dragon is studded with thousands of lit incense sticks.

phrases.en: draw visitors beyond the festival's traditional audience
phrases.zh: 吸引超越傳統觀眾群的旅客
phrases.sample: International elements are designed to draw visitors beyond the festival's traditional audience.

phrases.zh: 在精神意義與商業吸引力之間取得平衡
phrases.sample: Festival organisers must balance spiritual meaning against commercial appeal.

phrases.zh: 讓社區儀式登上國際舞台
phrases.sample: Heritage status has given this neighbourhood ritual a global stage it never previously had.

phrases.zh: 以真實的文化遺產作為旅遊推廣的根基
phrases.sample: Officials insist the campaign is rooted in genuine heritage rather than manufactured spectacle.

phrases.zh: 防範令傳統流於空洞
phrases.sample: Advocates want safeguards to guard against hollowing out the tradition for profit.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港將於九月舉辦一場擴大版的中秋節慶祝活動,康樂及文化事務署一年一度在維多利亞公園舉行的花燈晚會,將與香港旅遊發展局首次舉辦、由九月十七日至二十七日舉行的「國際花燈薈萃」同場展出。是次活動以「團圓」為主題,匯聚超過三千盞來自二十個國家及地區的花燈,包括製作工藝精細、已被列入中國國家級非物質文化遺產名錄的南京秦淮花燈。

有意見認為,將本土傳統與國際花燈工藝並置,反映出一項刻意的策略,旨在增強香港作為文化旅遊目的地的吸引力,同時仍然尊重本地傳統文化。在附近,歷史悠久的大坑舞火龍——同樣被列入國家級非物質文化遺產名錄——將於九月二十四日至二十六日舉行第一百四十七屆活動,一條長六十七米、以一萬二千支香枝點燃照亮的火龍將穿梭社區街巷。此類活動對於維繫原本可能隨城市生活現代化而逐漸式微的非物質文化習俗,具有舉足輕重的作用。

同樣地,花燈晚會及國際花燈薈萃均設免費入場,此舉顯示出一種致力培養包容性的努力,確保不同收入階層的市民皆可參與這些節慶活動。然而,部分文化遺產倡議者提醒,傳統節慶的商業化有可能削弱其原有的精神及社群意義。然而總體而言,這個協調一致的節目安排,說明香港如何持續在保存真正傳統與培養獨特而獲國際認可的文化身份之間,尋求平衡。

cover_text.en: Victoria Park doubles up for Mid-Autumn Festival

articles.headline: HKU Partners with Tech Giants to Open AI Labs at Expanded Shanghai Campus
articles.summary_html:
The University of Hong Kong has partnered with several major technology companies to establish on-site artificial intelligence laboratories at its expanded Shanghai campus, which welcomed more than 300 students at the start of the new academic term earlier this month. The initiative is designed to equip students withprovide someone with the tools or skills needed為學生裝備 hands-on experience in developing and applying AI systems, rather than relying solely on theoretical instruction. It comes amid a broader national push, articulated in the 15th Five-Year Plan, for Hong Kong to serve as a hub for AI research, development and commercialisationthe process of turning research into marketable products商業化.

It is widely argued that partnerships of this kind allow universities to keep pace with an industry that evolves far more rapidly than traditional curricula can accommodate. Critics contend that Hong Kong's tertiary institutions have historically been slow to bridge the gap betweenreduce the difference or distance separating two things彌合……之間的差距 academic theory and workplace-ready skills; the new AI labs are intended to directly address this shortfall. By the same token, Chief Executive John Lee has described AI as a central planka fundamental or defining part of a plan or policy核心支柱 of the city's economic development strategy, and the forthcoming AI Research and Development Institute, due to begin operations later this year, is expected to further catalysecause or accelerate a process促進 commercialisation efforts across sectors.

Nevertheless, some educators caution that access to cutting-edge facilities must be matched by sufficient teaching capacity and clear pathways into employment, or else students may graduate with impressive technical exposure but limited practical opportunity. On the other hand, supporters maintain that positioning Hong Kong students within a cross-borderspanning or operating across national or regional borders跨境的 campus network gives them a distinct competitive advantage as regional demand for AI talent continues to intensify. Ultimately, the success of such initiatives will depend on whether laboratory-based learning translates into tangible innovation and employment outcomes for the students who pass through them.

vocab.sample: The new artificial intelligence laboratory allows students to build and test their own models.
Employers increasingly value hands-on experience over purely theoretical qualifications.
Several tertiary institutions in Hong Kong are expanding their technology partnerships.
The programme was designed to equip graduates with workplace-ready skills.
Government funding aims to accelerate the commercialisation of local research.

articles.headline: All Signals Cancelled as Tropical Depression Saudel Weakens Over Guangdong
articles.summary_html:
The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled all tropical cyclone warning signals earlier this month after Tropical Depression Saudel, which had earlier prompted a Standby Signal No. 1, weakenedbecame less strong or intense減弱 into an area of low pressure over inland Guangdong. The system had made landfall over Zhangzhou in Fujian before tracking across eastern Guangdong and losing strength, with forecasters concluding that a higher signal, such as the Strong Wind Signal No. 3, was unlikely to be warrantednot probable to be justified or necessary不太可能有需要 as the storm dissipated. The episode marked the latest in a string of tropical systems, following closely behind Tropical Storm Krovanh, to brush past the city during an unusually active September.

It is widely argued that the frequency of such systems this year reflects broader climatic shifts affecting the western Pacific, with environmental groups noting that Hong Kong has experienced an uptick inan increase or rise in the frequency of something……的增加 tropical cyclone activity and rainstorm warnings compared with historical averages. Critics contend that while the Observatory's forecasting has grown increasingly accurate, public preparednessthe state of being ready to deal with a situation應變準備 for rapid signal changes remains uneven, particularly among outdoor workers and small business operators who must adjust their schedules at short notice.

Nevertheless, officials point out that swift signal cancellations, such as the one following Saudel's dissipation, allow economic activity to resume quickly and minimise disruptionreduce interference or inconvenience to the smallest possible extent減少干擾 to daily life. By the same token, this pattern of frequent but often short-lived storms underscores the importance of maintaining climate resiliencethe capacity to withstand and recover from climate-related shocks氣候韌性 measures, including improved drainage and early-warning systems, so that the city can adapt as extreme weather events become an increasingly routine feature of the autumn season.

Scientists point to climatic shifts as a possible cause of more frequent storms.
A rainstorm warning was issued as heavy downpours battered the city overnight.

不少人認為，今年熱帶氣旋系統頻繁出現，反映西太平洋地區氣候正在轉變，環保團體指出，本港熱帶氣旋活動及暴雨警告的次數較歷年平均明顯增加。然而，儘管天文台預測日益準確，公眾對信號急速轉變的應變準備仍然參差不齊，戶外工作者及小商戶尤其需要在短時間內調整工作安排。

articles.headline: CityU concludes disciplinary probe after viral orientation camp video sparks controversy
articles.summary_html:
A viral orientation-camp video has plunged the City University of Hong Kong (CityU) into one of its most closely scrutinisedexamined in great detail被仔細審視 controversies of the new academic year. Footage circulating on Threads and Instagram showed a shirtless male student carrying a female peer clad only in underwear at a so-called "disco night", while onlookers in matching T-shirts cheered and waved glowsticks. Further images that later surfaced, showing students with bruising and red marks on their backs and thighs, only served to inflame public outragemake public anger worse激化公憤. It is widely argued that such rituals, dressed up as bonding exercises, in fact normalise a culture ofmake something seem acceptable through repetition使……成為常態 humiliation that few first-year students feel able to refuse.

In the wake ofimmediately following在……之後 the backlash, CityU vowed a policy of "zero tolerance" and convened a Student Discipline Panel to investigate. The inquiry has now concluded: all students involved have admitted wrongdoing, apologised formally, and accepted disciplinary penalties, although the university has withheld specific sanctions to safeguard student privacyprotect students’ personal information保障學生私隱. The Management Sciences Society, the students’ union body that organised the event, acknowledged serious mismanagementadmitted it had handled matters very badly承認嚴重管理失當 and promptly dissolved its executive committee. Critics contend that such swift internal dissolution, while symbolically important, does little to address the deeper question of why so-called "Ocamp" excesses resurface year after yearhappen again and again年復一年地重演 despite repeated pledges of reform.

Nevertheless, the episode has reignited a long-running debate about initiation culture at Hong Kong’s universities. By the same token that fraternities abroad have faced hazing bans after injuries and deaths, local commentators argue it is imperative that institutions move beyond token gesturesstop making only symbolic or superficial changes不再只作表面姿態 and instead overhaul the supervisory mechanismsthoroughly reform the systems of oversight徹底改革監督機制 governing student-run events. There is little doubt that peer pressure, alcohol, and a desire to belong together create fertile ground for poor judgement among freshmen eager to fit in. For this reason, student affairs offices across the sector are now under pressure to strike a balance betweenfind a fair middle ground between two competing needs在……之間取得平衡 preserving cherished traditions of camaraderie and protecting the basic dignity and safety of every participant.

一段瘋傳的迎新營片段，令香港城市大學（城大）捲入新學年以來最受仔細審視的風波之一。片段在Threads及Instagram上廣傳，顯示一名赤裸上身的男生背著一名只穿內衣的女同學，在所謂「的士高之夜」上到處走動，而身穿同款T恤的旁觀者則歡呼並揮動螢光棒。後來流出的其他照片顯示，有學生背部及大腿留有瘀傷及紅印，進一步激化公憤。有意見認為，這類打著聯誼活動旗號的儀式，實際上使羞辱文化成為常態，令大部分新生難以拒絕參與。

在輿論風波之後，城大承諾採取「零容忍」政策，並成立學生紀律委員會進行調查。調查現已完結：所有涉事學生承認犯錯、正式致歉並接受紀律處分，惟校方為保障學生私隱而未有公開具體懲處。主辦活動的學生組織管理科學學會則承認嚴重管理失當，並隨即解散其執行委員會。有批評者認為，此等迅速的內部解散舉措雖具象徵意義，卻未能正視核心問題——為何所謂「迎新營」亂象儘管一再承諾改革，仍年復一年地重演。

儘管如此，事件再次引發有關本港大學迎新文化的長期爭論。正如海外大學生會因傷亡事故而禁止欺凌式迎新儀式，本地評論員認為院校必須不再只作表面姿態，而應徹底改革監管學生自辦活動的機制。無可否認，同儕壓力、酒精及渴望歸屬感三者結合，容易令急於融入的新生判斷力下降。因此，各院校的學生事務處現時面對壓力，須在維繫珍貴的同窗情誼與保障每位參與者基本尊嚴及安全之間取得平衡。

articles.headline: 'Covered in bites': pests and extreme heat worsen health risks for Hong Kong's homeless, NGO warns
articles.summary_html:
As Hong Kong swings between record-breaking heatthe hottest temperatures ever recorded破紀錄的高溫 and sudden heavy downpours, the city’s homeless population is facing a health hazard that has so far received little public attention: pests. A new NGO study by ImpactHK, which monitored four sites — including parks, tunnels and footbridges — over fifteen days, found that cockroach and rat infestation rates reached as high as 79 to 83 percent, while every single respondent at the Tsim Sha Tsui Cultural Centre reported problems with biting midges. It is widely argued that such findings lay bareexpose clearly揭露 a dimension of urban poverty that is too often overlooked.

The consequences extend well beyond mere discomfortsimple inconvenience純粹的不便. Three-quarters of those surveyed reported severely disrupted sleep, with bites frequently leading to skin inflammation or secondary infection. Nearly one in five said the financial burdenthe strain of extra costs經濟負擔 of buying insect repellent had only worsened their already precarious circumstances. Notably, respondents living on the street reported markedly more severe pest problems than those able to stay in hostels, a gap that critics contend exposes the limits ofreveals the shortcomings of揭示……的局限 current outreach services for the unhoused.

Nevertheless, campaigners insist the findings should not be read merely as an environmental health footnote but as evidence of a vicious cycle of deprivationa self-reinforcing pattern of hardship匱乏的惡性循環 in which extreme weather, inadequate shelter and inequality compound one another. By the same token that heatwaves have already been shown to endanger elderly residents in subdivided flats, advocates argue it is imperative that the government extend outreach provisionsexpand support services to reach more people擴展外展服務 and pest-control resources to the city’s most vulnerable groups. For this reason, ImpactHK is calling on policymakers to treat climate-linked health risks among the homeless as a matter of urgent social equity rather than an issue that can be safely ignored.

articles.summary_zh_html:
隨著香港在破紀錄的高溫與突如其來的暴雨之間反覆交替，該市的無家者正面臨一項至今鮮少受到公眾關注的健康威脅——蟲患。NGO「要想行動」（ImpactHK）一項新研究，在包括公園、隧道及行人天橋等四個地點監察十五天，發現蟑螂及老鼠滋生比率高達79%至83%，而尖沙咀文化中心的所有受訪者均表示受到蚊蚋叮咬困擾。有意見認為，這些發現揭露了一個經常被忽視的城市貧窮面向。

影響遠遠不止於純粹的不便。四分之三受訪者表示睡眠受到嚴重干擾，叮咬亦常導致皮膚發炎或繼發感染。近五分之一受訪者表示，購買驅蚊用品所帶來的經濟負擔，令其本已拮据的生活更加雪上加霜。值得注意的是，露宿街頭的受訪者所面對的蟲患問題，明顯較能入住宿舍的人嚴重，有批評者認為這一差距揭示了現時外展服務對無家者支援的局限。

然而，倡議團體堅持，這些發現不應僅被視為環境衞生的附帶問題，而是匱乏的惡性循環的證據——極端天氣、居所不足與不平等三者互相加劇。正如熱浪已被證實會危及居於分間樓宇的長者，倡議者認為政府必須擴展外展服務及滅蟲資源至本港最脆弱的群體。因此，ImpactHK呼籲政策制定者將無家者所面對的氣候相關健康風險，視為急需正視的社會公平議題，而非可以安然忽視的小事。

cover_text.en: Pests and heat compound health risks for Hong Kong's homeless

articles.headline: Hong Kong suspends contractors over 'extremely serious' Queen Mary Hospital lift defects
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong’s Development Bureau has taken the unprecedented stepan action never taken before前所未見的舉措 of suspending a main contractor and its lift subcontractor from tendering for public works, after defects left the vast majority of lifts in a newly built clinical block at Queen Mary Hospital unreliable. Of the 28 lifts installed, 24 have been affected, delaying the relocation of clinical servicesthe moving of hospital departments to the new building臨床服務的遷移 to the HK$15.15 billion facility that was originally due to open at the end of last year. Engineers have described the scale of the malfunction as "extremely rare" by Hong Kong standards.

It is widely argued that the episode raises uncomfortable questionsquestions that are difficult but necessary to confront令人尷尬的問題 about quality control on major public infrastructure projects. A lawmaker branded the situation "unacceptable", warning that the defects could further delay a project already years behind schedule. Under the terms of the contract, the firms responsible must bear the full cost of remedial workspay entirely for the repairs themselves承擔全部補救工程費用 and could face further claims for losses stemming from the delay. Health chiefs, for their part, have expressed open disappointment, acknowledging thatadmitting that承認 patients and frontline staff continue to bear the brunt of the setback.

Nevertheless, the Hospital Authority insists that rectification work is proceeding, with a target completion by the fourth quarter of this year. Critics contend that such assurances ring hollowsound insincere or unconvincing顯得空洞 to a public that has already waited years for the redevelopment to bear fruit. By the same token that construction delays elsewhere have eroded public confidence in project oversight, commentators argue it is imperative that the government tighten scrutiny overstrengthen its monitoring of加強對……的監察 contractors on safety-critical builds such as hospitals, where delays are measured not merely in dollars but in the everyday welfare of patients.

香港發展局採取前所未見的舉措，暫停一間主要承建商及其升降機分判商參與公共工程投標，事緣耗資150.15億港元興建的瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓內，絕大部分升降機均出現故障，不堪使用。大樓合共安裝28部升降機，當中24部受影響，令原定去年底啟用的新大樓臨床服務的遷移延誤。工程師形容此次故障規模，以香港標準而言「極為罕見」。

不少人認為，事件就大型公共基建項目的品質監控提出令人尷尬的問題。有議員形容情況「不能接受」，警告故障可能令原已延誤多年的工程進一步拖慢。按合約條款，有關承建商須承擔全部補救工程費用，並可能因延誤造成的損失而面臨進一步索償。醫院管理層亦坦言失望，承認病人及前線員工持續承受事件帶來的沉重影響。

不過，醫院管理局堅稱修復工程正在進行，目標於今年第四季完成。有批評者認為，對於一個已苦等重建成果多年的公眾而言，這類保證顯得空洞。正如其他地方的建築延誤已侵蝕公眾對工程監督的信心，評論員認為政府必須加強對醫院等安全攸關工程的承建商監察，因為延誤所付出的代價，不僅計算於金錢，更關乎病人每日的福祉。

articles.headline: Hang Seng Index extends losses as rising oil prices stoke inflation fears
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong equities extended their decline this week as surging oil pricesrapidly rising oil prices急升的油價 and heightened geopolitical tension unsettled investors across the region. The Hang Seng Index slipped roughly 0.5 percent to close near 25,283, marking a second consecutive session of losses after selling pressure had already dragged the benchmark down about 0.9 percent, or 226 points, at the start of the week. It is widely argued that the sell-off reflects growing anxiety over how renewed inflationary pressurea fresh rise in inflation重新出現的通脹壓力 might complicate central banks’ plans to ease interest rates further.

Financial, technology and energy-related counters bore the brunt of the sell-off, as traders weighed stronger-than-expected United States employment data against its implications for Federal Reserve policy. Analysts contend that pricier crude has a habit of seeping into broader inflation expectationsgradually affecting how people expect prices to change generally滲入更廣泛的通脹預期, a development that could, by the same token, weigh on Hong Kong households already grappling with elevated living costs. Nevertheless, some strategists point out that softer bond yields have provided regional markets with a degree of cushioning effecta softening or protective impact緩衝作用 against the worst of the volatility.

For this reason, market watchers are now looking ahead to the Federal Reserve’s upcoming policy decision for clearer signals on the direction of borrowing costs. It is imperative, economists argue, that Hong Kong — whose currency is pegged to the US dollar and whose economy remains highly sensitive tostrongly affected by對……高度敏感 global rate movements — closely monitor these external headwindskeep track of unfavourable outside forces密切監察這些外圍逆風 even as domestic growth forecasts for the year have been revised upward. There is little doubt that ordinary residents, from small investors to homeowners with adjustable mortgages, will be watching the coming weeks with considerable interest.

本週,香港股市持續下跌,急升的油價及地緣政治緊張局勢加劇,令區內投資者坐立不安。恒生指數下跌約0.5%,收報25,283點左右,是連續第二個交易日下跌,此前指數已因沽售壓力在本週初下跌約0.9%,即226點。普遍認為,此次拋售反映市場日益擔心重新出現的通脹壓力,可能令各央行進一步放寬利率的計劃更加複雜。

金融、科技及能源相關股份首當其衝,因交易員正在權衡強於預期的美國就業數據對聯儲局政策的影響。分析師認為,油價上升往往會滲入更廣泛的通脹預期,這一情況同樣可能令早已努力應對高昂生活成本的香港家庭百上加斤。然而,部分策略師指出,債券孳息率回軟,已為區內市場帶來一定的緩衝作用,抵銷部分最壞的波動。

因此,市場人士現正密切留意聯儲局即將公布的政策決定,以掌握借貸成本走向的更清晰訊號。經濟學家認為,香港貨幣與美元掛鈎,經濟亦對全球利率走勢高度敏感,故必須密切監察這些外圍逆風,即使今年本地經濟增長預測已獲調升。毫無疑問,從小投資者到採用浮動利率按揭的業主,普羅市民都將以極大興趣留意未來數週的局勢發展。

articles.headline: Hong Kong Launches AI Privacy Sandbox to Safeguard Students' Data in Schools
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong has rolled outto launch or introduce something推出 a new AI Privacy Sandbox for Schools, a government-backed scheme that allows publicly funded primary and secondary schools to trial artificial intelligence tools in a controlled environmenta regulated setting designed to limit risk受控環境 before adopting them more widely. Applications for the first phase are open to schools until 30 October 2026, with a briefing session having already been held to explain how the scheme will operate. Only fifteen schools will be selected to take part in the initial six-month pilot.

It is widely argued that the initiative reflects a broader attempt to strike a balanceto achieve an even compromise between two demands取得平衡 between technological advancement and the protection of students' personal data. Schools taking part will be able to experiment withto test out in practice嘗試 AI-powered marking, personalised learning platforms and administrative tools, while regulators monitor how student information is collected, stored and used. Officials say the sandbox model will help the Education Bureau formulateto devise or work out a plan or policy制定 clearer guidelines before AI is rolled out across all schools territory-wide.

Critics contend that six months is too short a period to assess the long-term implicationsto evaluate the lasting effects or consequences評估長遠影響 of AI adoption in classrooms, particularly given how quickly the technology evolves. Nevertheless, supporters maintain that a cautious, phased approacha plan carried out in stages rather than all at once分階段方式 is preferable to rushing untested systems into daily use. By the same token, parents' groups have called for greater transparency, urging the government to discloseto make information known publicly披露 exactly what data each participating school collects. As Hong Kong positions itself as a regional AI hub, this small-scale trial may prove to be an important litmus testa decisive indicator of future success or failure試金石 for how the city balances innovation with accountability in education.

vocab.sample: A regulatory sandbox allows new technologies to be tested under close supervision before wider release.
Data protection has become a pressing concern as more schools adopt AI-driven platforms.

普遍認為,這項計劃反映當局嘗試在科技發展與保障學生個人資料之間取得平衡。參與學校將可嘗試人工智能評卷、個人化學習平台及行政工具,而監管機構則會監察學生資料如何被收集、儲存及使用。官員表示,沙盒模式將有助教育局在人工智能全港學校推行前,制定更清晰的指引。

批評者認為,六個月時間過短,難以就人工智能應用於課堂一事評估長遠影響,尤其是科技發展日新月異。然而,支持者堅持審慎、分階段的方式,總比倉促將未經測試的系統投入日常使用更為可取。同樣地,家長團體要求當局提高透明度,促請政府披露每所參與學校所收集的具體資料。隨著香港致力定位為區域人工智能樞紐,這項小規模試驗或將成為衡量本港如何在教育上平衡創新與問責的重要試金石。

articles.headline: HKTB to Host First International Lantern Spectacular This Mid-Autumn
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong will stage its first-ever International Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park this Mid-Autumn Festival, running from 17 to 27 September. Organised by the Hong Kong Tourism Board under the theme "Reunion", the event will bring togetherto unite or combine different elements匯聚 lanterns from twenty countries and regions along a World Lantern Boulevard, including silk pieces from Jinju in South Korea, patchwork designs from Brazil and Polish folk paper-cut crafts. Its centrepiece, an eight-metre lantern called Shadowlight, draws inspiration fromto derive creative ideas from a source取材自 Hong Kong's iconic banyan trees.

Running alongside the Spectacular is the time-honouredrespected because of great age or long-standing tradition歷史悠久的 Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance, now in its 147th edition and inscribed on China's National List of Intangible Cultural Heritage. From 24 to 26 September, a 67-metre dragon illuminated bylit up or made bright by被……照亮 some 12,000 burning incense sticks will weave through the narrow streets of Tai Hang, watched by residents and visitors alike. It is widely argued that such traditions offer a rare window intoan opportunity to observe or understand something not usually visible了解……的窗口 the city's cultural roots at a time when many younger residents feel increasingly disconnected from traditional customs.

Speciality mooncake stalls, run in partnership with Po Leung Kuk, will also showcaseto display or exhibit something to its best advantage展示 regional varieties from 17 to 20 September, ranging from Shanghai Suzhou-style pastries to Yunnan ham flavours. Nevertheless, some heritage advocates caution that pairing centuries-old customs with large-scale tourism promotion risks dilutingto weaken the strength, purity or significance of something沖淡 their original meaning. By the same token, organisers insist that introducing international elements can help revitaliseto give new energy, strength or life to something為……注入新活力 interest in local heritage among both tourists and a new generation of Hong Kong students, who are increasingly encouraged to see festivals such as Mid-Autumn as living, evolving traditions rather than static relics of the past.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港將於本年中秋節期間,在維多利亞公園舉辦首屆「國際花燈節」,活動由9月17日至27日舉行。活動由香港旅遊發展局以「團圓」為主題舉辦,將沿著「世界花燈大道」匯聚來自二十個國家及地區的花燈,包括南韓晉州的絲綢花燈、巴西的拼布設計,以及波蘭傳統剪紙工藝花燈。活動的焦點裝置——一座八米高、名為「光影之樹」的花燈,取材自香港標誌性的細葉榕。

與花燈節同期舉行的,還有歷史悠久的大坑舞火龍,今年已踏入第147屆,並已列入中國國家級非物質文化遺產名錄。9月24日至26日,一條長67米的火龍,被約一萬二千支燃點中的香枝照亮,將穿梭大坑的狹窄街巷,吸引居民與遊客共同觀賞。普遍認為,在不少年輕一代日益與傳統習俗脫節之際,這類傳統為人們提供了難得的窗口,讓人了解本地文化根源。

與保良局合作設立的特色月餅攤檔,亦會於9月17日至20日展示各地月餅,種類涵蓋上海蘇式酥餅以至雲南火腿口味。然而,部分文化遺產倡議者警告,將歷時數百年的習俗與大規模旅遊推廣結合,或有沖淡其原意的風險。同樣地,主辦方則堅持,加入國際元素有助為本地文化遺產注入新活力,吸引遊客及新一代香港學生,並鼓勵他們將中秋節等節日視為活態、不斷演變的傳統,而非過去靜態的遺物。

cover_text.en: Hong Kong hosts its first international lantern festival this Mid-Autumn.

articles.headline: Kai Tak Stadium Cements Hong Kong's Status as Asia's Live Music Hub
articles.summary_html:
Kai Tak Stadium, which opened in 2025, has rapidly cemented its statusto firmly establish a position or reputation鞏固其地位 as one of Asia's premier live-event destinations, hosting a string of major concerts by international K-pop acts. SEVENTEEN recently delighted fans with a high-energy performance at the venue, while Stray Kids are set to follow with a stadium show on 5 December. Industry observers say the arena's capacity and transport linksconnections between different modes of transportation交通連接 have made Hong Kong an increasingly attractive stop for touring acts, even amid competition from Bangkok, Singapore and Macau.

Locally, Cantopop continues to hold its own. The Hong Kong Jockey Club's new racing season kicked off on 6 September with a live performance by Cantopop veteran Aaron Kwok, who debuted the club's official theme song "Go Go Go" on stage after the track had already racked upto accumulate or achieve a large amount of something累積 more than 22.7 million views online. Meanwhile, the Hong Kong Pop Culture Festival 2026, themed "Beyond Fantasy", continues to showcaseto display or exhibit prominently展示 how local creativity intersects with wider entertainment trends.

It is widely argued that this dual boom, international K-pop stadium tours alongside a resilient homegrown Cantopop scene, reflects Hong Kong's efforts to reposition itself as a regional entertainment hub following years of pandemic disruption. Critics contend that heavy reliance on imported acts could gradually overshadowto make something seem less important by comparison使……相形失色 local artists' visibility, particularly among younger audiences drawn to global fandoms. Nevertheless, boy bands such as Mirror have shown that homegrown talent can still commandto attract and hold, especially in reference to attention or loyalty贏得 fierce loyalty. By the same token, concert organisers argue that a vibrant mix of local and international acts ultimately benefits everyone, giving Hong Kong audiences unprecedented access tothe opportunity or right to use or see something接觸……的機會 world-class entertainment on their own doorstep.

啟德體育園於2025年開幕,迅速鞏固其地位,成為亞洲首屈一指的大型活動場地之一,接連舉辦多場國際K-pop巨星演唱會。SEVENTEEN早前在場內帶來精彩絕倫的演出,令粉絲雀躍不已,而Stray Kids亦將於12月5日舉行體育館演唱會。業界人士指出,場館的容納人數及交通連接,令香港在曼谷、新加坡及澳門的激烈競爭下,仍日益成為巡迴演出的熱門之選。

本地粵語流行曲方面,仍然保持一定地位。香港賽馬會新賽季於9月6日揭幕,粵語流行曲資深歌手郭富城現場演出,並在台上首次演唱馬會主題曲《Go Go Go》,該曲網上點擊率早已累積超過2270萬次。同時,以「超越幻想」為主題的「香港流行文化節2026」,繼續展示本地創意如何與更廣泛的娛樂潮流互相交融。

普遍認為,國際K-pop體育館巡演與本地粵語流行曲的韌力並存,這種雙重熱潮反映香港在經歷多年疫情衝擊後,致力重新定位為區域娛樂樞紐。批評者認為,過度依賴外來演出或會逐漸使本地藝人的曝光度相形失色,尤其是在被全球粉絲文化吸引的年輕觀眾群中。然而,Mirror等本地男團已證明,本地培育的人才仍能贏得忠實擁躉的熱烈支持。同樣地,演唱會主辦方認為,本地與國際演出的多元組合最終對各方均有利,讓香港觀眾能在家門口接觸到世界級娛樂。

articles.headline: Save the Children Hong Kong Launches "Every Moment Matters" Mental Health Campaign
articles.summary_html:
Save the Children Hong Kong has launched "Every Moment Matters", a new public awareness campaign focused on children's mental health. The campaign brings togetherto unite different people or elements for a shared purpose匯聚 Children's Mental Wellness Ambassador Snow Suen alongside celebrities 6 Wing, Tracy Chu and Karen Cheng, who appear in a series of back-to-school "cheer-up" videos aimed at raising awareness ofto increase public knowledge or concern about an issue提高對……的關注 emotional wellbeing among young children.

As part of the initiative, the celebrities, several of whom are parents themselves, open up aboutto speak honestly and freely about a personal topic坦誠談及 their own parenting experiences, encouraging adults across the community to pay closer attention to children's emotional needspsychological requirements related to feelings and wellbeing情緒需要 during periods of change, adjustment and growth, such as the start of a new school year. The campaign's first phase centres on helping adults recognise the signsto be able to identify early indicators of a problem識別徵兆 of distress, reminding parents and teachers that a child's struggles are not always immediately visible.

It is widely argued that youth mental health has become an increasingly urgent concern in Hong Kong, with academic pressure and social media often cited asreferred to or mentioned as an example or reason被引述為 contributing factors. Later phases of the campaign will encourage adults to create safe spacesto establish environments where people feel comfortable expressing themselves營造安全的空間 for children to express themselves, under the slogan "smallest knock, biggest talk". Nevertheless, some child psychologists caution that celebrity-led campaigns, however well-intentionedhaving good intentions, even if the outcome is imperfect出於好意的, cannot replace sustained investment in school counselling services and family support. By the same token, campaign organisers argue that public figures can play a valuable role in destigmatisingto remove the shame or negative judgement associated with a topic消除……的污名化 conversations about mental health, making it easier for ordinary families to start difficult conversations at home.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港救助兒童會推出全新公眾宣傳活動「有你,刻刻同行」,聚焦兒童精神健康議題。活動匯聚兒童精神健康大使孫慧雪,以及藝人6號Wing、朱千雪及鄭融,一同拍攝一系列開學「打氣」短片,旨在提高公眾對幼童情緒健康的關注。

作為活動的一部分,多位本身亦是家長的藝人坦誠談及自己的育兒經驗,鼓勵社會各界人士在孩子面對轉變、適應及成長的時期——例如開學季——更加留意子女的情緒需要。活動首階段的重點,是協助成年人識別孩子情緒困擾的徵兆,提醒家長及老師,孩子的困難未必總是顯而易見。

普遍認為,青少年精神健康已成為本港日益迫切的議題,學業壓力及社交媒體往往被引述為促成因素。活動後續階段將鼓勵成年人為孩子營造安全的空間去表達自己,口號是「小敲門,大對話」。然而,部分兒童心理學家提醒,名人主導的宣傳活動無論多麼出於好意,都不能取代學校輔導服務及家庭支援方面的持續投放資源。同樣地,活動主辦方認為,公眾人物可發揮寶貴作用,協助消除精神健康議題的污名化,讓普通家庭更容易在家中展開艱難的對話。

cover_text.en: New campaign urges adults to notice children's emotional distress early.

articles.headline: Buildings Department Launches 259 Prosecutions Over Wang Fuk Court Fire, Nine Months After Deadly Blaze
articles.summary_html:
Nine months after a fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po claimed 168 lives in one of Hong Kong's deadliest disasters in decades, the Buildings Department has launchedto formally begin a legal or official process展開 259 prosecutions against two companies and four individuals believed to have overseen the estate's renovation works. The defendants include the project's consulting firm and its main contractor, along with a director, a registered inspector and two further company executives. It is widely argued that the sheer scale of the charges underscoresto emphasise or draw attention to the importance of something強調 how systemic the alleged failings were, rather than the result of a single oversight.

The charges relate to the alleged use of substandard materialsmaterials that fail to meet required safety or quality standards不合規格物料 in breach of the Buildings Ordinance, as well as a failure to adequately superviseto oversee work properly and with sufficient care充分監督 the repair works being carried out. Critics contend that such lapses should have been flaggedto bring a problem to someone's attention提出警示 long before the fire broke out, given that renovation scaffolding and netting are believed to have acceleratedto make something happen faster加速 the spread of the flames across seven of the estate's eight blocks. Nevertheless, officials maintain that the prosecutions send a clear signal that accountabilitythe state of being responsible for one's actions and answerable for them問責 will be pursued regardless of how long an investigation takes.

By the same token, bereaved families and residents' groups have called for the process to culminate into reach a final result or conclusion after a series of events以……告終 meaningful reform of how renovation contracts are awarded and supervised across Hong Kong's ageing public housing stock, rather than stopping short ofto fail to go as far as something, often disappointingly未能達到 genuine institutional change. Whether the case eventually leads to convictions or not, it has already prompted wider scrutiny of building safety enforcement, and many argue that only a root-and-branch reviewa thorough examination that addresses every part of a system全面檢討 of inspection regimes can restore public confidence.

The government has pledged to strengthen its enforcement regime for renovation projects citywide.
