articles.summary_zh_html:
大埔宏福苑大火造成168人死亡,是香港數十年來最嚴重的災難之一,事發九個月後,屋宇署已就苑內翻新工程,向兩間公司及四名個人展開259項檢控。被告包括該工程的顧問公司及主要承建商,以及一名董事、一名註冊檢驗人員及另外兩名公司行政人員。普遍認為,檢控數目之龐大強調了所指控的失誤屬系統性問題,而非單一疏忽所致。

控罪涉及被指違反《建築物條例》使用不合規格物料,以及未能充分監督正在進行的維修工程。批評者認為,有關疏漏早於火警發生前便應該被提出警示,因為翻新工程所用的棚架及防護網,被認為加速火勢蔓延至苑內八座大廈中的七座。然而,官方堅稱,檢控清楚顯示,無論調查需時多久,都會追究問責。

同樣地,喪親家屬及居民組織要求,整個程序最終應促成本港老化公營房屋翻新工程招標及監督方式的實質改革,而非未能達到真正的制度改革。無論最終是否有人被判有罪,事件已引發社會對建築安全執法的廣泛關注,不少人認為,唯有對驗樓制度進行全面檢討,才能重建公眾信心。

cover_text.en: Buildings Department charges six over deadly Wang Fuk Court fire.

articles.headline: Nearly 40% of Hong Kong's Elderly Face Medium to Extreme Heat Risk, Greenpeace Study Finds
articles.summary_html:
A new Greenpeace study has found that nearly 40 per cent of Hong Kong's elderly population live in districts facing medium to extreme heat risk, following a summer in which the mercury reached a record 39.8 degrees Celsius in Sheung Shui. Researchers assessedto evaluate or judge the nature of something評估 each district according to day and night temperatures, the concentration of senior citizens, and household income, before identifying Kwun Tong, Kwai Tsing, Tuen Mun and Wong Tai Sin as the four highest-risk areas.

It is widely argued that these districts are especially vulnerableeasily harmed or badly affected by something脆弱；易受傷害 because they combine older buildings with a high number of low-income elderly residents, some of whom live alone with limited access to air conditioning. The report notes that each of these districts has only a single heat shelter, and that such facilities are often located far from where vulnerable residents actually live, while also lackingto not have something that is needed缺乏 sufficient outdoor green space to help cool the surrounding area. By contrast, neighbourhoods with more greenery and country parks, such as Shek O and Pok Fu Lam, were found to pose comparatively low risk.

Greenpeace has called on the government to expandto make something larger in size, number or importance擴展 the network of community cooling centres, increase greenery coverage, and provide a hot weather allowance for low-income residents. Critics contend that current measures remain reactive rather than preventiveresponding after a problem occurs instead of acting to stop it beforehand被動應對而非防患未然, and that without structural change, vulnerable elderly residents will continue to bear the brunt of rising temperatures each summer. Nevertheless, officials point to existing heat shelter schemes as evidence that support is already in place. By the same token, environmental groups argue that isolated shelters cannot substitute for long-term urban planning that mitigatesto make a problem or its effects less severe緩解 the underlying causes of urban heat.

vocab.sample: Districts with older housing stock face a disproportionately high extreme heat risk.
At-risk residents in older districts face far greater exposure during heatwaves.
Dense, concrete-heavy districts often experience a more intense urban heat island effect.
The government has been urged to open more cooling centres within walking distance of the elderly.
Increasing green coverage can help lower surface temperatures in built-up neighbourhoods.
Cases of heat-related illness among the elderly tend to spike during record-breaking summers.
This year's record-breaking temperature has renewed calls for better heat protection policies.
Low-income residents are less likely to have reliable access to air conditioning at home.
Officials say long-term heat adaptation requires more than emergency shelters.
The study highlights a structural inequality in how heat risk is distributed across the city.
Campaigners want a hot weather allowance introduced to help residents cover electricity costs.
Urban planners are exploring ventilation corridors as a way to improve airflow in dense districts.

phrases.en: map risk along the fault lines of poverty
phrases.zh: 按貧窮的斷層劃分風險
phrases.sample: The study maps heat risk along the fault lines of income and housing quality.

phrases.en: turn up the heat on policymakers
phrases.zh: 向決策者施壓
phrases.sample: Campaigners hope the findings will turn up the heat on policymakers to act faster.

phrases.en: leave the most exposed with the least protection
phrases.zh: 令最脆弱的人得到最少的保護
phrases.sample: Older, low-income districts leave the most exposed residents with the least protection.

phrases.en: paper over a deeper design flaw
phrases.zh: 掩蓋更深層的設計缺陷
phrases.sample: A single shelter per district risks papering over a deeper flaw in urban planning.

phrases.en: cool a city built to trap heat
phrases.zh: 為一個易積熱的城市降溫
phrases.sample: Planners face the challenge of cooling a city built largely to trap heat.

phrases.en: spread relief beyond a single shelter
phrases.zh: 將紓緩措施擴展至單一中心以外
phrases.sample: Greenpeace wants relief to spread beyond a single shelter per district.

phrases.en: treat heat as a public health emergency
phrases.zh: 將酷熱視為公共衛生緊急事故
phrases.sample: Advocates argue officials should treat extreme heat as a public health emergency.

phrases.en: widen the green divide between districts
phrases.zh: 擴大地區之間的綠化差距
phrases.sample: A lack of greenery widens the divide between cooler and hotter neighbourhoods.

phrases.en: leave structural causes untouched
phrases.zh: 未觸及結構性成因
phrases.sample: Short-term relief measures leave the structural causes of urban heat largely untouched.

phrases.en: buy time rather than solve the problem
phrases.zh: 只是爭取時間而非解決問題
phrases.sample: Officials admit existing shelters may only buy time rather than solve the problem.

phrases.en: redesign neighbourhoods to beat the heat
phrases.zh: 重新設計社區以應對酷熱
phrases.sample: Long-term planning is needed to redesign ageing neighbourhoods to beat the heat.

phrases.en: shoulder a disproportionate share of the risk
phrases.zh: 承受不成比例的風險
phrases.sample: Low-income elderly residents continue to shoulder a disproportionate share of the risk.

articles.summary_zh_html:
綠色和平一項最新研究發現,香港近四成長者居住在面臨中度至極端酷熱風險的地區,此前的夏季,上水氣溫更創下39.8度的歷史新高。研究人員根據日夜溫度、長者人口密度及住戶收入評估各區情況,結果顯示觀塘、葵青、屯門及黃大仙為風險最高的四個地區。

普遍認為,這些地區特別脆弱,因為樓齡偏高的舊式建築與大量低收入長者居民並存,部分長者獨居,使用冷氣的機會亦有限。報告指出,這些地區各自只有一個納涼中心,而這些設施往往遠離脆弱居民的實際居所,同時亦缺乏足夠的戶外綠化空間以助降溫。相比之下,綠化較多及鄰近郊野公園的地區,例如石澳及薄扶林,風險相對較低。

綠色和平呼籲政府擴展社區納涼中心網絡,增加綠化覆蓋率,並為低收入居民提供酷熱津貼。批評者認為,現行措施仍然被動應對而非防患未然,若無結構性改變,脆弱長者每年夏天仍將首當其衝承受氣溫上升的影響。然而,官員指現有的納涼中心計劃已證明支援措施早已到位。同樣地,環保團體認為,孤立的納涼中心不能取代長遠的城市規劃,後者才能緩解都市酷熱的根本成因。

cover_text.en: Nearly 40% of elderly residents face serious heat risk.

articles.headline: Suicide Rate Among Children Under 15 Tripled Last Year, HKU Researchers Urge Schools and Media to Do Better
articles.summary_html:
Researchers at the Hong Kong Jockey Club Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention at the University of Hong Kong have revealed that the suicide rate among children under 15 tripled last year, even as the city's overall suicide rate edged downto decrease slightly微跌 from 13.8 to 13 per 100,000 residents. The centre found that most of the young students who died by suicide had been struggling with academic pressurestress caused by schoolwork, exams or the pursuit of good grades學業壓力 or difficulties with peers, and that the great majority of suicide notes and expressions of suicidal ideation were left in digital form.

It is widely argued that this trend lays bareto reveal something clearly, especially something troubling揭露 how early emotional distress can take root among Hong Kong's youngest students, well before the pressures typically associated with public examinations. Researchers have urged schools to strengthento make something more robust or effective加強 mental health awareness from an earlier age, and have called on media outlets to report on such cases more responsiblyin a careful and considerate manner that avoids causing harm負責任地, in line with established guidelines that discourage sensationalised coverage of suicide.

Critics contend that schools remain ill-equippedlacking the necessary skills, resources or training裝備不足 to identify early warning signs, particularly when they are expressed only through private messages or social media rather than face-to-face. Nevertheless, education officials maintain that counselling resources have expanded significantly in recent years. By the same token, mental health advocates argue that resourcing alone is not enough unless teachers and parents are also trained to recogniseto identify or notice something, especially something significant識別 digital signs of distress. The findings have reignited debate over how families, schools and social media platforms should share responsibility for safeguarding young people's mental wellbeing.

vocab.sample: Schools are being urged to build mental health awareness into the curriculum from an early age.
Exam-related stress is often cited as a factor, even among very young students.
Researchers found that most expressions of suicidal ideation appeared in digital messages.
Teachers are being trained to spot early warning signs of emotional distress in students.
Difficult peer relationships were identified as a major factor behind the students' distress.
Media guidelines call for responsible reporting that avoids sensationalising suicide cases.
Education officials say counselling resources in schools have expanded in recent years.
Parents are often unaware of digital distress signals shared only among a student's peers.
Schools, families and platforms must share responsibility to safeguard students' wellbeing.
Identifying an at-risk student early can make a critical difference in prevention.
Building emotional resilience from a young age is seen as key to long-term prevention.
Studies consistently show low help-seeking behaviour among distressed young students.

phrases.en: surface long before exam pressure sets in
phrases.zh: 早於考試壓力出現前已浮現
phrases.sample: Researchers say emotional distress can surface long before exam pressure typically sets in.

phrases.en: slip past the usual warning signs
phrases.zh: 避過慣常的警號
phrases.sample: Digital-only cries for help can slip past the warning signs adults are trained to spot.

phrases.en: demand a rethink of how risk is spotted
phrases.zh: 要求重新思考如何察覺風險
phrases.sample: The findings demand a rethink of how schools spot risk among the very young.

phrases.en: move the conversation earlier
phrases.zh: 將相關討論提前展開
phrases.sample: Experts want schools to move the conversation about mental health earlier, before secondary school.

phrases.en: report with care rather than sensation
phrases.zh: 以謹慎而非渲染的方式報導
phrases.sample: Guidelines urge outlets to report such cases with care rather than sensation.

phrases.en: leave teachers guessing at hidden distress
phrases.zh: 令教師難以察覺隱藏的困擾
phrases.sample: Signs expressed only online can leave teachers guessing at a student's hidden distress.

phrases.en: widen the net of who gets noticed
phrases.zh: 擴闊被察覺到的學生範圍
phrases.sample: Training programmes aim to widen the net of which struggling students actually get noticed.

phrases.en: outgrow the resources meant to support them
phrases.zh: 超出原有資源所能應付的範圍
phrases.sample: Demand for counselling has outgrown the resources schools currently have in place.

phrases.en: close the gap between policy and the classroom
phrases.zh: 縮窄政策與課室之間的差距
phrases.sample: Advocates say more funding alone cannot close the gap between policy and classroom reality.

phrases.en: catch distress before it becomes a crisis
phrases.zh: 在困擾演變成危機前及早察覺
phrases.sample: Early training is meant to help adults catch distress before it becomes a crisis.

phrases.en: shift the burden onto overstretched teachers
phrases.zh: 將重擔轉移至已不勝負荷的教師身上
phrases.sample: Critics warn new expectations risk shifting the burden onto already overstretched teachers.

phrases.en: demand a shared watch over young lives
phrases.zh: 要求共同守護年輕的生命
phrases.sample: The findings demand a shared watch over young lives among families, schools and platforms.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港大學香港賽馬會防止自殺研究中心的研究人員披露,去年15歲以下兒童的自殺率較前一年上升三倍,而全港整體自殺率則由每十萬人13.8人微跌至13人。研究中心發現,大部分死於自殺的年輕學生,生前均受學業壓力或與同儕關係困擾所苦,而絕大部分遺書及自殺意念的表達,均以數碼形式留下。

普遍認為,這一趨勢揭露了情緒困擾可以早於公開考試所帶來的壓力之前,已在香港最年幼的學生當中紮根。研究人員促請學校從更年幼的階段開始加強精神健康意識,亦呼籲傳媒機構按照不鼓勵渲染自殺報導的既定指引,更負責任地報導同類事件。

批評者認為,學校仍然裝備不足,難以識別早期警號,尤其是當這些訊號只透過私訊或社交媒體表達,而非面對面交流時。然而,教育官員堅稱,近年輔導資源已大幅增加。同樣地,精神健康倡議者認為,除非教師及家長同樣接受培訓,學會識別數碼形式的求助訊號,否則單靠資源投放並不足夠。這項研究結果,重新引發社會對家庭、學校及社交媒體平台應如何共同承擔保障青少年精神健康責任的爭論。

cover_text.en: Child suicide rate triples, researchers urge schools to act.

articles.headline: ReThink HK 2026 Opens at HKCEC, Uniting 10,000+ Global Leaders to Accelerate Climate Action
articles.summary_html:
ReThink HK 2026, now in its seventh edition, opened its two-day run at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre on Thursday, conveningto bring people together for a formal meeting or event召集 more than 10,000 attendees, 500 speakers and 350 sustainability solution providers from around the world. Miss Diane Wong, Under Secretary for Environment and Ecology, opened the event by outlining Hong Kong's latest climate priorities, while overseas pavilions from Austria, France, Spain, Japan and Sweden underscored the event's international scopethe range or extent of something across different countries國際規模.

This year's programme was restructured around five thematic zones — Cities, Energy, Impact, Innovation and Resources — reflecting an attempt to translateto convert something from one form into another, more practical form轉化 broad climate commitments into concrete, operational results. It is widely argued that Hong Kong is well placed to serve as a regional hub for such discussions, given its position as a financial centre with close links to both mainland China and international markets. Sessions at the Innovation Zone showcased AI-driven sustainability tools and university spin-outs, while the Resources Zone focused on circular economy solutions across Asia's manufacturing and supply chains.

Nevertheless, sceptics contend that large sustainability conferences can risk becoming exercises in rhetoricactivities focused on fine words rather than concrete action流於空談 unless commitments made on stage are matched by measurable follow-through. By the same token, organisers argue that the event's restructured format—placing a greater emphasis onspecial importance or attention given to something著重於 implementation rather than ambition alone—is a direct response to that criticism. As regulatory pressure on companies to disclose climate impact intensifies globally, many argue that platforms like ReThink HK will only grow in importance as venues where businesses, governments and NGOs can coordinateto organise different elements so that they work together effectively協調 their next steps.

vocab.sample: The conference brought together experts from across Asia to discuss sustainable development.
The summit's convening power drew more than ten thousand participants this year.
The Resources Zone highlighted circular economy solutions for reducing industrial waste.
Many companies at the summit outlined roadmaps towards carbon neutrality by 2050.
Organisers stressed that cross-sector collaboration is essential to meaningful climate progress.
Regulatory pressure on companies to disclose emissions has intensified worldwide.
Delegates discussed how to close the implementation gap between pledges and action.
Businesses were urged to convert climate pledges into measurable operational results.
Green finance was a central theme across several panels at the summit.
International cooperation between governments and businesses remains vital to climate action.
Manufacturers discussed how to make their supply chains more resource-efficient.
Officials reiterated their policy commitment to reducing the city's carbon footprint.

phrases.en: move from pledges to proof
phrases.zh: 由承諾走向實證
phrases.sample: Organisers say this year's summit is about moving from pledges to proof.

phrases.en: convert ambition into a working plan
phrases.zh: 將願景轉化為可行計劃
phrases.sample: The new thematic zones are designed to convert ambition into a working plan.

phrases.en: put sustainability talk under scrutiny
phrases.zh: 令可持續發展的言論受到檢視
phrases.sample: Sceptics say large conferences should put their own sustainability talk under scrutiny.

phrases.en: anchor climate goals to measurable steps
phrases.zh: 將氣候目標與可衡量的步驟相連
phrases.sample: This year's format tries to anchor broad climate goals to measurable steps.

phrases.en: draw together voices from government, business and civil society
phrases.zh: 匯聚政府、商界及公民社會的聲音
phrases.sample: The summit draws together voices from government, business and civil society on one stage.

phrases.en: position itself as a bridge between markets
phrases.zh: 將自己定位為市場之間的橋樑
phrases.sample: Hong Kong is positioning itself as a bridge between mainland and international climate markets.

phrases.en: answer scepticism with concrete outcomes
phrases.zh: 以具體成果回應質疑
phrases.sample: Organisers hope to answer scepticism with concrete, trackable outcomes this year.

phrases.en: turn a conference into a working venue for deals
phrases.zh: 將會議變成促成合作的場所
phrases.sample: The event aims to turn a conference into a working venue for cross-sector deals.

phrases.en: feel the weight of mounting disclosure rules
phrases.zh: 感受到日增的披露規定帶來的壓力
phrases.sample: Companies increasingly feel the weight of mounting climate disclosure rules.

phrases.en: give substance to lofty pledges
phrases.zh: 為宏大的承諾注入實質內容
phrases.sample: This year's agenda is designed to give substance to otherwise lofty pledges.

phrases.en: serve as a proving ground for new ideas
phrases.zh: 成為新構思的試驗場
phrases.sample: The Innovation Zone serves as a proving ground for AI-driven sustainability tools.

phrases.en: keep talk tethered to timelines
phrases.zh: 令討論緊扣具體時間表
phrases.sample: Delegates were urged to keep their talk tethered to concrete timelines.

articles.summary_zh_html:
「ReThink HK 2026」已踏入第七屆,本週四於香港會議展覽中心展開兩日活動,召集來自世界各地逾一萬名參加者、五百位講者及三百五十家可持續發展方案供應商。環境及生態局副局長黃淑嫻在開幕致辭中,概述香港最新的氣候政策重點,而來自奧地利、法國、西班牙、日本及瑞典的海外展館,則凸顯了活動的國際規模。

今年的活動重新規劃為五個主題展區——城市、能源、影響力、創新及資源——反映主辦方嘗試將廣泛的氣候承諾轉化為具體、可操作的成果。普遍認為,憑藉作為金融中心、與內地及國際市場關係緊密的地位,香港具備優勢成為此類討論的區域樞紐。創新展區的多個環節展示人工智能驅動的可持續方案及大學初創項目,資源展區則聚焦亞洲製造業及供應鏈的循環經濟方案。

然而,懷疑論者認為,大型可持續發展會議若未能將台上承諾轉化為可衡量的落實成果,便有淪為流於空談的風險。同樣地,主辦方認為,今年活動重新編排,更著重於落實執行而非單純談論願景,正是對上述批評的直接回應。隨著全球企業披露氣候影響的監管壓力日益加劇,不少人認為,像ReThink HK這樣的平台將變得愈發重要,成為企業、政府及非政府組織協調下一步行動的場所。

cover_text.zh_sub: 各界共商落實氣候行動
cover_text.en: ReThink HK 2026 gathers global leaders to accelerate climate action.

articles.headline: Hong Kong Tech Chief Warns AI Will Unleash 'Greatest Industrial Revolution'
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry, Sun Dong, has issued a stark warningto give an unusually serious warning about something發出嚴厲警告 that artificial intelligence will trigger a transformation exceeding all previous industrial revolutions. Speaking at the third GTI Forum on Digital Intelligence held in Hong Kong, Mr Sun told the South China Morning Post that "the impact of this AI wave on Hong Kong and its entire society will, I believe, exceed all previous industrial revolutions." It is widely argued that such remarks, coming from the city's top technology official, underscoreto emphasise or draw attention to the importance of something強調 the scale of disruption authorities now anticipate across every sector of the economy.

By the same token, the government insists it is not standing idle. Hong Kong has already rolled outto introduce a new product, scheme or policy officially推出 a HK$50 million universal AI education programme, established an AI supercomputing centre, and launched a HK$3 billion funding scheme intended to nurture homegrown large language models. Science Park and Cyberport now host more than 800 AI-related companies, a clustering effectthe tendency of similar businesses or activities to gather in one location聚集效應 officials say will accelerate commercialisation and attract further overseas investment.

Nevertheless, critics contend that training initiatives remain grossly insufficientseriously inadequate in scale or amount嚴重不足 given the pace of change, with some reports suggesting reskilling schemes currently reach barely one percent of the workforce. Mr Sun himself conceded that certain traditional sectors will "gradually decline," which he described as an inevitable outcomea result that cannot be avoided必然結果 of technological progress, even as new opportunities emerge elsewhere. For students weighing future careers, the debate poses a pressing questionto present an issue that urgently needs to be addressed提出迫切問題: how should Hong Kong prepare its next generation of workers for a labour market being reshaped faster than policy can keep pace?

vocab.sample: Artificial intelligence is now being deployed across almost every sector of Hong Kong's economy.
Officials have compared the current wave of automation to a fourth industrial revolution.
The funding scheme hopes to multiply the number of homegrown AI spin-off companies.
Critics argue that workforce reskilling programmes have expanded far too slowly.
Hong Kong is investing heavily in developing its own large language models.
The new supercomputing centre will support AI research across local universities.
Workers in traditional sectors fear being left behind as automation accelerates.
Critics say the reskilling gap is widening even as AI adoption accelerates.
The government's funding scheme has attracted applications from hundreds of start-ups.
Officials hope homegrown technology will reduce reliance on foreign AI providers.
Economists warn that the labour market is being reshaped faster than policy can respond.
Cyberport's growing AI cluster has begun to attract significant overseas investment.

phrases.en: brace the workforce for sweeping change
phrases.zh: 為勞動力迎接全面變革作好準備
phrases.sample: Officials say new funding schemes aim to brace the workforce for sweeping change.

phrases.en: outstrip every previous wave of automation
phrases.zh: 超越以往每一波自動化浪潮
phrases.sample: Mr Sun warned that this AI wave will outstrip every previous wave of automation.

phrases.en: concede that some jobs will not survive
phrases.zh: 承認部分職位將無法保存
phrases.sample: Officials have begun to concede that some traditional jobs will simply not survive.

phrases.en: pour money into a race it cannot afford to lose
phrases.zh: 投入資金應對一場不容有失的競賽
phrases.sample: Hong Kong is pouring money into an AI race it cannot afford to lose.

phrases.en: build a cluster from scratch
phrases.zh: 從零建立產業聚群
phrases.sample: Science Park and Cyberport are trying to build an AI cluster from scratch.

phrases.en: leave retraining trailing far behind
phrases.zh: 令再培訓遠遠落後
phrases.sample: Critics say retraining schemes are leaving workers far behind the pace of automation.

phrases.en: reach only a sliver of the workforce
phrases.zh: 僅觸及勞動力的一小部分
phrases.sample: Current reskilling programmes reach only a sliver of the city's workforce.

phrases.en: treat disruption as a given rather than a choice
phrases.zh: 將衝擊視為既定事實而非選擇
phrases.sample: Officials now treat AI-driven disruption as a given rather than a choice to be debated.

phrases.en: force a rethink of what counts as a stable career
phrases.zh: 迫使人們重新思考何謂穩定的職業
phrases.sample: The AI wave is forcing students to rethink what counts as a stable career.

phrases.en: race to attract capital before rivals do
phrases.zh: 搶先於對手吸納資金
phrases.sample: The funding scheme is designed to attract capital before rival cities do.

phrases.en: widen the distance between policy and reality
phrases.zh: 拉闊政策與現實之間的距離
phrases.sample: Critics warn that slow retraining widens the distance between policy and reality.

phrases.en: demand that education catch up with disruption
phrases.zh: 要求教育追上變革的步伐
phrases.sample: The warning demands that education policy catch up with the pace of disruption.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港創新科技及工業局局長孫東發出嚴厲警告,指人工智能將引發一場超越以往所有工業革命的變革。孫東在香港舉行的第三屆數字智能化發展論壇上向《南華早報》表示:「我相信,這次人工智能浪潮對香港及整個社會的影響,將超越以往所有工業革命。」普遍認為,出自本港最高科技官員之口的這番言論,強調了當局現時預期衝擊將波及經濟各行各業的規模。

同樣地,政府堅稱並非坐視不理。香港已推出五千萬港元的全民人工智能教育計劃,設立人工智能超算中心,並推出三十億港元的資助計劃,旨在培育本地研發的大型語言模型。科學園及數碼港現時合共有逾八百家人工智能相關企業進駐,官員表示,這種聚集效應將加速商業化進程,並吸引更多海外投資。

然而,批評者認為,相對於變化的速度,現時的培訓措施仍然嚴重不足,有報告顯示,再培訓計劃目前覆蓋的勞動力比例不足百分之一。孫東本人亦承認,部分傳統行業將會「逐漸式微」,他形容這是科技進步的必然結果,即使新機遇正於其他領域湧現。對於正考慮未來職業路向的學生而言,這場辯論提出了迫切問題:香港應如何為下一代勞動力作好準備,應對一個變化速度已超越政策步伐的勞動市場?

cover_text.zh_sub: 局長警告衝擊超工業革命
cover_text.en: Hong Kong's tech chief warns AI will reshape every industry.

articles.headline: HKTB to Host First International Lantern Event This Mid-Autumn
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong is preparing its most ambitious Mid-Autumn Festival celebration to date, according to a report in The Standard. The Hong Kong Tourism Board will stage the city's first-ever International Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park from 17 to 27 September, under the theme "Reunion". More than 3,000 lanterns from twenty countries and regions will line the newly created World Lantern Boulevard, including silk lanterns from Jinju in South Korea, patchwork designs from Brazil, and Polish lanterns made using traditional folk paper-cutting techniques.

It is widely argued that the initiative reflects a deliberate attempt to harnessto control and make use of something for a particular purpose善用；運用 Hong Kong's intangible cultural heritage as a tourism asset, rather than treating tradition and economic development as separate concerns. The centrepiece attraction, an eight-metre lantern named "Shadowlight" inspired by the city's iconic banyan trees, sits at the park's main entrance, its layered gauze panels intended to representto stand for or symbolise something象徵 the tree's growth in three-dimensional form.

By the same token, heritage advocates note that the festivities coincide with the 147th edition of the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance, running from 24 to 26 September. A 67-metre dragon studded withcovered or decorated with many small objects點綴著；鑲滿 roughly 12,000 burning incense sticks will be carried through Tai Hang's narrow streets by generations of local performers, a practice inscribed onofficially recorded or listed as part of an official register列入 China's National List of Intangible Cultural Heritage. Nevertheless, some commentators caution that as such events are increasingly packaged for visitorspresented or marketed in a way designed to appeal to tourists為遊客包裝, organisers must take care not to let commercial appeal come at the expense ofto cause harm or loss to something else in the process以……為代價 the ritual's original spiritual significance — a tension that, arguably, defines the challenge of preserving living heritage in a modern, tourism-driven city.

vocab.sample: Polish folk paper-cutting techniques inspired some of this year's lantern designs.
Large-scale festivals are increasingly used to boost the city's tourism economy.
Layered gauze lantern design gives the centrepiece a three-dimensional glow.
Traditional festivals play a key role in shaping Hong Kong's cultural identity.
Festival organisers must weigh commercial appeal against cultural authenticity.
Some worry that the dragon dance's ritual significance is being overshadowed by spectacle.
The boulevard display stretches across Victoria Park's main thoroughfare.
The lanterns showcase traditional craftsmanship from more than twenty regions.
The lantern display promotes cross-cultural exchange between Hong Kong and its guests.
Heritage preservation groups have welcomed the renewed attention on local traditions.
Officials hope the festival will give the visitor economy a much-needed boost.
Seasonal festivities such as Mid-Autumn remain central to community life in Hong Kong.

phrases.en: repackage tradition for a global audience
phrases.zh: 為全球觀眾重新包裝傳統
phrases.sample: The lantern festival repackages a local tradition for a global audience.

phrases.en: lend a traditional ritual a modern stage
phrases.zh: 為傳統儀式添上現代舞台
phrases.sample: Victoria Park lends the Mid-Autumn ritual a modern, large-scale stage.

phrases.en: trade intimacy for scale
phrases.zh: 以規模換取親密感
phrases.sample: Critics worry that expanding the festival trades intimacy for scale.

phrases.en: lean on heritage to draw visitors
phrases.zh: 依靠文化遺產吸引遊客
phrases.sample: Tourism planners increasingly lean on heritage events to draw visitors in the off-season.

phrases.en: keep a centuries-old practice legible to outsiders
phrases.zh: 令歷時數百年的習俗仍能讓外人看懂
phrases.sample: Explanatory displays help keep the centuries-old dance legible to outsiders.

phrases.en: stretch a local custom across a global stage
phrases.zh: 將本地習俗延伸至國際舞台
phrases.sample: This year's event stretches a local custom across an unusually international stage.

phrases.en: risk flattening a ritual into a photo opportunity
phrases.zh: 有將儀式淪為拍照打卡場景的風險
phrases.sample: Some fear heavy promotion risks flattening the ritual into a mere photo opportunity.

phrases.en: carry a practice forward without hollowing it out
phrases.zh: 延續習俗而不使其流於空洞
phrases.sample: Performers say their challenge is to carry the practice forward without hollowing it out.

phrases.en: dress up an old custom in new spectacle
phrases.zh: 為舊習俗添上新的視覺盛宴
phrases.sample: Giant illuminated lanterns dress up an old custom in new spectacle this year.

phrases.en: let commerce and custom coexist uneasily
phrases.zh: 讓商業與傳統並存但關係緊張
phrases.sample: Large festivals often let commerce and custom coexist somewhat uneasily.

phrases.en: stage heritage for maximum visibility
phrases.zh: 為提高曝光度而展演文化遺產
phrases.sample: Organisers have chosen to stage heritage events for maximum visibility this year.

phrases.en: keep performers' lineage at the centre of the show
phrases.zh: 讓表演者的傳承置於表演核心
phrases.sample: Despite the spectacle, organisers insist on keeping performers' family lineage at the centre of the show.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據《The Standard》報道,香港正籌備歷來規模最大的中秋節慶祝活動。香港旅遊發展局將於9月17日至27日,在維多利亞公園舉辦本港首屆「國際花燈節」,主題為「團圓」。超過三千個來自二十個國家及地區的花燈,將沿新設立的「世界花燈大道」陳列,包括南韓晉州的絲綢花燈、巴西的拼布設計,以及以傳統民間剪紙工藝製成的波蘭花燈。

普遍認為,這項計劃反映當局有意善用香港的非物質文化遺產作為旅遊資產,而非將傳統與經濟發展視為互不相干的兩件事。焦點裝置是一座名為「光影之樹」、靈感源自本港標誌性細葉榕的八米高花燈,設於公園正門入口,其層疊的紗網設計旨在以立體形式象徵大樹的生長過程。

同樣地,文化遺產倡議者指出,慶祝活動恰與第147屆大坑舞火龍同期舉行,活動將於9月24日至26日舉行。一條長67米、點綴著約一萬二千支燃點中的香枝的火龍,將由世代本地表演者抬著穿梭大坑的狹窄街巷,這項習俗已列入中國國家級非物質文化遺產名錄。然而,有評論員提醒,隨著同類活動日益為遊客包裝,主辦方必須小心,不要讓商業吸引力以犧牲儀式原有的精神意義為代價——這種張力,可說正正界定了在現代旅遊主導城市中保存活態文化遺產所面對的挑戰。

cover_text.en: Hong Kong Tourism Board unveils its first international lantern spectacular.

articles.headline: NMIXX Brings First World Tour to Hong Kong's AsiaWorld-Expo
articles.summary_html:
K-pop group NMIXX will bring their first world tour, "Episode 1: Zero Frontier," to Hong Kong on 16 September, with a stop at AsiaWorld-Expo that fan communities describe asto say that something is a particular thing or has a particular quality形容為 one of the most anticipated concerts of the season. The six-member group, known for hits blending sharp choreography with genre-shifting production, joins a lineup of comebacks and releases from CHUNG HA, LISA, JISOO, MONSTA X, LE SSERAFIM and BOYNEXTDOOR that has made September an unusually busy month for the K-pop calendar.

It is widely argued that Hong Kong's continued appeal to Korean entertainment companies stems less from novelty than from infrastructurethe basic physical systems and facilities needed for an activity to function基礎設施: strong venue capacity, convenient transport links and a base of regional fans willing to travel have turned AsiaWorld-Expo into what industry observers now regard as the de facto centrethe centre in practice, even if not officially designated as such事實上的中心 of the city's major K-pop concerts. By the same token, ticket demand for acts with an established international following, such as NMIXX, tends to sell through quicklyto be bought up rapidly until none remain迅速售罄, reinforcing promoters' confidence in returning to the same venue year after year.

Nevertheless, the concert's popularity also speaks to something broader than any single group's fanbase. K-pop's presence in Hong Kong has become so pervasivespreading widely throughout a place or group無處不在 that its tracks now play routinely in restaurants, retail stores and gyms across the city, a sign that the genre has moved well beyond a niche subculture into the mainstream soundtrack of everyday urban life. For many young fans, a live show represents not just entertainment but a chance to participate directly into take an active, hands-on part in something親身參與 a cultural phenomenon they otherwise experience only through a screen.

vocab.sample: NMIXX's world tour will take the group across more than a dozen cities.
The group has built a loyal international fanbase since their debut.
Their genre-shifting sound has helped the group stand out in a crowded market.
The group's box office pull has made Hong Kong a reliable stop on their tour.
AsiaWorld-Expo's large venue capacity makes it ideal for major international tours.
K-pop has firmly entered mainstream culture in cities across Asia.
K-pop's global rise has been described as an unprecedented cultural phenomenon.
What began as a niche subculture has become a dominant force in global pop music.
Promoters continue to invest in Hong Kong because of its strong regional fanbase.
Fans say nothing compares to experiencing a live performance in person.
The Korean entertainment industry has expanded rapidly across Southeast Asia.
Groups with a strong international following can reliably fill large arenas.

phrases.en: ride on the back of regional travel demand
phrases.zh: 乘區域旅遊需求之勢
phrases.sample: Promoters are riding on the back of strong regional travel demand this concert season.

phrases.en: turn a city into a reliable tour stop
phrases.zh: 令一個城市成為可靠的巡演站
phrases.sample: Reliable infrastructure has turned Hong Kong into a reliable tour stop for K-pop acts.

phrases.en: seep into everyday soundscapes
phrases.zh: 滲入日常的聲音景觀
phrases.sample: K-pop has seeped into everyday soundscapes, from gyms to shopping malls.

phrases.en: blur the line between fan and bystander
phrases.zh: 模糊了粉絲與旁觀者的界線
phrases.sample: The genre's visibility has blurred the line between devoted fan and casual bystander.

phrases.en: convert online fandom into ticket sales
phrases.zh: 將網上粉絲熱潮轉化為票房
phrases.sample: Agencies are skilled at converting online fandom into rapid ticket sales.

phrases.en: offer fans a rare in-person payoff
phrases.zh: 為粉絲帶來難得的親身體驗回報
phrases.sample: A live show offers fans a rare in-person payoff after months of following online.

phrases.en: anchor a packed concert season
phrases.zh: 成為繁忙演唱會季的重心
phrases.sample: NMIXX's stop anchors an unusually packed September concert season.

phrases.en: signal confidence in a market's staying power
phrases.zh: 顯示對市場持久力的信心
phrases.sample: Repeated bookings signal promoters' confidence in the market's staying power.

phrases.en: travel far for a few hours on stage
phrases.zh: 長途跋涉只為台上數小時
phrases.sample: Regional fans are willing to travel far for just a few hours on stage.

phrases.en: cross over from niche fandom to mainstream habit
phrases.zh: 由小眾粉絲圈跨越至主流習慣
phrases.sample: The genre has crossed over from niche fandom into a mainstream listening habit.

phrases.en: compress a global following into one night
phrases.zh: 將全球擁躉濃縮於一夜之間
phrases.sample: A single concert compresses a global following into one unforgettable night.

phrases.en: make a venue synonymous with a genre
phrases.zh: 令一個場館與某類型音樂劃上等號
phrases.sample: Repeated bookings have made AsiaWorld-Expo nearly synonymous with K-pop in Hong Kong.

articles.summary_zh_html:
韓國女子組合NMIXX將於9月16日舉行首次世界巡迴演唱會「Episode 1: Zero Frontier」香港站,假亞洲國際博覽館舉行,粉絲群體將其形容為本季最矚目的演唱會之一。這支六人組合以凌厲編舞配合跨曲風製作見稱,與CHUNG HA、LISA、JISOO、MONSTA X、LE SSERAFIM及BOYNEXTDOOR的回歸及新作一同登場,令9月成為K-pop界異常忙碌的一個月。

普遍認為,香港對韓國娛樂公司持續的吸引力,與新鮮感關係不大,反而更多源於基礎設施:場館容納量大、交通便利,加上一群願意長途跋涉的地區粉絲,使亞洲國際博覽館成為業界觀察人士眼中本港主要K-pop演唱會事實上的中心。同樣地,具備國際知名度的組合如NMIXX,門票需求往往迅速售罄,令主辦方更有信心年年選擇同一場館。

然而,這場演唱會的熱潮亦反映出超越單一組合粉絲群的更廣泛現象。K-pop在香港已變得如此無處不在,其歌曲現時在全城餐廳、零售店舖及健身中心日常播放,顯示這個音樂類型已遠遠超越小眾次文化,成為都市日常生活的主流配樂。對許多年輕粉絲而言,現場演出不僅是娛樂,更是一個能親身參與平日只能透過屏幕感受的文化現象的機會。

cover_text.en: NMIXX brings its first world tour to Hong Kong fans.

articles.headline: Hong Kong Embraces Workforce Shift Amid AI Revolution
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's labour market is undergoing what China Daily describes as a fundamental shift, as artificial intelligence adoption accelerates across industries far faster than most employers anticipated. Roughly a quarter of local organisations now report widely deployingto put a resource, system or technology into active use部署 AI in their operations, three times the proportion recorded just a year earlier, while understanding and applying the technology has become, according to surveyed executives, the most crucial skill demanded of employees at every level of seniority.

It is widely argued that this shift carries a double edgehaving both a beneficial and a harmful aspect at the same time雙面刃. Merchandise exports of AI-related electronic products have grown sharply, and hundreds of companies have set up or expanded local operations this year alone, suggesting the technology is fuelling genuine economic momentum. Nevertheless, critics contend that the transition is unevenly distributednot spread equally or fairly across a group分布不均: nearly forty percent of firms remain confined to small-scale pilot projects, while full-time vacancies suitable for university graduates have fallen by roughly sixty percent since 2022, with entry-level administrative roles hit hardest of allaffected most severely compared to others受影響最深.

By the same token, employers appear notably more cautiouscareful to avoid risk or danger謹慎 about future hiring than in previous years, with a larger share now expecting headcount reductions than increases — the weakest outlook in recent memory. For secondary school students weighing their eventual career paths, the implication seems clear: technical literacy in AI is fast becoming a baseline expectationa minimum standard that is assumed or required基本要求 rather than a specialised advantage, and traditional entry routes into the workforce can no longer be taken for granted.

vocab.sample: The report describes a major workforce shift driven by automation.
AI adoption among local firms has tripled within a single year.
Entry-level roles have been hit hardest by recent automation trends.
Several firms have signalled possible headcount reductions next year.
Many companies remain stuck at the pilot project stage of AI adoption.
Technical literacy in AI is increasingly expected of new graduates.
Rising exports have helped sustain the city's economic momentum.
The job market outlook has weakened compared with previous years.
Graduate vacancies suitable for university leavers have fallen sharply.
Employers say closing the skills gap in AI remains a pressing priority.
The automation trend shows little sign of slowing in the near term.
This year's hiring outlook is the weakest recorded in recent years.

phrases.en: cut both ways for workers
phrases.zh: 對打工仔是雙刃劍
phrases.sample: Economists say the AI shift cuts both ways for workers at different skill levels.

phrases.en: squeeze the bottom rung of the career ladder
phrases.zh: 擠壓職業階梯最底層的位置
phrases.sample: Automation appears to be squeezing the bottom rung of the career ladder hardest.

phrases.en: stall at the pilot stage
phrases.zh: 停滯於試點階段
phrases.sample: Many firms admit their AI projects have stalled at the pilot stage.

phrases.en: thin out entry-level opportunities
phrases.zh: 削減初級職位的機會
phrases.sample: Graduates say automation has visibly thinned out entry-level opportunities.

phrases.en: turn caution into a hiring freeze
phrases.zh: 令謹慎態度變成招聘凍結
phrases.sample: For some firms, caution about AI has quietly turned into a hiring freeze.

phrases.en: reward adaptability over tenure
phrases.zh: 重視應變能力多於資歷
phrases.sample: Employers increasingly reward adaptability over simple tenure or seniority.

phrases.en: redraw the entry points into a career
phrases.zh: 重新劃定進入職業的切入點
phrases.sample: AI adoption is redrawing the entry points graduates once relied on.

phrases.en: post stronger numbers on paper than on the ground
phrases.zh: 帳面數字比實際情況亮麗
phrases.sample: Export growth posts stronger numbers on paper than conditions on the ground suggest.

phrases.en: demand fluency rather than familiarity
phrases.zh: 要求熟練運用而非僅止於認識
phrases.sample: Employers now demand fluency with AI tools rather than mere familiarity.

phrases.en: leave fresh graduates competing for fewer rungs
phrases.zh: 令新畢業生爭奪更少的晉升機會
phrases.sample: Shrinking vacancies leave fresh graduates competing for fewer rungs on the ladder.

phrases.en: move the goalposts for what counts as job-ready
phrases.zh: 改變了何謂「具備就業能力」的標準
phrases.sample: Rapid AI adoption is moving the goalposts for what counts as job-ready.

phrases.en: cast a shadow over otherwise upbeat growth figures
phrases.zh: 為原本亮麗的增長數字添上陰影
phrases.sample: Weak hiring plans cast a shadow over otherwise upbeat export growth figures.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港勞動市場正經歷《中國日報》形容為根本性的轉變,人工智能在各行業的應用速度遠超大多數僱主預期。目前約四分之一的本地機構表示正廣泛部署人工智能於日常運作,比率是一年前的三倍;據受訪行政人員指出,理解並應用這項技術,已成為各層級僱員最關鍵的必備技能。

普遍認為,這種轉變帶有雙面刃的性質。與人工智能相關的電子產品出口貨值大幅增長,單是今年已有數百家企業在本港設立或擴展業務,反映這項技術正帶動實質經濟動力。然而,批評者認為,這場轉型分布不均:近四成企業仍停留於小規模試點項目階段,而適合大學畢業生的全職職位空缺,自2022年以來已下跌約六成,當中初級行政職位受影響最深。

同樣地,僱主對未來招聘明顯較以往謹慎,預期裁減人手的比例現已超過預期增聘的比例——是近年最疲弱的前景。對於正在衡量未來職業路向的中學生而言,啟示似乎十分清楚:人工智能的技術素養正迅速成為基本要求,而非專門優勢,而傳統的入職途徑亦再也不能被視為必然。

cover_text.en: AI adoption reshapes Hong Kong's labour market and graduate hiring.

articles.headline: HKU Raises Alarm Over Suicide Rate Among Under-15s, Warns of Social Media Impact
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that Hong Kong is facing a deeply troubling paradoxa situation that seems contradictory but may be true看似矛盾卻可能屬實的情況 in youth mental health. According to new research from the University of Hong Kong's Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention, the city's overall suicide rate declined across nearly all age groups last year. Nevertheless, the rate among children under the age of fifteen climbed to a decade-highthe highest level in ten years十年來最高水平 of 2.9 per 100,000, the worst figure recorded since 2016. This finding runs directly counter to the broader downward trend, and it has prompted researchers to sound the alarm over what appears to be an emerging crisisa serious problem that is only just becoming apparent剛開始浮現的嚴重問題 among the city's youngest residents.

Critics contend that heavy social media use is a significant contributing factorsomething that helps cause a result促成某結果的因素 behind this troubling shift. The centre's researchers found that social media activity was strongly predictive of suicide cases among young people, suggesting that online exposure to harmful content, cyberbullying and unrealistic comparisons may exacerbateto make a problem or situation worse使問題或情況惡化 existing vulnerabilities. By the same token, the timing of a recent spate of suicide attempts, clustered around the start of the new academic year, points to the added weight of examination pressure and the notoriously competitive nature of Hong Kong's schooling system, which is often blamed for placing undue strainan unreasonable or excessive amount of pressure不合理或過度的壓力 on students.

In light of these findings, the centre's founding director has urged schools to give pupils more time and space to build rapport with teachers and classmates, arguing that strong relationships can act as a protective factorsomething that reduces risk or vulnerability能減低風險的因素 against psychological distress. It is widely argued that a purely academic response is insufficient; instead, a holistic approachone that considers the whole person, not just one aspect顧及整體而非單一方面的方法 involving families, educators and platform regulators will be necessary if Hong Kong is to reverse this alarming trajectory and safeguard the wellbeing of its next generation.

vocab.sample: The number of youth mental health cases reached a decade-high this year, alarming researchers and educators alike.
Excessive screen time is believed to be a contributing factor in rising anxiety levels among teenagers.
Strong family support often acts as a protective factor against psychological distress in adolescents.
Unregulated social media use can exacerbate feelings of isolation among vulnerable young people.
Hong Kong's exam-oriented culture is often criticised for placing undue strain on secondary school students.
Experts recommend a holistic approach that combines counselling, family support and school reform.
Public health officials have described the rise in youth suicide as an emerging crisis requiring urgent attention.
Adolescents with limited emotional support may show greater vulnerability to online harms.
Many students report psychological distress during the lead-up to public examinations.
Teachers are encouraged to foster rapport with students to help them feel understood and supported.
Advocates want youth wellbeing policy to involve families, schools and tech platforms together.
Addressing the root cause of youth distress requires cooperation between schools, families and tech companies.

phrases.en: cut against the grain of an otherwise positive trend

articles.summary_zh_html:
據報道,香港在青少年精神健康方面正面對一個令人深感不安的矛盾現象。根據香港大學防止自殺研究中心的最新研究,去年全港整體自殺率在幾乎所有年齡組別均見下降。然而,15歲以下兒童的自殺率卻攀升至每十萬人2.9人的十年新高,是自2016年以來最差的數字。這項發現與整體下降趨勢背道而馳,促使研究人員就本港最年幼居民似乎正面臨的新興危機發出警號。

批評者認為,過度使用社交媒體是造成這一令人憂慮轉變的重要促成因素。研究中心的研究人員發現,社交媒體使用情況能強烈預測青少年的自殺個案,反映接觸網上有害內容、網絡欺凌及不切實際的比較,可能使現有的脆弱性惡化。同樣地,近期一連串自殺企圖集中在新學年開始之際發生,反映考試壓力及香港學制競爭激烈的本質,而後者常被指對學生造成不合理的壓力。

鑑於這些研究結果,研究中心的創辦總監促請學校給予學生更多時間及空間,與老師及同學建立融洽關係,認為緊密的人際關係可作為對抗心理困擾的保護因素。普遍認為,單靠學術層面的回應並不足夠;相反,若香港要扭轉這令人憂慮的趨勢,並保障下一代的福祉,必須採取涉及家庭、教育工作者及平台監管機構的全面方法。

cover_text.en: HKU researchers link social media use to rising child suicide.

articles.headline: China Teen's Hong Kong Concert Trip Costs Family Government Subsidies, Sparking Mixed Reaction
articles.summary_html:
A seemingly minor decision by a teenager in mainland China has sparked a nationwide debate over welfare policy, consumer culture and family responsibility, after it emerged that her trip to Hong Kong for a concert cost her family their government living allowance. The girl, a technical secondary school student from Ganzhou in Jiangxi province, reportedly told her family that she could financeto provide money for something為某事提供資金 the trip independently. However, local authorities subsequently classified the outing as a form of high-end consumptionspending on non-essential or luxury items非必要或奢侈品的消費, deeming it incompatible with the household's continued eligibility for a subsidy scheme intended for low-income families.

The case has since gone viral, dividing public opinion online. On one hand, some commentators argue that the policy is a reasonable safeguard, contending that public funds should be reserved strictly for essential needs rather than discretionary entertainment. On the other hand, many netizens have voiced sympathy for the family, arguing that penalisingpunishing someone for an action因某行為而懲罰某人 them over a single concert ticket is disproportionate, particularly given that the girl's parents depend on the monthly allowance of 2,000 yuan due to ongoing health issues. Nevertheless, officials maintain that the rules must be applied consistentlyin the same way every time, without exception始終如一,不作例外 to prevent abuse of the welfare system.

This incident, though seemingly small in scale, raises broader questions that resonate well beyond Ganzhou. It is widely argued that the episode illustrates the tension between rigid bureaucratic criteria and the nuanced realitiescomplex and detailed aspects of a situation that are easy to overlook容易被忽略的複雜細節 of family life, especially as fan culture and cross-border travel become increasingly accessible to young people. By the same token, the controversy invites reflection on how welfare systems everywhere, including Hong Kong, might strike a fairer balance between accountabilitybeing responsible for your own actions or decisions對自己的行為或決定負責 and compassion when administering support to vulnerable households.

Fan culture has driven a growing number of mainland teenagers to attend concerts in Hong Kong.
Rigid bureaucratic criteria sometimes fail to account for the complexity of individual circumstances.

phrases.sample: The case exposes a blind spot in welfare design that fails to account for one-off family treats.

articles.summary_zh_html:
中國內地一名少女看似微不足道的決定,竟引發一場關於福利政策、消費文化與家庭責任的全國性爭論——事件源於她到香港觀看演唱會一事,令家人因此失去政府生活津貼。這名少女是江西贛州一所技術中學的學生,據報她曾向家人表示,自己可以自行資助這次旅程,無須動用津貼。然而,當地政府後來把這次外遊界定為一種高端消費,認為與該家庭繼續享有低收入家庭資助資格的條件不符。

事件曝光後迅速在網上瘋傳,引發兩極評價。一方面,有評論認為這項政策屬合理的保障措施,主張公共資金應嚴格保留給必要需要,而非非必要的娛樂開支。另一方面,不少網民則對這個家庭表示同情,認為僅因一張演唱會門票就懲罰他們實屬不成比例,尤其女孩的父母因健康問題,一直依靠每月二千元人民幣的津貼生活。然而,官方堅持規則必須始終一致地執行,以防止有人濫用福利制度。

這宗事件規模雖小,卻引發了遠超贛州範圍的更廣泛議題。有人普遍認為,事件反映了僵化的官僚標準與家庭生活細膩複雜的現實之間的張力,尤其在追星文化與跨境旅遊對年輕人日益唾手可得的背景下更見明顯。同樣地,這場爭議促使人反思,世界各地包括香港的福利制度,應如何在問責與體恤之間取得更公平的平衡,以協助弱勢家庭。

articles.headline: Man Arrested After Allegedly Refusing to Share HK$30m Mark Six Jackpot With Group
articles.summary_html:
A dispute over a multimillion-dollar lottery prize has landed a Hong Kong man in police custody, after he allegedly refused to share a Mark Six jackpot worth approximately HK$30 million with fourteen of his colleagues. According to police, the group, made up of staff members from the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department, had reportedly pooled their moneycombined funds from several people for a shared purpose集合各人的金錢作共同用途 to purchase the winning ticket together, with the 36-year-old man responsible for buying the ticket and holding the bank account into which the prize was ultimately paid.

Nevertheless, once the ticket proved to be a winner, the man allegedly refused to distribute the winnings evenly among the group, despite a meeting having been convened in an attempt to resolve the disputea disagreement or conflict between parties爭議或衝突 amicably. A 53-year-old colleague subsequently reported the matter to police, prompting an investigation on suspicion of theft. Officers have since frozento officially prevent money in an account from being used or withdrawn正式凍結戶口內的資金,禁止動用 the HK$30 million held in the man's bank account while the case is investigated further.

It is widely argued that this case serves as a cautionary tale about the importance of establishing clear, written agreements before entering into any form of shared financial venture, however informal it may seem. By the same token, the incident highlights a recurring legal grey area in Hong Kong: verbal arrangements between friends or colleagues, though seemingly built on mutual trust, often carry little weight without documented proof, leaving aggrieved parties with limited recourse besides pursuing costly and time-consuming legal action. Critics contend that greater public awareness of such risks could help prevent similar disputes from arising in the future.

一名香港男子因一宗涉及過千萬元彩票獎金的糾紛被警方拘捕,他涉嫌拒絕與十四名同事分享一注約值三千萬港元的六合彩頭獎。據警方透露,這班同事來自食物環境衞生署,據報曾一同集資購買該注中獎彩票,由一名三十六歲男子負責買票,並以其銀行帳戶接收獎金。

然而,當彩票中獎後,該名男子卻涉嫌拒絕將獎金平均分配給各人,儘管各方曾召開會議,試圖友好解決這場爭議。其後一名五十三歲同事向警方報案,促使警方以涉嫌盜竊展開調查。警方已凍結該男子銀行帳戶內的三千萬港元,案件仍在進一步調查。

有人認為,這宗案件是一個警世教訓,說明在進行任何形式的集資活動前,即使看似非正式,訂立清晰的書面協議仍屬必要。與此同時,事件亦揭示香港一個常見的法律灰色地帶:朋友或同事之間的口頭承諾,儘管建基於互信,但在缺乏書面證明的情況下往往難以生效,令受屈一方在追討時只能依靠昂貴且耗時的法律程序。批評者認為,提高公眾對這類風險的警覺,有助防止同類糾紛再次發生。

articles.headline: Quality Concerns Prompt Further Tests on Concrete Used in 3 Public Housing Blocks
articles.summary_html:
Concerns over building safety have once again surfaced in Hong Kong's public housing sector, after the Housing Authority disclosed that the structural integritythe ability of a building or structure to withstand its intended load without failing結構承受預期負荷而不損壞的能力 of concrete used in three blocks at the Tung Chung Area 42 estate requires further investigation. The issue came to light during routine concrete cube strength tests conducted between late August and early September, when engineers found that certain structural components in Blocks 3, 4 and 5 did not meet the expected quality benchmarks, prompting authorities to order additional, more rigorous testing before construction can proceed.

The main contractor overseeing the project, Able Engineering, is no stranger to scrutinyclose and careful examination仔細和認真的審查; the firm is separately embroiled in a scandal involving defective lift installation work at an expansion project at Queen Mary Hospital. This is by no means the first time that quality control issues have affected Hong Kong's public housing pipeline, and it is widely argued that such recurring lapses raise serious questions about oversightthe act of supervising or monitoring a process監督或監察過程 within the construction industry, particularly given the government's ambitious targets for accelerating the supply of subsidised flats to address the city's chronic housing shortage.

Nevertheless, officials have sought to reassure the public that safety will not be compromised for the sake of speed, stressing that no units will be handed over until the concrete's quality is fully verified. By the same token, critics contend that greater transparency and stricter accountability measuressystems that ensure people or companies answer for their actions確保人或公司對其行為負責的制度 for contractors are urgently needed, arguing that public trust in the housing supply chain cannot be rebuilt through reassurances alone, but only through consistently rigorous enforcement of building standards.

香港公共房屋界的建築安全問題再次引起關注,房屋署披露東涌42區一個公共房屋地盤有三座大廈所使用的混凝土,其結構完整性須進一步調查。事件源於八月底至九月初進行的混凝土立方體強度測試,工程人員發現第3、4及5座部分結構構件未達到預期的質量標準,當局因此下令在工程繼續進行前展開更嚴格的額外檢測。

負責該項目的主要承建商「安利工程」(Able Engineering)並非首次受到審視——該公司另涉及瑪麗醫院擴建工程升降機安裝工程出現缺陷的醜聞。這並非香港公共房屋供應鏈首次出現質量管控問題,有人認為,這類反覆出現的失誤令建造業的監管備受質疑,尤其是在政府正致力加快資助房屋供應,以應對本港長期房屋短缺問題之際。

然而,官員試圖安撫公眾,強調不會為求趕工而犧牲安全,並重申在混凝土質量完全獲得確認之前,不會向居民交樓。與此同時,批評者認為,當局必須加強透明度,並對承建商實施更嚴格的問責機制,強調單靠安撫言辭無法重建公眾對房屋供應鏈的信心,唯有持續嚴格執行建築標準才能做到。

cover_text.zh_sub: 房署下令加做強度測試
cover_text.en: Housing Authority orders extra concrete tests at Tung Chung

articles.headline: Hong Kong Stages First International Lantern Spectacular for Mid-Autumn Festival
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong is preparing to welcome the Mid-Autumn Festival with a citywide celebrationan event that takes place across the whole city全市性的慶祝活動 on an unprecedented scale. The Hong Kong Tourism Board will stage its first-ever International Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park from 17 to 27 September, running alongside the long-running Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival. Centred on the theme of "Reunion," the event brings together around 3,000 specialty lanternslanterns made with distinctive or unique craftsmanship特色花燈 from 20 countries and regions, including four giant lanterns crafted by a team of Qinhuai lantern makers invited especially from Nanjing. A World Lantern Street will showcase these international pieces, while a dedicated Hong Kong lantern court will display more than 400 traditional hand-made lanterns. Lighting hours will run from 6:30pm to 11pm daily, extending to midnight on Mid-Autumn Day itself, 25 September, with free admission throughout.

It is widely argued that the event does more than simply entertain. Running in tandem with the 147th edition of the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance, an intangible cultural heritagetraditions and skills passed down that are not physical objects非物質文化遺產 item recognised on the national list, the festival period illustrates how the city is attempting to safeguard age-old customstraditions practised for a very long time古老習俗 while simultaneously projecting an image of international openness. By the same token, inviting overseas artisans to contribute to a distinctly local festival signals an ambition to position Hong Kong as a cultural crossroadsa place where different traditions and influences meet文化交匯點 rather than a city defined by a single heritage alone.

Nevertheless, critics contend that such large-scale, internationally flavoured festivities carry a risk of diluting authenticityweakening the genuine or original character of something削弱真確性, turning a solemn family occasion into a tourist spectaclean event staged mainly to attract and impress visitors吸引遊客的盛事. Supporters counter that exposing younger generations to traditional lantern-making alongside global art forms may in fact rekindle interestrenew or revive enthusiasm for something重燃興趣 in heritage that might otherwise fade. Whether this fusion approach represents a sustainable model for cultural preservation or merely a one-off commercial success remains to be seen, but it undeniably sets a notable precedentan earlier example used as a guide for future action先例 for how Hong Kong festivals might evolve in years to come.

vocab.sample: The illuminated installation stretching across Victoria Park drew record crowds eager to photograph its glowing lanterns.
The Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance is a heritage item recognised on the national list.
Many age-old customs surrounding the Mid-Autumn Festival are still observed by families today.
Hong Kong's position as a cultural crossroads allows it to host festivals with genuinely global input.
Some worry that adding too many international elements risks diluting the authenticity of the festival.
Critics fear the festival could become little more than a tourist spectacle rather than a meaningful tradition.
Organisers hope the event will rekindle interest in traditional crafts among young people.
This year's carnival may set a precedent for how future cultural events are staged in the city.
Visitors admired the specialty lanterns brought over from more than twenty countries and regions.
Each artisan spent weeks handcrafting the giant lanterns before they went on display.
Organisers hope the free event will boost visitor turnout during the festival period.
The lantern displays commemorate the values of reunion and togetherness central to the festival.

phrases.zh: 融合傳統工藝與國際風格
phrases.sample: The lantern festival blends heritage craft with global flair by inviting overseas artisans to Victoria Park.

phrases.zh: 有可能將莊重節日變成純粹的觀光項目
phrases.sample: Critics warn that oversized festivities risk flattening a solemn family occasion into mere spectacle.

phrases.zh: 為本地傳統增添國際光彩
phrases.sample: Inviting Nanjing lantern makers lends international lustre to a distinctly local tradition.

phrases.en: a showcase rather than a substitute for heritage
phrases.zh: 是展示而非取代傳統的方式
phrases.sample: Organisers insist the event is a showcase rather than a substitute for genuine heritage practice.

phrases.en: draws a younger crowd back to customs they overlooked
phrases.zh: 吸引年輕一代重新接觸被忽略的舊有習俗
phrases.sample: Interactive lantern displays could draw a younger crowd back to customs they once overlooked.

phrases.en: commercial polish without hollowing out meaning
phrases.zh: 商業化包裝而不流於空洞
phrases.sample: Planners say the festival can achieve commercial polish without hollowing out its cultural meaning.

phrases.en: stakes a claim as a cultural meeting point
phrases.zh: 確立自己作為文化交會點的地位
phrases.sample: By hosting lantern makers from twenty regions, Hong Kong stakes a claim as a cultural meeting point.

phrases.en: a test of whether scale and sincerity can coexist
phrases.zh: 考驗規模與誠意能否並存
phrases.sample: The festival becomes a test of whether scale and sincerity can coexist in a single celebration.

phrases.zh: 為未來節慶的舉辦方式立下範本
phrases.sample: If successful, the lantern spectacular could set the template for how future festivals are run.

phrases.zh: 以國際影響力換取社區親切感
phrases.sample: Some worry the event trades neighbourhood intimacy for international reach.

phrases.zh: 讓漸漸式微的工藝在數碼時代保持可見
phrases.sample: Displaying hand-made lanterns keeps a fading craft visible to a generation used to digital entertainment.

phrases.zh: 以超越免費入場人流的方式衡量成效
phrases.sample: Organisers should measure success beyond free-admission footfall, looking also at renewed cultural interest.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港正準備以一場前所未有規模的全城盛事迎接中秋節。香港旅遊發展局將於9月17日至27日在維多利亞公園舉辦首屆「國際花燈薈萃」,與歷史悠久的中秋綵燈會同場舉行。活動以「團圓」為主題,匯聚約三千個來自二十個國家及地區的特色花燈,包括特邀南京秦淮花燈師傅團隊製作的四個巨型花燈。「世界花燈大街」將展示這些國際花燈作品,而專設的香港花燈廊則會展出四百多個傳統手工花燈。亮燈時間為每日下午六時半至晚上十一時,中秋節當日(9月25日)則延長至午夜,全程免費入場。

有人認為,這項活動的意義不止於娛樂。活動期間同時舉行第147屆大坑舞火龍——一項被列入國家級名錄的非物質文化遺產——反映香港一方面致力守護古老習俗,另一方面亦努力展現開放國際形象。與此同時,邀請海外匠人參與這個本地特色濃厚的節日,亦顯示香港有意將自己定位為文化交匯點,而非單一傳承的城市。

然而,批評者認為,此類具國際色彩的大型慶典,有可能削弱節日的原汁原味,將本屬莊重的家庭節日變成旅客觀光項目。支持者則反駁指,讓年輕一代接觸傳統花燈工藝與各地藝術形式,實際上有助重燃對傳統文化的興趣,否則這些興趣可能逐漸消退。這種融合模式是否能成為可持續的文化保育方式,抑或只是一次性的商業成功,目前言之尚早,但無可否認,它為香港未來節慶的發展方向樹立了一個值得注視的先例。

cover_text.en: Hong Kong hosts first international lantern festival for Mid-Autumn

articles.headline: Paul Chan Unveils HK$50 Million AI Upskilling Drive for Hong Kong Workers
articles.summary_html:
The Hong Kong government has unveiled a major upskilling drivean organised effort to teach people new, higher-level skills提升技能行動 aimed at preparing the city's workforce for the growing role of artificial intelligence. Financial Secretary Paul Chan announced that professional AI courses would roll out from November, forming part of a broader HK$50 million initiative targeting 50,000 workers through some 200 training activities over two years. The scheme is designed to reach employees across a wide range of sectors, not merely those already working in technology, reflecting official recognition that AI is set to permeatespread through and become a noticeable feature of something滲透 almost every corner of the economy.

It is widely argued that such a programme is both timely and necessary. Hong Kong has been ranked among the world's leading economies in AI readiness, trailing only New York and London on one recent global index, and the city's computing power is projected to expand dramatically by 2032. Proponents maintain that without a workforce capable of applying these tools effectively, such infrastructure investment risks going to waste. Critics contend that the funding, while welcome, remains modest in scalesmall when compared with what is actually needed規模有限 relative to the scale of disruption AI is expected to bring, and that many workers in vulnerable sectorsindustries where jobs are more likely to be lost or changed易受影響的行業 may still be left behind.

By the same token, education experts point out that upskilling alone cannot substitute for deeper curriculum reform, particularly for young people entering the job market. There is growing consensus that AI literacy should be treated as a foundational competencya basic skill that underlies many other abilities基礎能力 comparable to digital literacy a decade ago, rather than an optional add-on. Whether this latest initiative can be scaled up quickly enough to keep pace with rapid technological change remains an open question, but it nevertheless marks a significant step in the government's effort to ensure the workforce is not caught off guardunprepared for something that happens措手不及 by the AI transition.

vocab.sample: The company launched an upskilling drive to help staff adapt to new software.
Artificial intelligence has begun to permeate nearly every industry in the city.
The pilot scheme was modest in scale but still attracted considerable public attention.
Workers in vulnerable sectors need targeted support during periods of rapid automation.
Basic data analysis is now considered a foundational competency in many careers.
Many firms were caught off guard by how quickly generative AI tools became mainstream.
Workforce readiness is a key factor in determining how smoothly new technology is adopted.
Sustained infrastructure investment is essential to support the growth of the AI sector.
Curriculum reform is needed to ensure students graduate with relevant digital skills.
The disruption caused by automation has forced many industries to rethink hiring practices.
Officials are under pressure to design a scalable training model that can reach more workers.
Without proper support, the AI transition could widen the existing digital divide.

phrases.en: front-loads training before disruption hits
phrases.zh: 在衝擊來臨前率先展開培訓
phrases.sample: The scheme front-loads training before AI-driven disruption hits vulnerable industries.

phrases.en: spreads a modest budget across a huge workforce
phrases.zh: 將有限資金分攤至龐大的勞動人口
phrases.sample: Critics note the fund spreads a relatively modest budget across a huge workforce of 50,000 trainees.

phrases.en: infrastructure investment outpacing workforce readiness
phrases.zh: 基建投資步伐超前於人力準備
phrases.sample: Analysts warn of infrastructure investment outpacing workforce readiness if training lags behind.

phrases.en: extends training reach beyond the tech sector alone
phrases.zh: 將培訓範圍延伸至科技業以外的行業
phrases.sample: Unlike earlier schemes, this upskilling drive extends training reach beyond the tech sector alone.

phrases.en: risks leaving low-skilled roles further behind
phrases.zh: 有可能令低技術職位進一步被遺留在後
phrases.sample: Without targeted support, the scheme risks leaving low-skilled roles further behind as AI adoption accelerates.

phrases.en: treats AI fluency as a baseline job expectation
phrases.zh: 將人工智能應用能力視為職場基本要求
phrases.sample: Employers are beginning to treat AI fluency as a baseline job expectation rather than a bonus skill.

phrases.en: a stopgap rather than a structural curriculum fix
phrases.zh: 屬應急措施而非結構性的課程改革
phrases.sample: Some educators see the funding as a stopgap rather than a structural curriculum fix.

phrases.en: keeps pace with a fast-closing skills window
phrases.zh: 追上迅速收窄的技能窗口期
phrases.sample: Officials hope the rollout can keep pace with a fast-closing skills window before jobs are automated.

phrases.en: converts raw computing power into usable skill
phrases.zh: 將龐大運算能力轉化為實際可用的技能
phrases.sample: Training is needed to convert the city's raw computing power into skills workers can actually use.

phrases.en: echoes an earlier generation's digital divide
phrases.zh: 呼應上一代的數碼鴻溝
phrases.sample: Commentators say the emerging AI skills gap echoes an earlier generation's digital divide.

phrases.en: a down payment on a much larger workforce transition
phrases.zh: 只是應付更大規模勞動力轉型的首筆投資
phrases.sample: The HK$50 million fund is best seen as a down payment on a much larger workforce transition.

phrases.en: softens the blow for the sectors most exposed
phrases.zh: 為最受衝擊的行業緩和打擊
phrases.sample: Targeted courses aim to soften the blow for the sectors most exposed to AI-driven job losses.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港政府公布一項大型技能提升計劃,旨在為日益重要的人工智能發展,做好本港勞動人口的準備。財政司司長陳茂波宣布,專業人工智能課程將由十一月起推出,屬於一項五千萬港元計劃的一部分,該計劃透過約二百項培訓活動,於兩年內惠及五萬名在職人士。該計劃的對象涵蓋各行各業的僱員,而非僅限於科技業從業員,反映官方意識到人工智能將滲透幾乎每個經濟環節。

有人認為,這項計劃既切合時機,亦有其必要性。香港在全球人工智能準備程度排名中位居前列,在其中一項全球指數中僅次於紐約和倫敦,而本港的運算能力預計將在2032年前大幅擴展。支持者堅持,若欠缺有能力善用這些工具的勞動人口,這類基建投資恐怕會付諸浪費。批評者則認為,這筆資金雖值得歡迎,但相對於人工智能預料帶來的衝擊規模而言,仍然規模有限,而不少身處易受衝擊行業的工人,仍有可能被遺留在後。

同樣地,教育專家指出,單靠技能提升無法取代更深層的課程改革,對準備投身職場的年輕人尤其如此。社會上日漸形成一種共識:人工智能素養應被視為一項基礎能力,猶如十年前的數碼素養一樣,而非可有可無的附加課程。這項最新計劃能否迅速擴展,追上科技急速變化的步伐,仍是未知之數,但它無疑標誌著政府致力確保勞動人口不致措手不及面對人工智能轉型的一個重要舉措。

cover_text.en: Government launches AI upskilling programme for Hong Kong workers

articles.headline: HKU Makes AI Literacy Compulsory as New Students Begin 2026-27 Academic Year
articles.summary_html:
The University of Hong Kong welcomed its new cohort of undergraduates at an inauguration ceremony held under the theme "Excellence with Purpose: Shaping Tomorrow's Leaders Today." What sets this academic year apart, however, is a curricular change that reaches far beyond a single ceremony: HKU has become the first university in the city to make AI literacy a compulsory componenta required part that cannot be avoided必修部分 of its undergraduate studies. All students admitted from the 2025-26 intake onwards are now required to complete a foundational course in artificial intelligence literacy, covering everything from the workings of large language models to the ethical dilemmas such technology raises.

It is widely argued that this move reflects a broader shift in how universities view their core mission. Rather than treating AI as a specialist subject reserved for computing students, the course is designed to be multidisciplinaryinvolving more than one academic subject or field跨學科的, drawing in perspectives from law, the arts and social sciences. Supporters maintain that graduates entering almost any profession will need at least a working understanding of AI's capabilities and limitations, much as computer literacy became indispensableso important that it cannot be done without不可或缺的 a generation ago. Nevertheless, some educators caution that a single mandatory course cannot, by itself, guarantee genuine critical engagement with the technology.

Critics contend that there is a danger of such initiatives becoming tokenisticdone only for appearance's sake rather than to have real effect流於形式的 unless they are backed by sustained investment in teaching capacity and updated regularly as the technology evolves. By the same token, others point out that requiring every student to grapple with AI's ethical implications, not merely its technical mechanics, could help cultivate a more discerning generationa group of people able to judge and evaluate things wisely有辨別能力的一代 of graduates. As other local universities weigh whether to follow suit, HKU's experience over the coming year is likely to be closely watched as a test case for AI education policy across Hong Kong's tertiary sector.

vocab.sample: The AI literacy course is now a compulsory component of every undergraduate degree at the university.
The new course takes a multidisciplinary approach, combining law, ethics and computing.
Basic AI knowledge is fast becoming indispensable in the modern workplace.
Without proper resources, the initiative risks being dismissed as tokenistic.
Educators hope the course will help produce a more discerning generation of graduates.
The curricular change was introduced after months of consultation with faculty members.
Students discussed the ethical dilemmas posed by the use of generative AI in coursework.
The programme is widely seen as a test case for AI education across the sector.
The university is still refining the assessment rubric used to grade students' AI literacy projects.
Employers now expect graduates to have at least a working understanding of AI tools.
Other local universities are considering whether to follow suit and introduce similar courses.
Preparing students for an AI-driven world has become part of the university's core mission.

phrases.en: treats AI as core curriculum, not an elective
phrases.zh: 將人工智能視為核心課程而非選修科
phrases.sample: HKU treats AI literacy as core curriculum, not an elective reserved for computing majors.

phrases.en: folds ethical questions into technical training
phrases.zh: 將道德議題融入技術訓練
phrases.sample: The new course folds ethical questions into technical training rather than teaching the two separately.

phrases.en: a bellwether other local universities may follow
phrases.zh: 其他本地大學或會跟隨的指標
phrases.sample: HKU's mandatory course could serve as a bellwether other local universities may follow.

phrases.en: hollow compliance without sustained investment
phrases.zh: 缺乏持續投資的空洞合規
phrases.sample: Without sustained funding, the requirement risks becoming hollow compliance rather than real learning.

phrases.en: mirrors how basic computer skills once became standard
phrases.zh: 呼應電腦技能昔日成為標準配備的過程
phrases.sample: The shift mirrors how basic computer skills once became a standard graduate expectation.

phrases.en: draws in voices beyond the computing department
phrases.zh: 吸納電腦系以外的聲音
phrases.sample: The course deliberately draws in voices beyond the computing department, including law and the arts.

phrases.en: a single course cannot carry the whole burden
phrases.zh: 單一課程無法獨力承擔全部責任
phrases.sample: Educators warn that a single mandatory course cannot carry the whole burden of AI education.

phrases.en: keeps the syllabus current as the technology shifts
phrases.zh: 隨科技轉變更新課程內容
phrases.sample: Regular revision will be needed to keep the syllabus current as AI technology shifts rapidly.

phrases.en: equips graduates to question, not just use, AI tools
phrases.zh: 讓畢業生懂得質疑而非只懂使用AI工具
phrases.sample: The programme aims to equip graduates to question, not just use, the AI tools they will encounter at work.

phrases.en: sets a benchmark other faculties may be judged against
phrases.zh: 樹立其他學系可能參照的標準
phrases.sample: HKU's requirement sets a benchmark that other faculties and universities may be judged against.

phrases.en: narrows the gap between technical skill and ethical judgement
phrases.zh: 拉近技術能力與道德判斷之間的差距
phrases.sample: The curriculum is designed to narrow the gap between technical skill and ethical judgement among graduates.

phrases.en: a test of how seriously the university takes the subject
phrases.zh: 考驗大學是否真正重視相關課題的試驗
phrases.sample: How well the course is resourced will serve as a test of how seriously the university takes the subject.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港大學以「卓越有為:塑造未來領袖」為主題,舉行開學典禮,歡迎新一屆本科生入學。然而,今學年真正與眾不同之處,在於一項遠超一場典禮意義的課程改革:港大成為全港首間將人工智能素養列為本科課程必修部分的大學。所有由2025至26學年起入學的學生,現須完成一門人工智能素養基礎課程,內容涵蓋大型語言模型的運作原理,以至相關科技引發的道德爭議。

有人認為,此舉反映大學對自身核心使命看法的轉變。課程並非將人工智能視為電腦系學生專屬的專科,而是設計成跨學科課程,涵蓋法律、人文及社會科學等多個領域的觀點。支持者堅持,幾乎任何行業的畢業生,都需要對人工智能的能力與局限有基本理解,正如一代人之前電腦素養變得不可或缺一樣。然而,部分教育工作者提醒,單憑一門必修課,未能單靠本身保證學生真正具備批判性思考的能力。

批評者認為,除非持續投放資源加強教學能力,並隨科技發展定期更新內容,否則此類措施有流於形式主義之虞。與此同時,也有意見指出,要求每位學生正視人工智能帶來的道德議題,而非僅著眼技術操作,或有助培養出更具辨識能力的一代畢業生。隨著本地其他大學考慮是否跟隨,港大今年的經驗,將成為香港高等教育界人工智能政策的一個備受關注的試驗案例。

cover_text.en: HKU makes AI literacy compulsory for all new students

articles.headline: Hong Kong Logs Hottest Day on Record as Typhoon Dolphin Brings Extreme Heat
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong recorded its hottest day on recordthe highest temperature ever measured since records began有紀錄以來最熱的一天 this summer, as the Observatory headquarters registered 36.9 degrees Celsius while Typhoon Dolphin swept warm air across the region. The reading, the highest since records began in 1884, was eclipsed in some districts: Sheung Shui in the New Territories logged 39.8 degrees, the highest figure recorded since automatic weather stations were introduced in the 1980s. The extreme heat forced many residents to seek refuge in shopping malls and even artificial snow parks, while outdoor workers and domestic helpers were reported to have struggled significantly under the scorching conditionsextremely hot weather conditions酷熱的天氣.

It is widely argued that such records are no longer isolated anomalies but part of a discernible patterna pattern that can be clearly noticed or recognised明顯的規律 of intensifying heat linked to climate change. Meteorologists have noted that Hong Kong is projected to face several typhoons annually in the coming years, and that rising sea and air temperatures are likely to make such record-breaking days increasingly common rather than exceptional. Critics contend that current public health measures, including heat warnings and outdoor work guidelines, have not kept pace with the frequency and severity of these events, leaving vulnerable groups disproportionately exposedaffected to an unfairly large degree compared with others承受不成比例的影響 to heat-related risks.

By the same token, environmental groups argue that record heat should serve as a wake-up callan event that makes people realise a serious problem exists警號 for accelerating the city's transition towards carbon neutrality, rather than being treated merely as a short-term inconvenience. Nevertheless, sceptics point out that individual weather records, however striking, cannot alone justify sweeping policy change without sustained long-term data. What seems increasingly clear is that as extreme heat becomes a more regular feature of Hong Kong summers, pressure will continue to mount on policymakers to reassess how the city prepares its infrastructure, workforce and public health systems for a warmer future.

vocab.sample: The Observatory confirmed this was the hottest day on record since 1884.
Outdoor workers struggled under scorching conditions during the heatwave.
Scientists say the record heat fits a discernible pattern linked to climate change.
Low-income outdoor workers are disproportionately exposed to heat-related health risks.

Forecasters warned that the feels-like temperature in some districts topped 40 degrees during the afternoon.
The Observatory issued a heat warning as temperatures soared across the territory.

phrases.sample: Tackling record heat demands more than a one-off emergency response from the government.

phrases.sample: Record heat forces a rethink of how the city's infrastructure is built to cope with extremes.

phrases.sample: Scorching conditions compound strain on an already stretched outdoor workforce.

phrases.en: accelerates the timetable for carbon neutrality

phrases.sample: Environmental groups want the heat record to accelerate the timetable for carbon neutrality.
