writing_angles.text: Participating in shared cultural rituals can strengthen a sense of collective belongingthe feeling of being part of a larger community with shared values and history集體歸屬感, particularly valuable during periods of social change.

articles.summary_zh_html:
論者普遍讚揚，香港今年首次在維多利亞公園舉辦國際花燈節，標誌著本港中秋節慶祝活動的重大擴展。活動由香港旅遊發展局主辦，為期由9月17日至27日，匯聚來自二十個國家及地區的花燈，以「團圓」為主題。

同樣地，這項活動彰顯香港作為本地與國際文化傳統匯聚點的持久角色。除了從南京引入的大型巨匠花燈外，遊客亦可參觀專設的香港花燈廣場，展出逾四百個傳統手工花燈，以及造型如本地點心和街頭小食的趣味花燈，為這個有數百年歷史的節日提供獨特的香港演繹。

儘管如此，有文化評論員提醒，過於側重旅遊的活動有可能沖淡節日原有的意義，將一個以家庭為中心的節日變成主要為遊客而設的表演。然而值得注意的是，鄰近的大坑舞火龍已踏入第147屆，被列為國家級非物質文化遺產，至今仍由本地居民主導，顯示草根傳統與大型旅遊推廣可以並存。

不可否認，這類大型活動在強化市民身份認同方面具有相當價值，對那些否則可能只膚淺地參與傳統節日的年輕居民而言尤其如此。這些活動能否成功在商業吸引力與真正的文化遺產保育之間取得平衡，仍是一個值得密切關注的懸而未決的問題。

cover_text.en: Victoria Park hosts first international lantern festival for Mid-Autumn

articles.headline: Hong Kong Leader Says Firms Must Strive to Survive Despite Government Support
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu has defended the economic measures set out in his 2026 Policy Address, insisting that private enterprisesbusinesses owned and operated by individuals or companies rather than the government私營企業 must still strive to remain competitive even as the government extends fresh support. Speaking on Saturday, Mr Lee stressed that the livelihood section of this year's address was the broadest in scope to date, forming part of the city's inaugural five-year development plana government blueprint setting economic and social goals over a five-year period五年發展規劃.

Critics contend that repeated rounds of government assistance risk fostering a culture of dependency on state interventiona reliance on government action rather than independent effort依賴政府干預, particularly among small and medium enterprises still recovering from years of subdued consumer spendingweaker than usual spending by households on goods and services疲弱的消費支出. Nevertheless, officials argue that targeted relief remains necessary to prevent further business closures while the broader economy adjusts to structural change.

By the same token, Mr Lee emphasised that businesses must first help the economy grow before the government can expand support for livelihoods, a formulation suggesting that welfare spending will remain contingent on continued economic growthan increase in the production and consumption of goods and services within an economy經濟增長 rather than expanding indefinitely. It is worth noting that this framing places considerable pressure on firms to demonstrate market-driven resiliencethe ability of businesses to adapt and recover through their own commercial strategies rather than external aid市場主導的韌性 rather than treating government support as a permanent safety net.

One cannot deny that the tension between offering meaningful assistance and avoiding an over-reliance on public funds will remain a defining feature of Hong Kong's economic policy in the years ahead. For students, the debate offers a useful illustration of how governments must constantly rebalance short-term relief against long-term fiscal sustainabilitythe capacity of a government to maintain its spending levels without risking future financial instability財政可持續性.

vocab.sample: Private enterprises are being urged to compete on their own merits rather than rely on subsidies.
The city's first five-year development plan sets out clear targets for economic growth.
Prolonged relief schemes may create a dependency on state intervention among struggling firms.
Officials hope businesses will develop market-driven resilience rather than await further bailouts.
Maintaining fiscal sustainability requires balancing generous welfare with prudent budgeting.
Sustained economic growth is presented as a precondition for expanding social spending.
The government has favoured targeted relief over broad, indiscriminate handouts.
Officials say targeted relief remains necessary while firms undergo economic adjustment.
Subdued consumer spending has weighed heavily on the retail and catering industries.
Critics warn that firms should not treat government aid as a permanent safety net.
A wave of business closures prompted calls for further government support.
This year's livelihood measures cover housing, elderly care and family welfare.

phrases.en: wean businesses off repeated bailouts
phrases.zh: 令企業擺脫一再依賴援助的習慣
phrases.sample: Officials hope to gradually wean businesses off repeated bailout schemes.

phrases.en: earn support rather than expect it
phrases.zh: 靠實力爭取支援而非視為必然
phrases.sample: Mr Lee's remarks suggest firms must earn support rather than expect it automatically.

phrases.en: stand on their own commercial footing
phrases.zh: 靠自身商業實力站穩陣腳
phrases.sample: The government wants struggling firms to stand on their own commercial footing.

phrases.en: make further relief conditional on growth
phrases.zh: 將進一步紓困與經濟增長掛鈎
phrases.sample: The policy effectively makes further relief conditional on sustained growth.

phrases.en: cushion firms without propping them up indefinitely
phrases.zh: 緩解企業壓力而非無限期支撐
phrases.sample: Targeted schemes aim to cushion firms without propping them up indefinitely.

phrases.en: weather a prolonged spending slowdown
phrases.zh: 捱過持續已久的消費放緩期
phrases.sample: Small retailers are struggling to weather a prolonged consumer spending slowdown.

phrases.en: shift the burden of adjustment onto businesses
phrases.zh: 將調整的重擔轉移至企業身上
phrases.sample: Critics say the framing shifts the burden of adjustment onto businesses themselves.

phrases.en: draw a line between support and dependency
phrases.zh: 在支援與依賴之間劃出界線
phrases.sample: Officials insist they must draw a line between support and dependency.

phrases.en: keep welfare spending within fiscal limits
phrases.zh: 將福利開支維持在財政可承受範圍內
phrases.sample: The approach is designed to keep welfare spending within fiscal limits.

phrases.en: reward firms that adapt rather than wait
phrases.zh: 獎勵主動適應而非被動等待的企業
phrases.sample: The scheme is structured to reward firms that adapt rather than simply wait for aid.

phrases.en: treat state aid as a last resort
phrases.zh: 將政府援助視為最後手段
phrases.sample: Mr Lee suggests businesses should treat state aid as a last resort, not a first option.

phrases.en: balance compassion with budget discipline
phrases.zh: 在人情考量與財政紀律之間取得平衡
phrases.sample: The debate highlights the need to balance compassion with budget discipline.

writing_angles.label: Economic dimension
writing_angles.text: Balancing fiscal prudencecareful and responsible management of government spending財政審慎 against the immediate needs of struggling firms forces policymakers to weigh short-term relief against the risk of unsustainable public spendinggovernment expenditure that cannot be maintained over the long term without financial strain不可持續的公共開支.

writing_angles.label: Social dimension
writing_angles.text: Framing livelihood support as conditional on economic performance may deepen anxiety among lower-income households already grappling with economic insecuritya persistent lack of confidence in financial stability經濟不穩定感.

writing_angles.label: Political dimension
writing_angles.text: The insistence on self-reliance reflects a broader effort to manage public expectations, positioning continued political legitimacythe degree to which a government authority is accepted as rightful by the public政治認受性 on visible economic results rather than expanded welfare alone.

writing_angles.label: Ethical dimension
writing_angles.text: Critics argue there is an ethical obligationa moral duty to act in a particular way towards others道德責任 to protect vulnerable businesses regardless of broader fiscal targets, especially where closures directly threaten the livelihoods of workers.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據廣泛報導，行政長官李家超為其2026年施政報告中的經濟措施辯護，堅稱即使政府提供新一輪支援，私營企業仍須努力保持競爭力。他於星期六發言時強調，今年施政報告的民生部分涵蓋範圍是歷來最廣的，是本港首份五年發展規劃的一部分。

批評者認為，連續多輪的政府援助有可能助長依賴政府干預的風氣，對於仍在從多年疲弱的消費支出中復元的中小企尤其如此。然而，官員認為，在整體經濟適應結構性轉變之際，針對性紓困措施仍有必要，以防止更多商戶結業。

同樣地，李家超強調，企業必須先推動經濟增長，政府才能擴大民生支援，這種說法意味福利開支將取決於持續的經濟增長，而非無限擴張。值得注意的是，這種框架對企業造成相當大的壓力，要求它們展現市場主導的韌性，而非將政府支援視為永久的安全網。

不可否認，在提供有意義的援助與避免過度依賴公共資金之間取得平衡的張力，將繼續是香港未來多年經濟政策的一大特徵。對學生而言，這場爭論正好說明政府必須不斷在短期紓困與長期財政可持續性之間重新取得平衡。

cover_text.zh_sub: 李家超籲企業提升競爭力
cover_text.en: Lee urges firms to strive for competitiveness despite state support

articles.headline: Foreign Carers for Elderly to Get 10 to 20 Percent More Pay Than Current Helpers
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that foreign carers recruited under a new government pilot scheme for elderly care will be paid ten to twenty per cent more than existing domestic helpers, according to Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun. The initiative is intended to address Hong Kong's growing ageing populationa demographic trend in which the proportion of elderly people within a society steadily increases人口老化 by attracting carers with specialised training rather than relying solely on the existing domestic helper scheme.

Critics contend that the pay differential could create friction within an already strained care sector, where existing helpers frequently perform similar duties without comparable recognition or wage paritythe state of receiving equal pay for work of equal value薪酬平等. Nevertheless, officials argue that requiring applicants to hold at least three years of relevant experience justifies the higher pay, since it reflects genuine specialised expertiseadvanced skills and knowledge developed through focused training in a particular field專業技能 rather than a general willingness to perform household duties.

By the same token, the scheme forms part of a broader package announced in this year's Policy Address to reinforce support for family carers, including an expanded Living Allowance Scheme for low-income households caring for elderly relatives. It is worth noting that such measures reflect growing recognition that informal caregivingunpaid care provided by family members rather than professional institutions非正式照顧 places a considerable and often invisible burden on working families.

One cannot deny that Hong Kong's care economy faces mounting strain as its population ages and its workforce shrinks. Whether higher wages alone can attract sufficient carers, or whether deeper structural reform of the sector is required, remains an important question for policymakers and families alike.

vocab.sample: Rising elderly care demand has prompted the government to pilot higher pay for foreign carers.
Labour groups have long called for greater wage parity among domestic care workers.
The new scheme rewards carers who bring specialised expertise in elderly support.
Informal caregiving by family members often goes financially unrecognised.
Investment in the care economy is seen as essential to supporting an ageing society.
The trial initiative will be reviewed after its first year before any decision to expand it citywide.
A persistent labour shortage in elderly care has driven the search for new recruitment models.
Carers recruited under the scheme will also receive a monthly stipend to cover basic living costs.
Studies consistently show that caregiver burden affects both mental and physical health.
The domestic helper scheme has operated in Hong Kong for several decades.
Some experts argue the sector needs structural reform rather than incremental pay rises.
Officials are testing a new recruitment model to attract experienced carers from abroad.

phrases.en: reward expertise rather than mere willingness
phrases.zh: 獎勵專業技能而非單純的意願
phrases.sample: Officials say the pay gap rewards expertise rather than mere willingness to work.

phrases.en: risk sowing resentment among existing staff
phrases.zh: 有可能在現職員工間埋下不滿
phrases.sample: A visible pay gap risks sowing resentment among existing domestic helpers.

phrases.en: put a price on specialised training
phrases.zh: 為專門培訓定出相應價值
phrases.sample: The scheme effectively puts a price on specialised elder-care training.

phrases.en: shoulder care duties without formal recognition
phrases.zh: 肩負照顧責任卻未獲正式認可
phrases.sample: Many existing helpers shoulder similar care duties without formal recognition.

phrases.en: widen the pool of qualified carers
phrases.zh: 擴大合資格護理人員的來源
phrases.sample: Higher pay is intended to widen the pool of qualified carers willing to relocate.

phrases.en: lean on family members by default
phrases.zh: 在缺乏支援下默默依靠家人
phrases.sample: Without affordable options, many households lean on family members by default.

phrases.en: count unpaid caregiving as a hidden cost
phrases.zh: 將無償照顧視為隱藏成本
phrases.sample: Economists increasingly count unpaid caregiving as a hidden cost to the economy.

phrases.en: test whether higher pay alone can fix a shortfall
phrases.zh: 考驗單憑加薪能否解決人手短缺
phrases.sample: The pilot will test whether higher pay alone can fix the carer shortfall.

phrases.en: stretch a shrinking workforce further
phrases.zh: 令萎縮的勞動人口承受更大壓力
phrases.sample: An ageing population continues to stretch an already shrinking workforce further.

phrases.en: formalise support that families once absorbed alone
phrases.zh: 將過去由家庭獨力承擔的支援制度化
phrases.sample: The living allowance formalises support that families once absorbed entirely alone.

phrases.en: require proof of relevant experience
phrases.zh: 要求提供相關經驗的證明
phrases.sample: The scheme will require proof of relevant experience before granting higher pay.

phrases.en: signal where policy priorities now lie
phrases.zh: 顯示政策重點現時所在
phrases.sample: The expanded allowance signals where the government's caregiving priorities now lie.

writing_angles.label: Social dimension
writing_angles.text: The reform highlights how demographic ageingthe gradual increase in the average age of a population人口老化現象 is reshaping labour demand, requiring society to reconsider how care work is valued and rewarded.

writing_angles.label: Economic dimension
writing_angles.text: Higher wages for specialised carers may improve recruitment, but they also raise the cost of care provisionthe total financial expense involved in delivering care services照顧服務成本 for families who must eventually bear part of that expense.

writing_angles.label: Ethical dimension
writing_angles.text: Paying new carers more than existing helpers for comparable work raises questions of distributive fairnessthe principle that benefits and burdens should be shared among people in a just manner分配公平 within an already vulnerable migrant workforce.

writing_angles.label: Psychological dimension
writing_angles.text: Family members providing unpaid care frequently experience caregiver fatiguephysical and emotional exhaustion resulting from the sustained demands of caring for another person照顧者疲勞, underscoring the need for allowances that acknowledge this hidden cost.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據廣泛報導，根據勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡所述，在一項新的政府先導計劃下，招聘用於照顧長者的外地護理人員，薪酬將較現有的家庭傭工高出一至兩成。這項措施旨在應對香港日益嚴重的人口老化問題，透過吸納具備專門培訓的護理人員，而非單靠現有的外傭計劃。

批評者認為，這種薪酬差距可能在本已緊絀的照顧行業內造成摩擦，因為現職傭工往往執行類似職務，卻未獲相應的認可或薪酬平等待遇。儘管如此，官員認為，要求申請人擁有至少三年相關經驗，足以合理化較高的薪酬，因為這反映出真正的專業技能，而非一般的家務意願。

同樣地，這項計劃是今年施政報告公布的更廣泛措施之一，旨在加強對家庭照顧者的支援，包括擴大照顧低收入家庭長者親屬的生活津貼計劃。值得注意的是，這些措施反映出社會日漸意識到，非正式照顧為在職家庭帶來相當沉重、卻往往隱而不見的負擔。

不可否認，隨著人口老化及勞動人口萎縮，香港的照顧經濟正面臨日益加劇的壓力。單靠加薪能否吸引足夠的護理人員，抑或行業需要更深層的結構性改革，仍是政策制定者及家庭皆須面對的重要問題。

cover_text.zh_sub: 先導計劃應對人口老化
cover_text.en: Hong Kong to pay new foreign elderly carers higher wages

articles.headline: Hospital Authority Calls for Early Flu Vaccination Amid Infection Rise
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that Hong Kong's Hospital Authority has urged residents to seek early influenza vaccination as seasonal flu infections continue to rise across the city. Health officials describe current viral activitythe level of a virus's spread and transmission within a population病毒活躍程度 as remaining high, with hospitals reporting an increase in serious cases requiring admission.

Critics contend that public awareness campaigns alone may be insufficient to reach vulnerable groups, particularly the elderly and those with chronic illnesses who face the greatest risk of severe complications. Nevertheless, the Hospital Authority has procured around 1.3 million vaccine doses this season, offering inactivated, recombinant and nasal spray formulationsdifferent types of vaccine preparations suited to varying medical needs and age groups滅活、基因重組及噴鼻劑型疫苗 to accommodate different patient needs.

By the same token, doctors have emphasised that the body requires roughly two weeks after vaccination to build sufficient immune protectionthe body's ability to resist and fight off a particular infection免疫保護, meaning delays in getting vaccinated could leave individuals exposed during the peak infection period. It is worth noting that immunity from the vaccine is expected to last at least six months, covering much of the traditional winter flu season.

One cannot deny that persuading the public to act before symptoms appear remains one of the most persistent challenges in preventive healthcaremedical measures taken to prevent illness before it occurs, rather than treating it afterwards預防性醫療. The current campaign illustrates the recurring tension between individual complacency and the collective benefits of timely public health action.

vocab.sample: Viral activity is expected to remain high over the coming weeks, doctors warned.
Vaccination provides immune protection that develops gradually over two weeks.
Preventive healthcare measures such as vaccination reduce the burden on hospitals.
Patients with chronic illness are advised to get vaccinated as early as possible.
The government launched a public awareness campaign to encourage early vaccination.
High-risk patients, including the elderly, are being urged to get vaccinated early.
Hospitals brace for pressure during the peak infection period each winter.
Different vaccine formulations are available to suit patients of varying ages.
Untreated flu infections can occasionally lead to severe complications.
Widespread vaccination generates a collective benefit by slowing community transmission.
Timely public health action can significantly reduce hospital admissions.
Health officials warn that public complacency remains a major obstacle to prevention.

phrases.en: race against a two-week immunity gap
phrases.zh: 與兩星期的免疫空窗期競賽
phrases.sample: Health officials are racing against a two-week immunity gap before the peak season.

phrases.en: wait until symptoms force the issue
phrases.zh: 直至病徵出現才被迫正視問題
phrases.sample: Many residents wait until symptoms force the issue before seeking a vaccine.

phrases.en: stock a range of formulations for different needs
phrases.zh: 備存多種劑型以配合不同需要
phrases.sample: The Authority has stocked a range of formulations for different age groups.

phrases.en: ease strain on an already stretched system
phrases.zh: 緩解本已繃緊的醫療系統壓力
phrases.sample: Early vaccination helps ease strain on an already stretched hospital system.

phrases.en: outpace public willingness to act
phrases.zh: 快過市民願意採取行動的速度
phrases.sample: Rising infection rates have begun to outpace public willingness to act.

phrases.en: shield those least able to recover
phrases.zh: 保護最難以復原的群組
phrases.sample: Priority vaccination is meant to shield those least able to recover from complications.

phrases.en: bank protection before the surge arrives
phrases.zh: 在高峰期來臨前儲備保護力
phrases.sample: Doctors urge residents to bank protection before the seasonal surge arrives.

phrases.en: treat prevention as a shared responsibility
phrases.zh: 將預防視為共同承擔的責任
phrases.sample: Public health campaigns frame prevention as a shared responsibility, not just a personal choice.

phrases.en: fall into a pattern of last-minute action
phrases.zh: 養成臨急才行動的習慣
phrases.sample: Many residents fall into a pattern of last-minute action once cases are already rising.

phrases.en: spread risk across a vulnerable population
phrases.zh: 令風險在高危人群中擴散
phrases.sample: Delayed vaccination can spread risk across an already vulnerable population.

phrases.en: count on immunity lasting through winter
phrases.zh: 指望免疫力能維持整個冬季
phrases.sample: Officials say residents can count on immunity lasting through most of winter.

phrases.en: underestimate a risk until it becomes personal
phrases.zh: 直至風險落在自己身上才予以重視
phrases.sample: Complacency often means people underestimate a risk until it becomes personal.

writing_angles.label: Public health dimension
writing_angles.text: Widespread vaccination generates herd immunitya level of population-wide immunity sufficient to slow the spread of a disease even among the unvaccinated群體免疫, illustrating how individual medical choices carry consequences for the wider community.

writing_angles.label: Psychological dimension
writing_angles.text: Public risk perceptiona subjective assessment of how likely and how serious a potential danger is風險認知 often lags behind actual medical risk, leading many to delay vaccination until symptoms are already widespread.

writing_angles.label: Economic dimension
writing_angles.text: Preventing severe flu cases through vaccination reduces healthcare expenditurethe total amount of money spent on medical treatment and hospital services醫療開支, easing pressure on an already strained public hospital system.

writing_angles.label: Policy dimension
writing_angles.text: Government-funded vaccination schemes reflect an attempt to overcome market failurea situation in which individuals acting in their own interest produce an outcome that is worse for society as a whole市場失效, since private incentives alone may not achieve adequate vaccination coverage.

articles.summary_zh_html:
據廣泛報導，香港醫院管理局呼籲市民及早接種流感疫苗，因為本港季節性流感感染持續上升。衛生官員形容目前的病毒活躍程度仍然偏高，醫院報稱需要入院的嚴重病例有所增加。

批評者認為，單靠公眾教育宣傳可能不足以觸及高危群組，尤其是面臨最大併發症風險的長者及長期病患者。儘管如此，醫管局今季已採購約130萬劑疫苗，提供滅活、基因重組及噴鼻劑型疫苗，以配合不同病人的需要。

同樣地，醫生強調，身體需要約兩星期才能建立足夠的免疫保護，這意味延遲接種可能令市民在感染高峰期暴露於風險之中。值得注意的是，疫苗所提供的免疫力預計可持續至少六個月，足以覆蓋傳統冬季流感季節的大部分時間。

不可否認，說服市民在出現病徵前便採取行動，仍是預防性醫療工作中最持久的難題之一。目前的接種運動正好說明個人自滿情緒與及時公共衛生行動所帶來的集體利益之間，持續存在的張力。

cover_text.en: Hospital Authority urges early flu jabs as infections climb

articles.headline: BABYMONSTER Draws Over 1,000 Fans at Tsim Sha Tsui Appearance
articles.summary_html:
It is widely reported that the K-pop girl group BABYMONSTER drew more than 1,000 fans to a fashion brand appearance at 1881 Heritage in Tsim Sha Tsui, with dedicated fans reportedly beginning to queue outside the venue the night before. The event underscores the enduring commercial drawing powerthe ability of a celebrity or group to attract large crowds and generate business interest商業號召力 of K-pop acts within Hong Kong's entertainment scene.

Critics contend that such intense fan mobilisationthe organised gathering and coordinated activity of a celebrity's supporters粉絲動員 raises concerns about crowd safety and public order, particularly when large numbers of young fans camp outside venues overnight. Nevertheless, organisers noted that designated fan areas and wristband distribution helped manage the crowd in an orderly fashion.

By the same token, the appearance illustrates how brands increasingly rely on celebrity-driven marketinga promotional strategy that uses the popularity of a well-known figure to attract customers名人營銷 to generate publicity, treating fan enthusiasm as a measurable commercial asset rather than a purely cultural phenomenon. It is worth noting that Hong Kong continues to serve as a regional hub for such events, given its transport links and established fan infrastructure.

One cannot deny that K-pop's continued popularity among Hong Kong youth reflects broader patterns of cross-border cultural consumptionthe practice of engaging with entertainment, fashion, or media produced in other countries or regions跨地域文化消費, in which local audiences increasingly participate in global entertainment fandoms rather than confining their interests to homegrown celebrities alone.

articles.headline: Hong Kong Chief Executive Vows to Ensure Safety as AI Push Accelerates
articles.summary_html:
In his latest Policy Address, delivered on 16 September, Chief Executive John Lee reaffirmed the government's determination to transform Hong Kong into a regional powerhouse for artificial intelligencea leading centre driving AI development in the region區域人工智能強國. It is widely argued that the city's long-term competitiveness now hinges on its ability to convert academic research into commercial applicationturn university research into marketable products or services將學術研究轉化為商業應用. Officials have set an ambitious target: total domestic expenditure on innovation activitiesthe overall amount spent locally on research and innovation本地創新活動總開支 is to reach three per cent of GDP after 2030, almost double the 1.63 per cent recorded in 2024. The initiative will be underpinned by three new innovation parks and an expanded Northern Metropolis huba planned development zone in northern Hong Kong dedicated to technology and innovation北部都會區樞紐 devoted to AI, robotics and health technology.

Nevertheless, the government has been careful to temper enthusiasm for rapid technological advancement with a parallel emphasis on regulation. Mr Lee pledged that safety considerations would play a pivotal role inbe a crucial, central factor in擔當關鍵角色 shaping how AI is deployed across finance, healthcare and public administration. New proposals addressing deepfakes and algorithmic accountabilitythe principle that those who design and deploy algorithms must answer for their effects演算法問責 are expected to be tabled in the coming legislative session. Critics contend that without robust oversightstrong, effective supervision and monitoring嚴謹的監管, the rapid rollout of AI systems could outpace the safeguards needed to protect ordinary citizens from misinformation and data misuse.

By the same token, the plan has implications that extend well beyond the technology sector itself. Analysts suggest that as automation becomes more deeply embedded in daily operations, the labour market will be reshaped considerablychanged substantially in structure or form大幅重塑, with some traditional roles rendered obsolete while entirely new career pathways emerge. For Hong Kong's students, the message is unambiguous: digital literacythe ability to use, understand and evaluate digital technology effectively數碼素養 and adaptability are no longer optional extras but prerequisites for future employabilityessential conditions one must meet to be considered employable later on未來就業能力的先決條件 in an economy increasingly driven by intelligent systems.

vocab.sample: The Chief Executive said generative technology would be at the heart of the city's next phase of economic growth.
The new innovation park will house start-ups specialising in robotics and biotechnology.
Lawmakers are pressing for stronger algorithmic accountability before AI is deployed in courts.
Officials say adaptability skills will matter more than any single technical qualification.
He acknowledged that the job landscape would shift rapidly as AI adoption accelerates across sectors.
Automation has reduced the need for manual data entry in many industries.
The spread of misinformation online remains a pressing concern for regulators.

New AI safety rules will cover deepfakes and algorithmic accountability.
Domestic expenditure on research and development has risen steadily in recent years.

phrases.sample: The blueprint tempers technological ambition with built-in regulatory safeguards.

phrases.en: answer for decisions a machine makes

phrases.sample: Critics fear regulators will let oversight lag behind the pace of AI deployment.

phrases.sample: Automation could redraw entire career paths overnight for some traditional trades.

phrases.zh: 防範數據被大規模濫用
phrases.sample: New legislation aims to guard against personal data being misused at scale.

phrases.en: frame adaptability as a basic survival skill
phrases.zh: 將適應能力定為基本生存技能
phrases.sample: Officials frame adaptability as a basic survival skill for an AI-driven economy.

phrases.en: fold safety rules into a growth agenda
phrases.zh: 將安全規則納入增長議程
phrases.sample: The plan folds safety rules into what is otherwise a growth-focused agenda.

phrases.en: leave no legislative gap unaddressed
phrases.zh: 不留下任何未填補的法律缺口
phrases.sample: Officials insist new deepfake rules will leave no legislative gap unaddressed.

phrases.sample: Some economists worry automation will retire job categories faster than new ones form.

phrases.zh: 融合經濟雄心與道德考量的優先次序
phrases.sample: The policy attempts to fuse economic ambition with ethical AI priorities.

phrases.sample: Lawmakers face the challenge of making oversight keep step with rapid innovation.

phrases.en: no longer treat adaptability as optional
phrases.zh: 不再將適應能力視為可有可無
phrases.sample: Students are told to no longer treat adaptability as optional in an AI-driven job market.

在最新一份施政報告中，於9月16日發表，行政長官李家超重申政府決心將香港發展成區域人工智能強國。論者普遍認為，本港長遠競爭力現時取決於能否將學術研究轉化為商業應用。官員已訂立宏大目標：本地創新活動總開支將於2030年後達到本地生產總值的3%，幾乎是2024年錄得的1.63%的一倍。這項計劃將由三個新創新園及擴大的北部都會區樞紐支持，專注發展人工智能、機械人及醫療科技。

儘管如此，政府亦小心翼翼地以監管措施，調和市民對科技急速發展的期望。李家超承諾，安全考量將在人工智能應用於金融、醫療及公共行政的過程中擔當關鍵角色。針對深度偽造及演算法問責的新建議，預期將於下個立法會會期提交。批評者認為，若缺乏嚴謹的監管，人工智能系統的急速推行，可能會超越保障普通市民免受失實資訊及數據濫用所需的措施。

同樣地，這項計劃的影響遠超科技界本身。分析人士認為，隨著自動化日益融入日常運作，勞動市場將被大幅重塑，部分傳統職位將變得過時，而全新的職業路向則會湧現。對香港學生而言，這個訊息非常明確：數碼素養及適應能力已不再是可有可無的附加條件，而是在日益由智能系統主導的經濟中，實現未來就業能力的先決條件。

articles.headline: Education Chief Unveils School Merger Scheme Amid Falling Enrolment
articles.summary_html:
Secretary for Education Christine Choi announced on 18 September that a new scheme encouraging publicly funded primary and secondary schools to merge would be launched as early as the 2027/28 academic year. It is widely acknowledged that Hong Kong's declining birth ratethe ongoing fall in the number of babies born each year出生率下降 has placed considerable strain on smaller schools, with more than 120 aided and government primary schools having already trimmed the number ofreduced the quantity of削減……的數目 Primary One classes they offer. The scheme is intended to consolidate resourcescombine and streamline resources for greater efficiency整合資源 rather than force outright closures, allowing schools facing dwindling enrolment to pool staff, facilities and funding.

Nevertheless, the proposal has proven contentiousturned out to be a source of dispute or disagreement引起爭議 among educators and parents alike. Critics contend that mergers risk eroding the distinct charactergradually wearing away the unique identity侵蝕獨特特色 and community ties that many long-established schools have cultivated over decades. Some school sponsoring bodies have voiced concern that consolidation could be imposed too hastily, without adequate consultationsufficient discussion with relevant stakeholders beforehand充分諮詢 with staff and parents who fear job losses or disruption to students' learning environments. By the same token, supporters argue that maintaining chronically under-enrolled schools is unsustainableunable to be maintained at the current level over the long term不可持續的 and ultimately does students a disservicecauses harm despite good intentions對學生造成損害, as limited resources make it difficult to offer a broad curriculum.

For students themselves, the implications are considerable. A merger could mean a change of campus, new classmates, and an adjustment perioda span of time needed to become accustomed to new circumstances適應期 that some worry may affect academic performance and emotional wellbeing. Education Bureau officials have stressed that further details, including eligibility criteria and transitional supportassistance provided during a period of change過渡支援, will be announced in due course, and that affected schools will be given sufficient lead time to prepare.

vocab.sample: Officials have long warned that Hong Kong's falling fertility rate would eventually force a rethink of school provision.

Students may need to adjust to an unfamiliar campus following a merger.

phrases.sample: Critics want the bureau to give parents a genuine say before the fact, not after a merger is announced.

phrases.sample: A rushed merger could stretch an already thin teaching establishment even further.

phrases.zh: 將收生下降視為共同承擔的問題

phrases.sample: Whether the policy succeeds will be a scheme judged by its execution, not its intent.

教育局局長蔡若蓮於9月18日宣布，一項鼓勵公帑資助小學及中學合併的新計劃最快將於2027/28學年推行。普遍認為，香港的出生率下降已令小型學校承受相當大的壓力，逾120所資助及官立小學已經削減小一班級的數目。該計劃旨在整合資源，而非強制學校徹底停辦，讓收生持續下降的學校能夠集中人手、設施及資金。

然而，建議在教育界及家長之間引起爭議。評論者認為，合併或會侵蝕許多歷史悠久學校數十年來建立的獨特特色及社區聯繫。部分辦學團體表示擔心，合併可能在未經與教職員及家長充分諮詢的情況下倉促推行，而他們擔心會失去工作或影響學生的學習環境。同樣道理，支持者則認為，長期維持收生嚴重不足的學校並不可持續，最終亦損害學生，因為有限的資源難以提供廣泛的課程。

articles.headline: Hong Kong Weighs Tougher Climate Finance Disclosures for Banks
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's financial regulator is exploring new rules that would require banks to disclose more information about how they fund climate-related projectsinitiatives connected to mitigating or adapting to climate change氣候相關項目, according to a report published on 21 September. It is widely argued that greater transparency is essential if the city's sustainable finance ambitions are to be taken seriously by international investors. The Hong Kong Monetary Authority plans to conduct a territory-wide survey next year examining how lenders are applying the existing sustainable finance taxonomyan official classification system distinguishing genuinely green investments from others可持續金融分類法.

The move comes amid growing scrutiny of so-called greenwashingthe practice of overstating or falsely claiming the environmental benefits of an activity漂綠, whereby financial institutions overstate the environmental benefits of the projects they fund. Nevertheless, banking industry representatives have cautioned that overly stringent disclosure requirements could increase compliance coststhe expenses incurred in meeting regulatory requirements合規成本 and discourage smaller lenders from participating in the green finance market altogether. By the same token, environmental groups maintain that without mandatory and standardised reportingcompulsory reporting that follows a uniform, consistent format強制性及標準化匯報, it remains difficult to hold institutions accountable for their claims, undermining public confidenceweakening the trust the public places in an institution or system削弱公眾信心 in the sector as a whole.

The initiative forms part of a broader effort to position Hong Kong as a hub for climate finance in the Asia-Pacific region, complementing measures such as the Monetary Authority's ongoing consultation on decarbonisation strategiesplans aimed at reducing carbon emissions across an economy or sector去碳化策略 for the banking sector. Given that climate change poses mounting risks to the financial system, officials argue that closer scrutiny of how capital is allocated is no longer a peripheral concern but a central pillar of long-term economic resiliencethe capacity of an economy to withstand and recover from shocks經濟韌性.

phrases.sample: A territory-wide survey could expose gaps between climate pledges and actual lending behaviour.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港金融監管機構正研究新規定，要求銀行披露更多有關其如何資助氣候相關項目的資訊，一份於9月21日發表的報告指出。普遍認為，若要國際投資者認真看待本港發展可持續金融的雄心，提高透明度至關重要。香港金融管理局計劃於明年進行一項全港性調查，審視銀行如何應用現有的可持續金融分類法。

此舉正值所謂漂綠行為日益受到關注之際，即金融機構誇大其資助項目的環保效益。然而，銀行業界代表警告，過於嚴格的披露要求可能增加合規成本，甚至令小型銀行完全放棄參與綠色金融市場。同樣道理，環保團體則堅稱，若缺乏強制性及標準化的匯報，便難以追究機構對其聲稱的責任，從而削弱公眾對整個行業的信心。

此項措施是更廣泛工作的一部分，旨在將香港定位為亞太區氣候金融中心，並與金管局就銀行業去碳化策略進行的持續諮詢相輔相成。鑑於氣候變化對金融體系構成日益嚴重的風險，官員認為，密切監察資金分配方式已不再是次要問題，而是長遠經濟韌性的核心支柱。

cover_text.zh_sub: 金管局擬加強氣候披露要求
cover_text.en: Hong Kong considers stricter climate disclosure rules for banks

articles.headline: Victoria Park Lights Up for Hong Kong's First International Lantern Spectacular
articles.summary_html:
Victoria Park has been transformed into a dazzling showcase of lantern craftsmanshipthe skilled art of designing and making decorative lanterns花燈工藝 this Mid-Autumn Festival, as the Hong Kong Tourism Board stages its inaugural International Lantern Spectacularthe first-ever event of its kind首屆國際花燈盛會. Running from 17 to 27 September under the theme of "Reunion", the free exhibition brings together more than 3,000 lanterns from 20 countries and regions, ranging from delicate silk creations from South Korea to vibrant patchwork designs from Brazil. It is widely regarded as one of the most ambitious cultural undertakings the Tourism Board has attempted in recent years.

The centrepiece of the display features four giant Qinhuai lanterns crafted by artisans from Nanjing using a technique dating back some 1,700 years. Nevertheless, local heritage has not been overshadowed by international contributions: hundreds of lanterns handcrafted by Hong Kong artisans pay tribute to beloved local delicacies, with playful designs incorporating egg waffles, milk tea and curry fishballs. By the same token, the festivities extend beyond Victoria Park, with the centuries-old Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance, now inscribed on the national list of intangible cultural heritagecultural practices and traditions, as opposed to physical artefacts, recognised as worth preserving非物質文化遺產, due to wind through the streets from 24 to 26 September.

Cultural commentators contend that such large-scale celebrations play a pivotal role inare a crucial, central factor in擔當關鍵角色 reinforcing a sense of collective identitya shared sense of belonging to a community or culture集體身份認同, particularly among younger residents who may otherwise engage with time-honoured customstraditions that have been respected and followed for a very long time歷久不衰的習俗 only superficially. By blending tradition with a contemporary, highly shareableeasily and widely spread on social media極易於分享的 visual spectacle, organisers hope to rekindle enthusiasm for heritage practices that might otherwise risk fading from public consciousnessgradually being forgotten by the general public從公眾意識中消失.

vocab.sample: Visitors admired the intricate lantern craftsmanship on display at Victoria Park.
Younger generations are being encouraged to take part in heritage practices.
Festivals like this help strengthen a sense of collective identity among residents.
One master lantern-maker said this year's commission was the most ambitious of his forty-year career.
This is one of the most ambitious cultural undertakings staged in recent years.
The festival's centrepiece lantern pays tribute to over a century of Mid-Autumn celebrations in the city.
The festivities will continue across the city throughout the week.
The lantern displays were designed to be highly shareable on social media.
Many visitors said the display captured a sense of togetherness central to the festival.
Organisers hope to keep traditional crafts alive in public consciousness.
The Brazilian delegation contributed vibrant patchwork designs to the lantern display.
The immersive display let visitors walk among lanterns from twenty countries and regions.

phrases.en: turn a single night into a season-long showcase
phrases.zh: 將單一夜晚延伸成整個節慶的展示
phrases.sample: Organisers turned a single night into a season-long showcase running for over a week.

phrases.en: let imported spectacle sit alongside homegrown craft
phrases.zh: 讓外地花燈與本地工藝並陳
phrases.sample: The exhibition let imported spectacle sit alongside homegrown craft from local artisans.

phrases.en: give local snacks a second life as folk art
phrases.zh: 讓本地小食以民間藝術形式重現
phrases.sample: Lanterns shaped like egg waffles gave local snacks a second life as folk art.

phrases.en: keep a ritual from becoming a museum piece
phrases.zh: 避免傳統淪為博物館陳列品
phrases.sample: Pairing the dance with a modern festival helps keep a ritual from becoming a museum piece.

phrases.en: turn heritage into something worth posting online
phrases.zh: 將傳統變成值得在網上分享的事物
phrases.sample: Bright, photogenic lanterns turn heritage into something worth posting online.

phrases.en: stretch a festival's reach well past its traditional home ground
phrases.zh: 將節慶的影響力延伸至傳統場地以外
phrases.sample: The parade's route stretched the festival's reach well past its traditional home ground.

phrases.en: let craftsmanship do the talking
phrases.zh: 讓工藝本身說話
phrases.sample: Rather than relying on scale alone, the display let craftsmanship do the talking.

phrases.en: anchor a modern spectacle in centuries-old technique
phrases.zh: 以數百年技藝為現代盛會奠定基礎
phrases.sample: The Qinhuai lanterns anchor a modern spectacle in centuries-old technique.

phrases.en: risk reducing heritage to backdrop rather than substance
phrases.zh: 可能令傳統淪為背景而非內涵
phrases.sample: Critics warn that spectacle alone risks reducing heritage to backdrop rather than substance.

phrases.en: repackage an old custom for a photo-driven generation
phrases.zh: 為慣於拍照的一代重新包裝舊習俗
phrases.sample: The carnival repackages an old custom for a photo-driven generation of visitors.

phrases.en: invite the world to borrow from a local tradition
phrases.zh: 邀請世界從本地傳統中取材
phrases.sample: By inviting lanterns from twenty places, the festival invites the world to borrow from a local tradition.

phrases.en: measure success by participation, not just spectacle
phrases.zh: 以參與度而非單純場面衡量成效
phrases.sample: Organisers insist the event should measure success by participation, not just spectacle.

articles.summary_zh_html:
今年中秋，維多利亞公園化身成展現花燈工藝的璀璨舞台，香港旅遊發展局首次舉辦國際花燈盛會。活動以「團圓」為主題，由9月17日至27日舉行，免費入場，匯聚來自20個國家及地區逾3,000個花燈，從南韓精緻的絲綢花燈到巴西繽紛的拼布設計，一應俱全。活動普遍被視為旅發局近年舉辦最具野心的文化盛事之一。

展覽的焦點是四個由南京工匠以逾1,700年歷史技藝製作的巨型秦淮花燈。然而，本地傳統並未被國際元素蓋過：數百個由香港工匠手工製作的花燈向深受喜愛的本地小食致敬，設計活潑生動，包括雞蛋仔、奶茶及咖喱魚蛋。同樣道理，節慶活動並不限於維多利亞公園，有數百年歷史的大坑舞火龍——現已列入國家級非物質文化遺產名錄——將於9月24至26日在街頭蜿蜒巡遊。

文化評論員認為，此類大型節慶活動擔當關鍵角色，有助強化集體身份認同，尤其是對於一些可能只是膚淺地接觸歷久不衰的習俗的年輕居民而言。透過將傳統與當代、極易於分享的視覺盛宴結合，主辦單位希望重燃大眾對傳統習俗的熱情，否則這些習俗或有在公眾意識中逐漸消失的風險。

cover_text.en: Victoria Park hosts Hong Kong's first international lantern festival

articles.headline: Hong Kong Confronts a Deepening Youth Mental Health Crisis After Troubled Start to School Term
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's return to the classroom this September has been overshadowed by tragedy. Within the first week of the new academic year, at least seven cases of student self-harm or suicide were reported across the city, three of which proved fatal. It is widely argued that such incidents, though distressing in isolation, point to a far more entrenched systemic probleman issue rooted in the structure of a system rather than in isolated individual cases系統性問題 within the city's education culture, one in which academic achievement has become almost synonymous with personal worth.

Critics contend that Hong Kong's intensely examination-oriented culturean educational environment that places overwhelming emphasis on test results以考試為導向的文化 leaves little room for students who struggle to keep pace. Data compiled by the University of Hong Kong's Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention reveal that some 30 per cent of suicide victims under the age of 15 were enrolled in Band One schools, suggesting that academic peer pressurestress arising from competition with high-achieving classmates學業同儕壓力 may weigh most heavily precisely where expectations are highest. Nevertheless, education authorities caution against viewing school banding alone as the root cause, noting that parental expectations and students' own self-imposed expectationsstandards a person sets for themselves, often unrealistically high自我要求 compound the pressure considerably.

By the same token, schools have not been passive in the face of this crisis. A Three-tier School-based Emergency Mechanism, regularisedmade a standard, permanent part of practice rather than a temporary measure常規化 across all secondary schools during the 2025/26 school year, has now been extended on a trial basis to upper primary levels, offering earlier identification of at-risk studentsindividuals identified as being in particular danger of harm高危學生 and swifter referral to counselling. Even so, commentators insist that lasting change demands more than emergency intervention: it requires a fundamental shift towards fostering resiliencehelping someone develop the ability to recover from difficulty培養抗逆力 and genuine emotional well-beinga state of psychological and emotional health情緒健康 throughout a child's schooling, rather than treating mental health merely as a crisis to be managed after the fact.

vocab.sample: Educators warn that the mental health crisis among teenagers requires urgent, coordinated intervention.
Schools are being trained to recognise early warning signs of self-harm among students.
Hong Kong's examination-oriented culture is often blamed for excessive student stress.
Teachers report that exam-related strain has intensified noticeably since the start of term.
Competition to enter a Band One school can place enormous strain on primary pupils.
Schools have been told to identify vulnerable pupils earlier through routine wellbeing check-ins.
Every secondary school in Hong Kong now provides on-site counselling services.
Researchers argue that strong family ties can act as a buffer against stress for students under pressure.
Suicide prevention hotlines have seen a marked rise in calls from teenagers.
Schools are being urged to prioritise emotional well-being alongside academic results.
A robust support mechanism can identify struggling students before a crisis develops.
Early identification of at-risk students allows for swifter referral to counselling.

phrases.en: treat grades as a proxy for self-worth
phrases.zh: 將成績視為自我價值的代名詞
phrases.sample: Many teenagers are taught, implicitly, to treat grades as a proxy for self-worth.

phrases.en: a warning sign dismissed as a personal failing
phrases.zh: 將警號誤當作個人缺失而被忽視
phrases.sample: Too often a warning sign is dismissed as a personal failing rather than a cry for help.

phrases.en: crisis response that arrives after the damage is done
phrases.zh: 危機應變在傷害已造成後才展開
phrases.sample: Critics argue schools still rely on crisis response that arrives after the damage is done.

phrases.en: pressure that compounds rather than cancels out
phrases.zh: 壓力互相疊加而非互相抵銷
phrases.sample: Parental and peer expectations create pressure that compounds rather than cancels out.

phrases.en: a safety net stretched thin across more grade levels
phrases.zh: 安全網擴展至更多年級卻愈見單薄
phrases.sample: Extending the mechanism to primary schools risks a safety net stretched thin across more grade levels.

phrases.en: normalise asking for help before a crisis hits
phrases.zh: 在危機發生前已將求助視為平常事
phrases.sample: Schools are being urged to normalise asking for help before a crisis hits.

phrases.en: measure a school's success by more than exam results
phrases.zh: 以超越考試成績的標準衡量學校表現
phrases.sample: Reformers want Hong Kong to measure a school's success by more than exam results.

phrases.en: a culture where falling behind feels like failure
phrases.zh: 在這種文化下，稍為落後已感覺如同失敗
phrases.sample: Band One pupils describe a culture where falling behind feels like failure.

phrases.en: build coping capacity long before the exam season
phrases.zh: 在考試季來臨前已建立應對能力
phrases.sample: Counsellors recommend schools build coping capacity long before the exam season begins.

phrases.en: shift from managing crises to preventing them
phrases.zh: 由處理危機轉向預防危機
phrases.sample: Commentators insist the real reform is a shift from managing crises to preventing them.

phrases.en: expectations that outpace a child's own coping resources
phrases.zh: 期望超越孩子本身的應對能力
phrases.sample: Self-imposed expectations that outpace a child's own coping resources can prove dangerous.

phrases.en: a wellbeing agenda that outlasts a single emergency mechanism
phrases.zh: 一項不止於單一應急機制的身心健康議程
phrases.sample: Experts want a wellbeing agenda that outlasts a single emergency mechanism.

articles.summary_zh_html:
今年九月，香港學生重返校園，卻籠罩在悲劇之中。在新學年開始首週內，全港至少有七宗學生自我傷害或自殺個案，其中三宗不幸死亡。普遍認為，這些事件雖然單獨看來已令人痛心，但其實反映出本港教育文化中一個更根深蒂固的系統性問題——學業成就幾乎等同於個人價值。

評論者認為，香港極度以考試為導向的文化，令難以追趕進度的學生幾乎沒有喘息空間。香港大學防止自殺研究中心所整理的數據顯示，15歲以下自殺死者中約30%就讀於第一組別學校，顯示學業同儕壓力在期望最高的地方反而最為沉重。然而，教育當局警告不應單純將學校組別視為根本成因，並指出家長的期望及學生本身自我要求亦大大加重了壓力。

同樣道理，學校在這場危機面前並非坐視不理。三層學校支援機制在2025/26學年於全港中學常規化後，現已擴展至高小試行，以更早識別高危學生，並更迅速轉介輔導服務。即使如此，評論員堅持，持久的改變需要的不止於緊急介入：必須從根本上轉向在學生整個求學階段培養抗逆力及真正的情緒健康，而非只將精神健康視為事後才處理的危機。

cover_text.zh_sub: 考試文化下的心理健康警號
cover_text.en: Hong Kong confronts a deepening student mental health crisis

articles.headline: Food Poisoning Cluster Sickens 39 at Sha Tin Primary School, Prompting Scrutiny of Lunch Suppliers
articles.summary_html:
An investigation is under way after 39 pupils and staff at a Sha Tin primary school fell ill following a school lunch, in what health officials describe as a suspected food poisoning clustera group of illness cases traced to a common contaminated source食物中毒羣組. The affected group, comprising 37 pupils aged five to eleven and two staff members, had eaten a catered midday meal of soy-braised chicken drumsticks and long pasta at Baptist (Sha Tin Wai) Lui Ming Choi Primary School on 9 September before developing abdominal painpain or discomfort in the stomach area腹痛 and diarrhoea between eight and twenty-two hours later.

According to the Centre for Health Protection, two of the affected pupils sought medical attention but did not require hospital admissionbeing formally admitted to hospital for treatment住院 and have since remained in stable condition, while the remaining cases presented only mild symptoms. It is widely argued that classroom-based lunch portioningthe practice of dividing and serving catered meals inside individual classrooms rather than a central kitchen課室分餐模式, in which catered food is divided among pupils inside the classroom rather than under closer kitchen supervision, may heighten the risk of cross-contaminationthe transfer of harmful bacteria from one food item or surface to another交叉污染 once meals leave the supplier's premises.

Danny Catering Service, the school's lunch supplier, described the outbreak as an isolated incidentan event that occurred on its own, without being part of a wider or recurring pattern單一事件 and has since announced it will discontinue the classroom portioning arrangement at the affected school. Nevertheless, the episode has reignited debate over whether Hong Kong's school lunch suppliers are subject to sufficiently rigorous food safety standardsstrict rules and procedures designed to prevent contamination and illness嚴格的食物安全標準. Parent groups have called on the Education Bureau to conduct unannounced inspections of catering contractors, arguing that public confidence in school meal safety cannot rest on suppliers' assurances alone.

vocab.sample: Health officials moved quickly to trace the source of the food poisoning cluster.
Several pupils complained of abdominal pain shortly after lunch.
Fortunately, none of the affected pupils required hospital admission.
Proper food handling reduces the risk of cross-contamination in catering kitchens.
The supplier insisted the outbreak was an isolated incident rather than a systemic failure.
Stricter food safety standards could prevent similar outbreaks in future.
The Education Bureau is reviewing its list of approved catering contractors.
The incident has shaken parental trust in the vetting of school lunch suppliers.
Parent groups are demanding unannounced inspections of school kitchens.
The outbreak investigation focused on the preparation of the chicken dish.
Caterers are required to follow a stringent hygiene protocol when preparing meals.
Better supply chain oversight could catch contamination before food reaches schools.

phrases.en: a lapse that slips past the kitchen door
phrases.zh: 疏忽在離開廚房後仍未被發現
phrases.sample: Investigators suspect a lapse that slips past the kitchen door rather than a failure inside it.

phrases.en: treat an outbreak as a one-off rather than a pattern
phrases.zh: 將事件視為單一個案而非重複出現的問題
phrases.sample: The supplier was quick to treat the outbreak as a one-off rather than a pattern.

phrases.en: shift the point of failure from kitchen to classroom
phrases.zh: 將問題根源由廚房轉移至課室
phrases.sample: Health officials suggest the incident may shift the point of failure from kitchen to classroom.

phrases.en: reassurance that stops short of proof
phrases.zh: 保證未有具體證據支持
phrases.sample: Parent groups say the caterer's statement is reassurance that stops short of proof.

phrases.en: put a single supplier's word above independent checks
phrases.zh: 單憑供應商一面之詞而缺乏獨立核實
phrases.sample: Critics argue schools still put a single supplier's word above independent checks.

phrases.en: a gap between catering and serving that invites risk
phrases.zh: 配餐與送餐之間的缺口招致風險
phrases.sample: Classroom portioning exposed a gap between catering and serving that invites risk.

phrases.en: symptoms that surface long after the bell has rung
phrases.zh: 症狀在放學後許久才浮現
phrases.sample: Several pupils developed symptoms that surface long after the bell has rung for the day.

phrases.en: quietly end a practice rather than publicly justify it
phrases.zh: 悄悄終止做法而非公開解釋原因
phrases.sample: The supplier chose to quietly end a practice rather than publicly justify it.

phrases.en: leave parents to police food safety themselves
phrases.zh: 讓家長自行監察食物安全
phrases.sample: Without unannounced checks, the system leaves parents to police food safety themselves.

phrases.en: a contractor's assurance is not the same as a regulator's check
phrases.zh: 承辦商的保證不等於監管機構的查核
phrases.sample: Officials are reminded that a contractor's assurance is not the same as a regulator's check.

phrases.en: catch a hazard before it reaches a lunchbox
phrases.zh: 在危害送到飯盒前已加以截停
phrases.sample: Stricter inspection regimes aim to catch a hazard before it reaches a lunchbox.

phrases.en: demand a paper trail from kitchen to classroom
phrases.zh: 要求從廚房到課室的完整紀錄
phrases.sample: Parent groups now demand a paper trail from kitchen to classroom for every catered meal.

articles.summary_zh_html:
沙田一所小學有39名師生在食用午膳後感到不適，當局正展開調查，衞生官員形容事件為懷疑食物中毒羣組。受影響人數包括37名年齡五至十一歲的學生及兩名教職員，他們於9月9日在浸信會（沙田圍）呂明才小學食用了外購的豉油雞髀配長通粉午膳，其後八至二十二小時內出現腹痛及腹瀉。

根據衞生防護中心資料，兩名受影響學生曾求醫，但無需住院，情況穩定，其餘個案僅屬輕微。普遍認為，課室分餐模式——即由供應商送抵的外購飯餐在課室內分發給學生，而非在廚房受更嚴密監管的情況下分配——可能令食物離開供應商後更容易出現交叉污染的風險。

學校的午膳供應商「丹尼餐飲服務」形容事件為單一事件，並已表示將在受影響學校取消課室分餐安排。然而，事件再次引發爭論，質疑香港學校午膳供應商是否受到足夠嚴格的食物安全標準監管。家長組織已要求教育局對膳食承辦商進行突擊巡查，認為公眾對學校午膳安全的信心不能單靠供應商的保證。

cover_text.zh_sub: 課室分餐模式惹交叉污染疑慮
cover_text.en: Food poisoning cluster at Sha Tin school raises supplier scrutiny

articles.headline: Hong Kong to Grant Foreign Firms Equal Mainland Market Access Under Third CEPA Revision
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong is set to overhaul its free trade arrangementmake major structural changes to an existing trade agreement全面革新自由貿易安排 with the mainland for a third time, in a move authorities say will make the city more attractive to international investors. Commerce Secretary Algernon Yau announced that under the third revision to the Closer Economic Partnership Arrangement, or CEPA, foreign companies manufacturing goods in Hong Kong will be granted preferential mainland market accessspecial, more favourable conditions for entering and trading in the mainland Chinese market優惠的內地市場准入 on equal terms with local Hong Kong firms.

Under the proposed amendment, foreign-invested manufacturers will be eligible for zero-tariff entrythe ability to import goods without paying any customs duty零關稅准入 into the mainland, provided their products meet the criteria for "Made in Hong Kong" origin. It is widely argued that this represents a significant departure from previous rounds of CEPA, which had largely reserved such benefits for companies with substantial local Hong Kong ownership. Critics of the status quothe existing state of affairs before a change is introduced現狀 had long complained that international firms based in the city faced an uneven playing field compared with mainland-linked competitors.

By the same token, the revision forms part of a broader commitment outlined in Hong Kong's first Five-Year Plana government document setting out development goals and policy direction over a five-year period五年規劃, which pledged to pursue a comprehensive upgrade of CEPA and deepen cooperation with mainland service sectors. Analysts suggest that by lowering barriers for foreign direct investmentmoney invested by an overseas company or individual into productive assets within another economy外商直接投資, Hong Kong hopes to reinforce its position as a gateway connecting international capital with the vast mainland consumer market, at a time when the city faces intensifying competition from rival regional trading hubsother cities or economies competing to serve as centres of international trade區域貿易樞紐 such as Singapore and Shenzhen.

vocab.sample: The free trade arrangement is designed to reduce barriers between the two economies.
Preferential market access gives local firms a considerable competitive advantage.
Zero-tariff entry significantly lowers the cost of exporting goods to the mainland.
Foreign direct investment remains a key driver of Hong Kong's economic growth.
Hong Kong has long positioned itself as Asia's premier trading hub.
A clear regulatory framework reassures investors considering entry into a new market.
