香港今年的中秋慶祝活動,在大坑舞火龍——這項傳統已踏入第147屆——再次穿梭於銅鑾灣狹窄街巷之際,迎來高潮。一條長67米、插滿逾一萬二千支燃亮線香的火龍,由約三百名舞者高舉,連續三晚沿浣紗街及銅鑾灣道蜈蚣式舞動,吸引大批市民前來觀賞這項自1880年起大致保持不變的傳統。

普遍相信,這項已列入國家級非物質文化遺產名錄的儀式,最初是因應多年前一場瘟疫侵襲村落而設,目的是驅除厄運。然而,這項傳統在過去數十年間經歷不少演變,今年更以一場壓軸巡遊進駐維多利亞公園作結,火龍與首次在該場地舉行的國際花燈展同場亮相。壓軸路段的預留座位門票早已售罄,但主辦方確保街頭觀賞依然免費開放予所有人。

同樣地,這個節慶亦凸顯出香港在保存古老習俗與迎合現代旅遊需求之間,須取得的微妙平衡。社區長老認為,跨代參與——讓兒童手持LED迷你火龍,與資深舞者並肩同行——是讓這些傳承習俗得以延續,而非逐漸式微並被淘汰的關鍵。對於正在研習香港文化身份的學生而言,舞火龍提供了一個生動的案例,說明傳統如何能靠積極的社區參與,而非單純懷舊之情,得以延續下去。

articles.headline: Policy Address Unveils Northern Metropolis Push and New 'AI City Brain'
articles.summary_html:
Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu delivered his fifth Policy Address on Wednesday, unveilingto reveal or present something publicly for the first time揭示；公開推出 a blueprint billed as ‘A Strategic Vision for a Bright New Era.’ It is anchored infirmly based on or connected to something以……為基礎 Hong Kong’s inaugural Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development (2026-2030), which sets out ambitious targets for reshaping the city’s economy and skyline alike. Central to this vision is the Northern Metropolis, a vast development spanning some 300 square kilometres near the border with mainland China, which Mr Lee confirmed would see all nine of its New Development Areas break ground in the coming year.

By the same token, the government pledged to modernise city governance through an ambitious “AI City Brain”, an integrated management system designed to streamlineto make a process simpler or more efficient使（程序）更簡化、更有效率 everything from traffic flow to emergency response. Officials also committed to replacing or rehabilitating 350 kilometres of ageing infrastructurepublic facilities and systems that are old and deteriorating老化的基礎設施, including corroded water mains, over the next five years. Nearby, a Northern Metropolis University Town spanning more than 1,000 hectares is envisaged as a hub for interdisciplinary research, with a new MTR station near the Hong Kong Science Park expected to strengthen the area’s role as a magnet for talent and investmentsomething that strongly attracts capable people and money人才與投資的磁石.

It is widely argued that the success of such initiatives will ultimately be judged by whether ordinary residents feel the benefits in their daily lives. Once fully developed, the Northern Metropolis is projected to house 2.5 million people and generate 650,000 jobs, offering secondary students a tangiblereal, concrete, and able to be clearly perceived實在的；具體可見的 glimpse of the careers and communities that may await them. Critics contend, nevertheless, that delivering on such a sprawling agendaa very large, wide-ranging plan or set of goals龐大而分散的議程 within budget and on schedule will prove to be no small feat.

同樣地,政府承諾透過雄心勃勃的「AI城市大腦」革新城市管治——這是一套綜合管理系統,旨在簡化由交通流量到緊急應變等各方面的運作。官員亦承諾在未來五年,更換或修復三百五十公里的老化基礎設施,包括已經鏽蝕的水管。附近佔地逾一千公頃的北部都會區大學城,則被設想為跨學科研究的樞紐,鄰近香港科學園的新港鐵站,預期將進一步強化該區作為人才與投資磁石的角色。

輿論普遍認為,這些措施能否成功,最終要視乎普通居民能否在日常生活中切身感受到成果。北部都會區全面發展後,預計可容納二百五十萬人口,並創造六十五萬個職位,為中學生提供一個實在的機會,一窺未來可能等待著他們的事業與社區。然而批評者認為,要在預算及時間表之內完成這個龐大而分散的議程,絕非易事。

articles.headline: Hong Kong's Largest Public Hospital to Open in Phases From October
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's largest public hospital is finally set to swing open its doorsto officially open and begin operating正式開放；開始運作 next week, as Kai Tak Hospital begins accepting patients in phases from 5 October. The Specialist Out-patient Clinic Block and the Oncology Block will be the first to launch, with follow-up consultations, blood-drawing services and the Family Medicine Integrated Centre transferred progressively from the nearby Queen Elizabeth Hospital. Once fully operational, Kai Tak Hospital will boast a gross floor areathe total built area of a building, floor by floor建築總樓面面積 of 500,000 square metres and 2,400 beds, making it the largest healthcare hub in the city by both measures.

It is widely argued that the new facility could not come at a more opportune time. The hospital is designed to relieve pressure onto reduce the burden or strain placed on something緩解……的壓力 Queen Elizabeth Hospital, which has long struggled with overcrowding, and will serve as the flagship of the Kowloon Central Cluster, covering Yau Tsim Mong, Kowloon City, Wong Tai Sin and Kwun Tong districts, home to more than 1.8 million residents. The Hospital Authority has set up a dedicated teama group of staff assigned specifically to one task專責小組 to contact affected patients directly, notifying them of new appointment details by phone, text message, post and its mobile application.

Nevertheless, health officials have cautioned that the transition will take time, with full inpatient care, surgery and round-the-clock accident and emergency services not scheduled until 2028. Critics contend that the phased rolloutthe gradual introduction of something in stages rather than all at once分階段推行 may cause short-term confusion among patients, particularly the elderly. By the same token, few dispute that the hospital represents a significant milestonean important stage or achievement in a process重要的里程碑 in Hong Kong's efforts to expand and modernise its public healthcare system for the coming decades.

The floor area expansion allows the hospital to house thousands more patients each year.
Overcrowding in emergency wards remains a persistent problem in winter.
The flagship hospital coordinates services across several smaller clinics in the district.

Once complete, the medical campus will house some of the busiest specialist clinics in the city.

Opening a second clinic should relieve pressure on the main hospital.

香港最大型的公立醫院終將於下週正式啟用，啟德醫院將由十月五日起分階段接收病人。專科門診大樓及腫瘤科大樓將率先啟用，覆診、抽血服務及家庭醫學綜合中心亦會逐步從鄰近的伊利沙伯醫院轉移過來。啟德醫院全面運作後，建築總樓面面積將達五十萬平方米，設有二千四百張病床，無論在面積或床數方面均成為全港最大的醫療樞紐，而這一切均始於下週的正式啟用。

普遍認為，新醫院的啟用時機可謂恰到好處。醫院旨在為長期人滿為患的伊利沙伯醫院緩解壓力，並將成為九龍中聯網的旗艦醫院，服務油尖旺、九龍城、黃大仙及觀塘四區合共逾一百八十萬名居民。醫院管理局已成立專責小組直接聯絡受影響的病人，透過電話、短訊、郵寄信件及手機應用程式通知他們新的覆診安排。

然而，衛生官員警告，整個過渡需時，全面住院服務、手術及全天候急症服務預計要到二零二八年才能提供。評論者認為，分階段推行可能會在短期內令病人，尤其是長者感到困惑。同樣道理，鮮有人質疑，這所醫院標誌著香港未來數十年擴展及現代化公共醫療系統的重要里程碑。

articles.headline: Hong Kong Inflation Holds at 1.7% as Utility and Transport Costs Bite
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's Census and Statistics Department reported this week that the Composite Consumer Price Index rose 1.7 percent year-on-year in August, matching July's increase and meeting market expectations. Excluding the effect of one-off government relief measures, the underlying inflation ratethe rate of price increase after removing temporary distortions such as subsidies基本通脹率 stood at 1.9 percent, unchanged from the previous month. It is widely argued that the figures reflect an economy that continues to hum along steadily, even as certain household expensesthe costs a family regularly pays for daily living住戶開支 climbed sharply.

Nevertheless, not all categories moved in the same direction. Electricity, gas and water charges surged 11.5 percent compared with a year earlier, by far the steepest rise of any component, while miscellaneous services and transport costs increased 4.7 percent and 3.9 percent respectively. By the same token, the cost of eating out and durable goods edged up only modestly, and housing costs, which make up a significant share of the basketthe proportion that an item represents within a set of goods used to measure prices在（物價）籃子中所佔的比例, rose by a mere 0.1 percent.

Critics contend that the headline figure understates the squeeze on household budgetsthe financial pressure felt by families as costs rise faster than income對家庭預算的壓力, given how disproportionately utility bills have climbed. The government has since revised its full-year forecast upward, now projecting headline inflation of 2.6 percent for 2026, while Standard Chartered raised its own estimate to 2.1 percent, citing higher energy and imported input prices. This comes against a backdrop of robust economic growthstrong and healthy expansion of the economy強勁的經濟增長, with gross domestic product having expanded 5.9 percent in the first quarter, its best performance in five years.

vocab.sample: The Consumer Price Index is the main gauge used to track inflation in Hong Kong.
The underlying inflation rate excludes the impact of temporary government subsidies.
Retail sales grew 5 percent year-on-year in the latest quarter.
Rising household expenses have forced many families to cut back on dining out.
Utility bills have risen sharply because of higher global energy prices.
The squeeze on household budgets has become a major concern for policymakers.
Gross domestic product measures the total value of goods and services produced.
Robust economic growth has helped keep unemployment at a historic low.

Economists expect price momentum to ease slightly in the final quarter of the year.
The company's profits came in meeting market expectations.
Analysts have revised their full-year forecast for inflation upward.

phrases.zh: 掩蓋各類開支承受壓力不均的情況
phrases.sample: The modest headline rate masks uneven pressure across spending categories such as utilities and transport.

phrases.en: outpace wage growth for ordinary households

phrases.sample: Once relief measures expire, households may no longer be cushioned from the full blow of rising prices.

phrases.sample: Lower-income tenants often bear the brunt of surging utility charges each winter.

phrases.sample: A single headline figure can tell only part of the inflation story facing families.

phrases.sample: Critics warn that the modest headline rate offers a misleadingly reassuring picture of household finances.

phrases.en: track price movements item by item
phrases.zh: 逐項追蹤價格變動
phrases.sample: Statisticians track price movements item by item to build the consumer price index.

phrases.en: signal resilience despite global headwinds
phrases.zh: 顯示即使面對全球不利因素仍具韌性
phrases.sample: Strong first-quarter growth signals resilience despite global headwinds facing the city.

phrases.en: strain budgets already stretched thin
phrases.zh: 令本已拮据的家庭開支百上加斤
phrases.sample: Rising transport fares further strain budgets already stretched thin for commuting families.

phrases.en: widen the gap between official statistics and lived experience
phrases.zh: 擴大官方統計數字與市民實際感受之間的差距
phrases.sample: Some economists worry the data widens the gap between official statistics and lived experience.

phrases.en: point to a broader cost-of-living squeeze
phrases.zh: 反映更廣泛的生活成本壓力
phrases.sample: The sharp rise in utility bills points to a broader cost-of-living squeeze across the city.

articles.summary_zh_html:
政府統計處本週公布，綜合消費物價指數八月份按年上升百分之一點七，升幅與七月相同，亦符合市場預期。若扣除一次性政府紓困措施的影響，基本通脹率維持於百分之一點九，與上月持平。普遍認為，這組數字反映經濟持續平穩運行，即使部分住戶開支已顯著攀升。

然而，並非所有類別都朝同一方向變動。電力、燃氣及水費按年急升百分之十一點五，是眾多項目中升幅最大的一項，而雜項服務及交通費則分別上升百分之四點七及百分之三點九。同樣道理，外出用膳及耐用品價格僅溫和上升，而在物價籃子中所佔份額顯著的房屋開支，升幅僅得百分之零點一。

評論者認為，整體通脹數字低估了家庭預算所承受的壓力，因為水電煤費用的升幅明顯不成比例。政府已將全年預測上調，現時預計二零二六年整體通脹率為百分之二點六，渣打銀行亦將其預測上調至百分之二點一，理由是能源及進口原材料價格上升。這一切正值經濟增長強勁之際，首季本地生產總值增長百分之五點九，是五年來最佳表現。

cover_text.en: Inflation holds steady as utility bills surge

articles.headline: Hong Kong Opens First Dedicated Psychiatric Facility for Children and Teenagers
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong has unveiled its first psychiatric facility dedicated exclusively to patients under the age of 18, marking a significant expansion of youth mental health services at the newly redeveloped Kwai Chung Hospital. The Child and Adolescent Block forms part of a wider redevelopment schemea large-scale project to rebuild and modernise existing facilities重建計劃 that has increased the hospital's total floor area from 80,000 to 134,000 square metres, allowing it to eventually provide 1,000 beds for psychiatric patients of all ages.

It is widely argued that the facility's design reflects a deliberate shift towards more therapeutic environmentssettings specifically designed to aid recovery and healing具療癒作用的環境. Wards feature spacious six-bedded and single rooms, each equipped with an en-suite bathrooma bathroom directly connected to and accessible only from a bedroom套內浴室, while every ward opens onto a garden where young patients may relax outdoors accompanied by healthcare staff. Outpatient psychiatric services began relocating to the new blocks in stages from March, with inpatient wards following from late July.

Nevertheless, the timing carries added weight, given growing alarm over student wellbeing since the start of the new school term. Critics contend that infrastructure alone cannot resolvephysical facilities by themselves are insufficient to fix an underlying problem單靠基建設施無法解決 a crisis rooted in academic pressure, housing unaffordability and digital overload. By the same token, mental health advocates have broadly welcomed the new facility as a long-overdue stepping stonean action or event that helps achieve a longer-term goal踏腳石；邁向目標的一步 towards a healthcare system better equipped to support Hong Kong's younger generation.

phrases.sample: Critics say new wards fall short of tackling root causes outside the hospital, like exam pressure.

phrases.sample: Health advocates treat bricks and mortar as only half the answer to the youth mental health crisis.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港首間專為十八歲以下病人而設的精神科設施正式揭幕，標誌著青少年精神健康服務在重建後的葵涌醫院大幅擴展。兒童及青少年病人大樓屬於一項更大規模重建計劃的一部分，該計劃已令醫院的總樓面面積由八萬平方米增至十三萬四千平方米，最終將可為各年齡層的精神科病人提供一千張病床。

普遍認為，這所設施的設計反映出有意識地轉向更具療癒作用的環境。病房設有寬敞的六人房及單人房，每個房間均配備套內浴室，而每個病房均可通往花園，讓年輕病人可在醫護人員陪同下到戶外放鬆身心。門診精神科服務已自三月起分階段遷往新大樓，住院病房則由七月底起跟進。

然而，鑒於新學年開學以來，社會對學生福祉的憂慮日益加劇，這項設施的啟用時機更顯重要。評論者認為，單靠基建設施無法解決一場根源於學業壓力、居住成本高昂及數碼超負荷的危機。同樣道理，精神健康倡導者普遍歡迎這所新設施，視之為邁向一個更有能力支援香港新一代的醫療系統的遲來的踏腳石。

cover_text.en: Hong Kong opens first youth psychiatric ward

articles.headline: Over half of HK entrepreneurs see AI as catalyst for workforce growth: HSBC
articles.summary_html:
A recent survey commissioned by HSBC has found that more than half of Hong Kong's entrepreneurs regard artificial intelligence as a catalystsomething that causes rapid change or action促成因素；催化劑 for workforce growth rather than a threat to employment. According to the findings, 58 percent of local business owners expect the adoptionthe act of starting to use something new採用；採納 of AI tools to increase headcount over the next two years, a proportion markedly higher than the global average.

It is widely argued that this optimism reflects a shift in how small and medium-sized enterprises in the city perceiveto become aware of or understand something察覺；理解 automation. Rather than viewing AI as a means of supplantingto take the place of, especially through force or scheming取代；排擠 human staff, many firms now see it as a way to augmentto make something greater by adding to it增加；提升 productivity, freeing employees to focus on higher-value tasks such as client relations and strategic planning. Sectors including retail, logistics and financial services are reportedly leading this trend, deploying AI-powered chatbots, data analytics platforms and inventory systems.

Nevertheless, critics contend that the benefits of AI adoption are not evenly distributed. Entry-level and routine clerical positions remain particularly vulnerablecapable of being easily harmed or affected易受影響的；脆弱的 to displacementthe forced removal of someone or something from their usual place取代；裁減, raising concerns for young jobseekers, including secondary school leavers, who may find it harder to secure a foothold in the labour market. By the same token, education authorities have been urged to prioritiseto treat something as more important than other things優先處理 digital literacy and critical thinking in the curriculum, equipping students with the adaptabilitythe quality of being able to adjust to new conditions適應能力 needed to thrive alongside, rather than in competition with, intelligent machines. As Hong Kong positions itself as an innovation and technology hub, the ability of its workforce to upskill continuously will likely prove decisive.

vocab.sample: Many business owners plan to retrain staff rather than cut headcount as AI tools take on routine tasks.
Entry-level positions in clerical work are among the most susceptible to automation.
Graduates often struggle to gain a foothold in an increasingly competitive labour market.
Routine clerical work is gradually being taken over by AI-powered software.
The retailer installed an AI-driven inventory system to reduce stock shortages.
Many banks now rely on chatbots to handle straightforward customer enquiries around the clock.
The survey suggests the hiring landscape is shifting towards hybrid human-AI roles rather than straightforward job losses.
Small and medium-sized enterprises are adopting AI tools to cut costs and boost efficiency.
The company plans to increase its headcount next year despite growing automation.
Freed from repetitive tasks, managers can devote more time to strategic planning.
Employees who learn to collaborate with intelligent machines are likely to remain indispensable.
Officials say workforce adaptability will decide who thrives alongside AI and who is left behind.

phrases.sample: Many bosses now treat automation as an amplifier of staff, not a substitute for them.

phrases.en: free up employees for higher-value work
phrases.zh: 讓員工騰出時間處理更高價值的工作

phrases.sample: Local optimism about AI hiring outstrips the global average by a wide margin.

phrases.sample: Routine automation leaves school leavers competing with software for a first job.

phrases.zh: 將人手增長轉向較高技術的職能
phrases.sample: Firms say they expect headcount growth, but shifted towards higher-skill functions.

phrases.sample: The findings put curriculum reform on an urgent footing for secondary schools.

phrases.sample: Graduates are being urged to coexist with intelligent systems rather than compete against them.

phrases.sample: The survey recasts local SMEs as early adopters rather than laggards of workplace AI.

phrases.sample: Officials tie the city's future competitiveness to continuous upskilling of its workforce.

articles.summary_zh_html:
滙豐委託進行的最新調查發現，超過一半香港企業家認為人工智能是推動人力增長的催化劑，而非對就業構成的威脅。調查結果顯示，百分之五十八的本地企業主預期，未來兩年內採用人工智能工具將會增加員工人數，這一比例明顯高於全球平均水平。

普遍認為，這種樂觀態度反映本港中小企看待自動化的方式出現轉變。許多企業不再將人工智能視為取代人力的手段，反而視之為提升生產力的方法，讓員工騰出時間專注於更高價值的工作，例如客戶關係及策略規劃。據報零售、物流及金融服務等行業正帶領這股趨勢，紛紛引入人工智能聊天機械人、數據分析平台及存貨系統。

然而，評論者認為人工智能帶來的好處並非平均分佈。入門級及日常文書職位尤其脆弱，容易面臨取代的風險，令包括中學畢業生的年輕求職者更難在勞動市場站穩陣腳，令人憂慮。同樣道理，教育當局被促優先在課程中加強數碼素養及批判思考訓練，讓學生具備足夠的適應能力，能夠與智能機器並存發展，而非與其競爭。隨著香港力求定位為創新及科技樞紐，其勞動力能否持續提升技能，將可能成為關鍵所在。

cover_text.en: Most HK employers see AI boosting jobs, not cutting them

articles.headline: Gang conflict over 'space oil' market triggers massive street brawl in Tin Shui Wai
articles.summary_html:
A mass street brawl in Tin Shui Wai, reportedly linked to a dispute over the illicit trade in "space oil" — a vape-based drug containing the anaesthetic etomidate — has renewed public debate over Hong Kong's ongoing battle against youth drug abuse. Footage of the clash, which showed a large group of men fighting in a public area, quickly circulatedspread widely among people, especially online流傳；傳播 on social media, prompting a police investigation into suspected organised crime involvement.

It is widely argued that incidents of this kind are symptomatic of a deeper, more troubling trend. Since the government outlawedmade something illegal將……列為非法 etomidate and several related substances, authorities have uncovered illicit laboratories manufacturing homemade versions of the drug, suggesting that demandthe desire of buyers for a particular product需求 among young users has not abatedbecome less intense or widespread減弱；減退. Health researchers note that a detoxification centre recently found that around ten percent of its caseload involved space oil abuse, with half of those affected being minors — the youngest only twelve years old.

Critics contend that public understanding of the drug's dangers remains alarmingly limited. A survey of over 1,600 residents found that nearly a third of respondents were unaware of its harmful effects, while fewer than three in ten could correctly identify its main ingredient. By the same token, medical professionals have warned that etomidate misuse has been linked to adrenal insufficiency, a potentially serious hormonal condition, among teenage users. Nevertheless, the recurrence of gang-related violence connected to the drug trade suggests that enforcementthe act of making sure laws are obeyed執法 measures alone may be insufficient. Educators and parents alike are being urged to engage young people in frank conversations about substance abuse before curiosity turns into dependencythe state of relying on something, especially a harmful substance依賴；上癮.

vocab.sample: Police have stepped up efforts to dismantle the illicit trade in banned substances.
Schools are introducing new programmes to raise awareness of substance abuse among teenagers.
Investigators suspect that organised crime groups are behind the illegal drug network.
The detoxification centre reported a sharp rise in cases involving teenage patients.
Protecting minors from exposure to drugs remains a key policy priority.
Doctors diagnosed the teenager with a rare hormonal condition linked to drug misuse.
Law enforcement agencies have intensified patrols in areas known for drug activity.
Youth drug experimentation often begins with curiosity rather than addiction.
Police say school outreach talks will be expanded following the brawl to warn teenagers about the drug's dangers.
The brawl raised fresh concerns about public safety in residential neighbourhoods.
Experts argue that addressing the underlying causes of addiction is more effective than punishment alone.
Curiosity alone can sometimes lead teenagers to experiment with dangerous substances.

phrases.en: fuel a troubling drug subculture among minors
phrases.zh: 助長未成年人之間令人憂慮的毒品次文化
phrases.sample: The brawl has drawn attention to a troubling drug subculture fuelled among minors.

phrases.en: outpace the reach of new legislation
phrases.zh: 增長速度超越新立法的規範範圍
phrases.sample: Homemade variants of the drug seem to outpace the reach of new legislation banning it.

phrases.en: spill over into open street violence
phrases.zh: 蔓延成公開的街頭暴力
phrases.sample: Disputes over the illicit trade have spilled over into open street violence in the district.

phrases.en: leave the public dangerously uninformed
phrases.zh: 令公眾對危害危險地缺乏認知
phrases.sample: The survey findings leave the public dangerously uninformed about the drug's real risks.

phrases.en: slip through gaps left by outdated bans
phrases.zh: 乘過時禁令的漏洞而逃過規管
phrases.sample: New synthetic variants slip through gaps left by outdated bans on specific substances.

phrases.en: treat enforcement as only one piece of the puzzle
phrases.zh: 視執法僅為解決問題的其中一環
phrases.sample: Officials now treat enforcement as only one piece of the puzzle in tackling youth drug abuse.

phrases.en: normalise casual experimentation among teenagers
phrases.zh: 令青少年之間的隨意嘗試變得普遍
phrases.sample: Easy access to vape-based drugs risks normalising casual experimentation among teenagers.

phrases.en: expose a widening gap in parental awareness
phrases.zh: 揭示家長認知方面日益擴大的差距
phrases.sample: The case exposes a widening gap in parental awareness of new synthetic drugs.

phrases.en: trigger a cycle of rivalry and retaliation
phrases.zh: 觸發一連串的爭奪與報復
phrases.sample: Competition over the illicit market has triggered a cycle of rivalry and retaliation between gangs.

phrases.en: mistake silence for safety
phrases.zh: 誤將沉默當作安全
phrases.sample: Parents who assume their children are unaffected may be mistaking silence for safety.

phrases.en: demand a coordinated response beyond policing
phrases.zh: 需要警方以外的協調應對措施
phrases.sample: Tackling the problem will demand a coordinated response beyond policing alone.

phrases.en: chip away at years of public health messaging
phrases.zh: 逐步削弱多年來的公共衛生宣傳成效
phrases.sample: Viral footage of the brawl risks chipping away at years of public health messaging on drugs.

articles.summary_zh_html:
天水圍一場大規模街頭鬥殴事件，據報與非法買賣「太空油」（一種含有麻醉劑依託咪酯的電子煙毒品）的糾紛有關，重新引發社會對香港持續打擊青少年濫藥問題的討論。片段顯示一大批男子在公眾場所鬥殴，迅速在社交媒體上流傳，促使警方就懷疑涉及有組織罪案展開調查。

普遍認為，這類事件反映出一個更深層、更令人憂慮的趨勢。自政府將依託咪酯及多種相關物質列為非法以來，當局已偵破多個非法製毒工場，自製仿製版本的毒品，顯示年輕使用者的需求並未減退。健康研究人員指出，一間戒毒中心最近發現，約一成求助個案涉及濫用太空油，當中一半為未成年人，最年輕的僅十二歲。

評論者認為，公眾對這種毒品危害的了解仍然令人憂慮地不足。一項訪問逾一千六百名居民的調查發現，近三分之一受訪者不知道其有害影響，而能正確指出其主要成分的受訪者則不足三成。同樣道理，醫護人員警告，濫用依託咪酯與腎上腺功能不足有關，這是一種可能相當嚴重的荷爾蒙失調症，在青少年使用者中屢見不鮮。然而，與毒品買賣有關的黑幫暴力事件一再發生，顯示單靠執法措施或許並不足夠。教育工作者及家長均被促與年輕人坦誠討論濫藥問題，以免好奇心演變成依賴。

cover_text.en: Gang brawl over drug turf renews public concern

articles.headline: Hong Kong cuts the sky with a 23-minute National Day fireworks show
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong marked the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China with a 23-minute fireworks display over Victoria Harbour on the evening of 1 October, illuminatinglighting up or making something bright照亮 the skyline with more than 31,000 pyrotechnicrelating to fireworks or explosive devices used for display煙火的 shells. Organised by the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and exclusively sponsored by Sun Life Hong Kong, the show was staged under the theme "Eternal Radiance, Fireworks in Bloom," with an estimated budget of around HK$18 million.

It is widely argued that such large-scale celebrations serve a purpose beyond mere spectacle. The display was divided into eight segments, each choreographedcarefully planned and arranged in sequence精心編排的 to music and featuring intricatevery detailed or complicated in design複雜精細的 patterns including red hearts, golden five-pointed stars, and a newly designed sun-and-pendulum motif that had never previously been used in a Hong Kong fireworks show. Crowds gathered at popular vantage pointspositions that give a good view of something有利位置 including Tsim Sha Tsui, Central, Wan Chai and Causeway Bay, while others watched from the Hung Hom Bypass and nearby rooftops.

By the same token, the event is widely regarded as an opportunity to strengthen a sense of civic identity and shared heritagevalued traditions, qualities and culture passed down through generations傳統；文化遺產 among residents. Tourism officials noted that the National Day period, often called "Golden Week," typically brings a significant influx of mainland visitors, giving such spectacles added economic as well as symbolic significance. Nevertheless, some commentators have questioned whether the considerable cost of these displays might be better allocateddistributed or assigned for a particular purpose分配 to other community needs. Proponents counter that the fireworks generate immense goodwill and tourism revenue, and that such moments of collective celebration help to fosterto encourage the development of something培養；促進 unity in an increasingly fragmented society. As the final shells faded over the harbour, the event once again underscored Hong Kong's enduring role as a stage for grand civic spectacle.

vocab.sample: Spectators along the harbourfront spoke of a shared pride as the display lit up the night sky.
The fireworks show has become part of the city's festive heritage over the decades.
Thousands gathered at vantage points around the harbour to watch the fireworks.
The fireworks finale alone used several thousand shells choreographed to patriotic music.
Collective celebrations can foster a stronger sense of community belonging.
The annual fireworks show has become one of Hong Kong's signature civic spectacles.
Major festivals often generate substantial tourism revenue for the local economy.
The event carries symbolic significance beyond its immediate entertainment value.
Critics questioned whether the public expenditure on fireworks was justified.
Officials said events like this help strengthen a communal bond among residents from different backgrounds.
The fireworks were carefully choreographed to match the accompanying soundtrack.
The Golden Week holiday typically brings a significant influx of visitors to the city.

phrases.sample: The fireworks show doubles as a calculated display of soft power during Golden Week.

phrases.en: draw crowds to vantage points long before dusk
phrases.zh: 早在入夜前已吸引人群聚集觀賞點
phrases.sample: Families began drawing to vantage points long before dusk to secure a good view.

phrases.en: weigh civic spectacle against competing budget priorities
phrases.zh: 衡量公民盛事與其他開支優次之間的取捨
phrases.sample: Councillors must weigh civic spectacle against competing budget priorities each year.

phrases.en: lend the skyline a rare sense of occasion
phrases.zh: 為天際線添上難得的節日氣氛
phrases.sample: The synchronised fireworks lent the skyline a rare sense of occasion for one night.

phrases.en: turn a one-off show into lasting goodwill
phrases.zh: 將一次性的表演轉化為持久的善意
phrases.sample: Organisers hope to turn a one-off show into lasting goodwill towards the city.

phrases.en: coincide deliberately with a peak tourist season
phrases.zh: 刻意配合旅遊旺季舉行
phrases.sample: The display was timed to coincide deliberately with the Golden Week tourist season.

phrases.en: spark a recurring debate over public spending priorities
phrases.zh: 引發一場有關公共開支優次的循環爭論
phrases.sample: Lavish displays like this spark a recurring debate over public spending priorities.

phrases.en: stitch together music, light and civic pride
phrases.zh: 將音樂、燈光與公民自豪感交織在一起
phrases.sample: The eight-segment show stitched together music, light and civic pride into one spectacle.

phrases.en: reinforce a shared narrative of national belonging
phrases.zh: 強化一套共同的國家身份認同敍事
phrases.sample: Officials hope the display will reinforce a shared narrative of national belonging among residents.

phrases.en: convert a brief spectacle into measurable tourism gains
phrases.zh: 將短暫的盛事轉化為可量化的旅遊收益
phrases.sample: Tourism officials aim to convert a brief spectacle into measurable tourism gains each October.

phrases.en: defend lavish spending as money well spent
phrases.zh: 為高額開支辯護，稱物有所值
phrases.sample: Supporters defend the lavish spending on fireworks as money well spent on morale.

phrases.en: offer a moment of collective pause amid daily division
phrases.zh: 在日常分化中提供片刻的集體共聚時刻
phrases.sample: The show offered a moment of collective pause amid the city's daily division.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港在十月一日晚上以一場長達二十三分鐘的煙花匯演，在維多利亞港上空慶祝中華人民共和國成立七十七周年，逾三萬一千枚煙火彈照亮了天際線。這場由文化體育及旅遊局主辦、永明金融獨家贊助的匯演，以「盛世永輝 煙花綻放」為主題，預算約一千八百萬港元。

普遍認為，這類大型慶典的作用遠超單純的視覺享受。匯演分為八個環節，每個環節均配合音樂精心編排，並呈現複雜精細的圖案，包括紅心、金色五角星，以及一款從未在香港煙花表演中使用過的全新「日晨擺動」圖案。市民紛紛聚集於尖沙咀、中環、灣仔及銅鑼灣等熱門觀賞點，其餘則在紅磡繞道及附近天台觀賞。

同樣道理，這項活動被普遍視為增強市民公民身份認同及共同文化遺產的機會。旅遊業官員指出，國慶假期（俗稱「黃金週」）通常會帶來大量內地旅客，令這類盛事兼具經濟及象徵意義。然而，有評論者質疑，這些匯演所涉的高昂成本是否應該更好地分配至其他社區需要。支持者則反駁，煙花匯演能帶來龐大的善意及旅遊收入，而這類集體慶祝的時刻有助在日益分化的社會中培養團結精神。隨著最後一輪煙火在海港上空消散，這次活動再次凸顯香港作為大型公民盛事舞台的持久角色。

cover_text.en: Hong Kong marks National Day with harbour fireworks

articles.headline: Hong Kong official defends U-turn on public flats at Pak Shek Kok rail stop site
articles.summary_html:
The Development Bureau has come under renewed scrutiny after confirming a last-minute U-turna reversal of an earlier decision or policy政策上的大轉變 on plans for the new Pak Shek Kok railway station, with public housing quietly dropped from the site in favour of private flats. Permanent Secretary for Development Doris Ho Pui-ling told reporters on Friday that the station, part of the East Rail Line extension works and earmarkedset aside for a particular purpose指定用途的；預留的 to open as early as 2033, would instead be financed by allowing the project's developer to build and sell private housing on the surrounding land.

It is widely argued that such reversals undermine public trust in long-term planning, yet officials insisted the decision was pragmatic rather than political. Ho explained that the area around the proposed station currently lacks the requisiterequired; necessary for a particular purpose必需的；所需的 community facilities — schools, clinics and transport links — to support a sizeable public housing estate, and that building purely private flats would better align withto be consistent or in agreement with與……一致；配合 existing development in the neighbourhood. Nevertheless, lawmakers have pressed the bureau to explain why the original mixed-use blueprint, which had promised a share of subsidised flats, was not honoured.

By the same token, the government was keen to allayto reduce fear, worry or doubt減輕；緩解（憂慮） public anxiety over the city's overall housing supply. Officials stressed that the revised proposal would not jeopardiseto put something at risk of being harmed or destroyed危害；使陷入危險 the administration's ten-year target of delivering 420,000 flats, including 294,000 public units, by 2036, since sufficient land has reportedly already been securedobtained or guaranteed, especially through effort獲得；確保 elsewhere to meet that quota. Critics, however, contend that ad hocdone or arranged only when necessary, not planned in advance臨時的；特別安排的 adjustments like this one risk eroding confidence in the Northern Metropolis strategy as a whole, and have called for greater transparencyopenness and honesty in communicating decisions透明度；公開程度 in how such housing trade-offs are decided.

vocab.sample: The government's U-turn on the housing plan caught many district councillors off guard.
The site had long been earmarked for a mix of public and private housing.
Planners admitted the area lacked the requisite infrastructure to support a new estate.
Officials argued the revised plan would better align with the character of the surrounding district.
The minister attempted to allay public concern by publishing the revised housing targets.
Officials denied that the change would jeopardise the city's long-term housing supply target.
Critics warned that ad hoc adjustments to planning blueprints could erode public trust.
Lawmakers have called for greater public accountability over how such last-minute planning changes are approved.
The original blueprint had promised a share of subsidised housing on the site.
Sudden reversals can undermine public confidence in long-term planning.
Officials cited a shortage of community facilities as a reason for the revised plan.
The bureau reaffirmed that the housing supply target remains unchanged despite the revision.

phrases.en: quietly swap public flats for private ones at the eleventh hour
phrases.zh: 在最後關頭悄悄將公屋換成私樓
phrases.sample: The bureau quietly swapped public flats for private ones at the eleventh hour, drawing criticism.

phrases.en: frame a reversal as pragmatism rather than retreat
phrases.zh: 將政策逆轉包裝為務實而非退讓
phrases.sample: Officials framed the reversal as pragmatism rather than retreat from earlier promises.

phrases.en: cite a shortfall in supporting infrastructure
phrases.zh: 以配套設施不足為理由
phrases.sample: The bureau cited a shortfall in supporting infrastructure to justify dropping public housing.

phrases.en: shift the burden of proof onto lawmakers' scrutiny
phrases.zh: 將舉證責任轉移至議員的審視之上
phrases.sample: Officials have shifted the burden of proof onto lawmakers' scrutiny by refusing further detail.

phrases.en: renege on an earlier mixed-use promise
phrases.zh: 違背早前的混合用途承諾
phrases.sample: Critics accuse the bureau of reneging on an earlier mixed-use promise for the site.

phrases.en: offset a scrapped quota with land found elsewhere
phrases.zh: 以在他處覓得的土地抵銷取消的配額
phrases.sample: Officials say they can offset the scrapped quota with land found elsewhere in the New Territories.

phrases.en: chip away at confidence in a flagship strategy
phrases.zh: 逐步削弱公眾對旗艦策略的信心
phrases.sample: Repeated reversals risk chipping away at confidence in the Northern Metropolis strategy.

phrases.en: reduce a long-term blueprint to a moving target
phrases.zh: 令長遠規劃藍圖變成不斷變動的目標
phrases.sample: Lawmakers warn that ad hoc tweaks reduce the long-term blueprint to a moving target.

phrases.en: demand a fuller account of how trade-offs are struck
phrases.zh: 要求對取捨的決定過程作出更全面的說明
phrases.sample: Opposition lawmakers demand a fuller account of how such housing trade-offs are struck.

phrases.en: trade a social housing pledge for financing convenience
phrases.zh: 以融資上的方便取代原來的公屋承諾
phrases.sample: Critics say the bureau traded a social housing pledge for financing convenience.

phrases.en: leave residents guessing about the next revision
phrases.zh: 令居民對下一次修訂毫無頭緒
phrases.sample: Sudden policy swings leave residents guessing about the next revision to come.

phrases.en: insist the headline target remains intact
phrases.zh: 堅稱整體目標數字維持不變
phrases.sample: Officials insist the headline housing target remains intact despite the change at this site.

cover_text.en: Public flats dropped at Pak Shek Kok rail site

articles.summary_zh_html:
發展局確認就白石角新鐵路站計劃作出臨門大轉變後，再次受到社會審視——公屋悄悄被剔出該地段，改由私人樓宇取代。發展局常任秘書長何珮玲星期五向記者表示，該車站屬東鐵綫延線工程的一部分，預留最早於二零三三年通車，將改以允許項目發展商在周邊土地興建及出售私人住宅的方式融資。

普遍認為，此類政策逆轉會削弱公眾對長遠規劃的信心，但官員堅稱這項決定純屬務實考量，並非政治決定。何珮玲解釋，建議車站周邊地區目前缺乏必需的社區設施——學校、診所及交通連接——未能支援規模可觀的公共房屋項目，而純粹興建私人樓宇則更能與該區現有發展配合。然而，議員已追問發展局，為何未有兌現原來承諾提供部分資助房屋的混合用途規劃藍圖。

同樣道理，政府亦急於緩解公眾對全港房屋供應的憂慮。官員強調，經修訂的建議不會危害政府在二零三六年前提供四十二萬個單位（包括二十九萬四千個公共單位）的十年目標，因為據報已在其他地點確保足夠土地以達標。然而，評論者認為，像這次的臨時調整有可能削弱公眾對北部都會區整體策略的信心，並要求當局在決定此類房屋取捨時提高透明度。

articles.headline: Widen mental health support for Hong Kong youth beyond high-risk cases, adviser urges
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong needs to broadento make something wider in range or scope擴闊；擴大範圍 mental health support well beyond students already flagged as high-risk, a key government adviser has urged, warning that the city's current approach may be missing many young people in genuine distress. Dr Lam Ching-choi, a member of the Executive Council and chairman of the Advisory Committee on Mental Health, pointed out that some students who took their own lives had shown no obvious warning signsindications that something bad might happen警號；預警跡象 at home or in school.

It is widely argued that this pattern complicates prevention efforts considerably. According to Dr Lam, several of the affected teenagers came from stable, middle-class families, performed well academically, and were not known to have experienced bullying — meaning that schemes targetingaiming at or directed towards a particular group針對（某群體） only "high-risk" individuals may fail to reach them in time. He attributed part of the problem to social media, where young people can be exposed to harmful contentmaterial that causes damage, especially psychologically有害內容 and online bullying largely invisible to parents and teachers.

Nevertheless, there are signs of a wider policy shift. Dr Lam called for support measures to be extended to the general student populationall students as a whole, not just a specific subgroup全體學生 rather than narrowly targeted groups, and separately, a prominent local tycoon has pledged funding to empower more young philanthropists to tackle the issue. By the same token, mental health experts caution that any expanded scheme must be adequately resourced, or risk becoming merely symbolicrepresenting an idea rather than having real, practical effect象徵性的；流於表面的 rather than genuinely protective. Critics contend that without sustained investment in school counselling and community outreach, Hong Kong's youth mental health crisis will continue to worsen.

vocab.sample: Experts are calling on the government to broaden support beyond students labelled high-risk.
Teachers are trained to look out for warning signs of emotional distress among students.
Current schemes mainly focus on identifying high-risk individuals for early intervention.
Programmes that target only a narrow group may overlook students who appear outwardly fine.
Exposure to harmful content online has been linked to a decline in teenagers' mental wellbeing.
Online bullying can inflict lasting psychological harm that is often invisible to adults.
Advocates argue that mental health education should reach the general student population, not just at-risk cases.
A local philanthropist has pledged funding to support youth mental health initiatives.
Critics warn that underfunded schemes risk becoming little more than a symbolic gesture.
Dr Lam said multi-year funding, not one-off grants, is needed to reach young people before a crisis develops.
Early intervention can prevent minor emotional difficulties from escalating into crises.
Many students hide their emotional distress behind strong academic performance.

phrases.en: slip through the cracks of a risk-based model
phrases.zh: 在以風險為本的模式下被遺漏
phrases.sample: Seemingly well-adjusted students can slip through the cracks of a risk-based model.

phrases.en: defy the profile that screening tools are built to catch
phrases.zh: 不符合篩查工具用以識別的典型特徵
phrases.sample: Several affected teenagers defied the profile that screening tools are built to catch.

phrases.en: mask inner turmoil behind academic success
phrases.zh: 以學業成就掩飾內心的煎熬
phrases.sample: Some students mask inner turmoil behind academic success, escaping teachers' notice.

phrases.en: broaden the net without diluting urgent care
phrases.zh: 擴大網絡範圍同時不削弱緊急援助
phrases.sample: Any reform must broaden the net without diluting urgent care for existing high-risk cases.

phrases.en: leave a visible gap between policy and lived reality
phrases.zh: 在政策與實際情況之間留下明顯缺口
phrases.sample: Narrowly targeted schemes leave a visible gap between policy and the lived reality of students.

phrases.en: risk reducing reform to a well-funded gesture
phrases.zh: 有可能令改革淪為一項資源充足卻流於表面的舉動
phrases.sample: Without proper staffing, the expanded scheme risks reducing reform to a well-funded gesture.

phrases.en: channel private wealth into grassroots youth causes
phrases.zh: 將私人財富投放於基層青年事務
phrases.sample: The tycoon's pledge channels private wealth into grassroots youth mental health causes.

phrases.en: treat every student as a potential cause for concern
phrases.zh: 將每一位學生均視為值得關注的對象
phrases.sample: Universal support means treating every student as a potential cause for concern, not just outliers.

phrases.en: surface quietly, away from parents' and teachers' view
phrases.zh: 在家長及教師視線以外悄悄浮現
phrases.sample: Much of the harm surfaces quietly, away from parents' and teachers' view, on social media.

phrases.en: stretch counselling resources thinner across more cases
phrases.zh: 令輔導資源在更多個案之間變得更緊絀
phrases.sample: Widening the scheme without new funding would stretch counselling resources thinner across more cases.

phrases.en: demand year-round vigilance rather than crisis-point response
phrases.zh: 需要全年保持警覺而非僅在危機出現時應對
phrases.sample: Experts argue prevention demands year-round vigilance rather than crisis-point response.

phrases.en: turn philanthropic goodwill into durable infrastructure
phrases.zh: 將慈善善意轉化為持久的支援架構
phrases.sample: Advocates hope to turn philanthropic goodwill into durable infrastructure for youth mental health.

articles.summary_zh_html:
一名重要的政府顧問促請香港將精神健康支援擴闊至遠超現時被標籤為高風險的學生範圍，並警告現行做法可能令許多正承受真正困擾的年輕人被忽略。行政會議成員兼精神健康諮詢委員會主席林正財指出，部分選擇結束自己生命的學生，在家中或學校均未曾顯露明顯的警號。

普遍認為，這種模式令預防工作大大複雜化。據林正財所述，多名受影響的青少年來自穩定的中產家庭，學業成績良好，亦沒有曾遭欺凌的紀錄——意味著只針對「高風險」人士的計劃或未能及時觸及他們。他將部分問題歸因於社交媒體，年輕人在當中可能接觸到有害內容及家長與教師難以察覺的網絡欺凌。

然而，政策方向出現更廣泛轉變的跡象。林正財呼籲將支援措施擴展至全體學生，而非僅限於狹窄的目標群體；另外，一名著名本地大亨亦承諾提供資金，培育更多年輕慈善家參與應對這問題。同樣道理，精神健康專家警告，任何擴展計劃必須獲得充足資源支持，否則只會流於象徵性而非真正具保護作用。評論者認為，若缺乏對學校輔導及社區外展服務的持續投資，香港青少年精神健康危機將會持續惡化。

cover_text.en: Adviser urges wider mental health support for youth

articles.headline: Hong Kong graduates at a crossroads as AI takes over entry-level jobs, experts warn
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's fresh graduates are facing an increasingly uncertain labour marketthe overall system of supply and demand for workers勞動市場, as artificial intelligence steadily absorbs the routine tasks that once served as a stepping stonean action or event that helps achieve a bigger goal踏腳石；過渡階段 into full-time careers. According to labour market experts, the number of full-time vacancies suitable for university graduates has plummetedto fall suddenly and sharply急劍下跌 from roughly 80,000 in 2022 to just 31,000 last year, a decline widely attributed to the rapid adoption of AI tools in offices across the city.

It is widely argued that administrative support, clerical duties and other entry-levelrelating to a job requiring little or no prior experience初級；入門級的 roles — historically the easiest point of entry for young job-seekers — are being systematically replaced by automation. One expert warned starkly that "it is no longer the case that a young person willing to learn and work hard will definitely find a job," underscoring how traditional assumptions about meritocracythe belief that success is earned through ability and effort精英制度；論功行賞的制度 in the workplace are being tested. A member of the Labour Advisory Board further cautioned that employers' growing emphasis on immediate productivity has made many reluctant to invest in on-the-job trainingskills training given to employees while they work在職培訓 for inexperienced hires.

Nevertheless, not every voice is pessimistic. By the same token that automation threatens certain roles, it is also reshaping demand towards new skill sets: a global survey found that employers increasingly prize critical thinking, data analysis and ethical decision-makingmaking choices guided by moral principles合乎道德的決策 over routine competence. Critics contend, however, that without targeted retraining schemes and government support, a persistent shortagea continuing lack of something over a long period持續的短缺 of experienced local talent could emerge, even as entry-level opportunities continue to disappear.

vocab.sample: The graduate job market has tightened sharply amid rising automation.
Clerical jobs used to be an entry point into a career for many young graduates.
Graduate vacancies have plummeted as companies automate routine tasks.
Fewer junior positions are being advertised this year as firms experiment with AI-assisted workflows.
Some experts argue that AI is quietly undermining the idea of workplace meritocracy.
Employers are increasingly reluctant to provide on-the-job training for new graduates.
Employers now rank ethical decision-making among the most valuable workplace skills.
A persistent shortage of experienced local talent could emerge within a decade.
Graduates increasingly worry about task displacement eroding the very entry rungs they once relied on.
Upskilling programmes are seen as essential to help graduates stay competitive.
Employers' focus on immediate productivity has made them wary of hiring inexperienced staff.
AI is disrupting the traditional career ladder that graduates once relied on.

phrases.en: narrow the on-ramp into full-time careers
phrases.zh: 收窄通往全職事業的入口
phrases.sample: Automation has narrowed the on-ramp into full-time careers for fresh graduates.

phrases.en: hollow out the entry rungs of the career ladder
phrases.zh: 削空職業階梯最底層的職位
phrases.sample: AI is hollowing out the entry rungs of the career ladder once filled by graduates.

phrases.en: unsettle long-held assumptions about hard work paying off
phrases.zh: 動搖長久以來努力終有回報的假設
phrases.sample: The trend unsettles long-held assumptions about hard work paying off for young jobseekers.

phrases.en: shift the burden of training onto job seekers themselves
phrases.zh: 將培訓的負擔轉移至求職者本身
phrases.sample: Reluctant employers effectively shift the burden of training onto job seekers themselves.

phrases.en: reward analytical judgement over routine competence
phrases.zh: 重視分析判斷力多於常規能力
phrases.sample: Employers increasingly reward analytical judgement over routine competence in new hires.

phrases.en: leave a widening void between graduates and experienced hires
phrases.zh: 在畢業生與資深人手之間留下日益擴大的斷層
phrases.sample: A hiring freeze on entry roles leaves a widening void between graduates and experienced hires.

phrases.en: demand proof of skills that university alone cannot certify
phrases.zh: 要求證明大學教育本身無法認證的技能
phrases.sample: Employers now demand proof of skills that university alone cannot certify.

phrases.en: push graduates to manufacture their own stepping stones
phrases.zh: 迫使畢業生自行創造踏入職場的途徑
phrases.sample: With fewer formal entry roles, graduates are pushed to manufacture their own stepping stones.

phrases.en: redraw the boundary between replaceable and irreplaceable work
phrases.zh: 重新劃分可被取代與不可被取代的工作界線
phrases.sample: AI adoption is redrawing the boundary between replaceable and irreplaceable work.

phrases.en: store up a talent gap for the years ahead
phrases.zh: 為未來數年累積人才缺口
phrases.sample: Cutting entry-level roles today may store up a talent gap for the years ahead.

phrases.en: force a rethink of what a first job is for
phrases.zh: 迫使社會重新思考首份工作的意義
phrases.sample: The shrinking vacancy count forces a rethink of what a first job is actually for.

phrases.en: offer little comfort to this year's graduating cohort
phrases.zh: 對今年的畢業生而言帶來的安慰甚少
phrases.sample: Optimistic long-term forecasts offer little comfort to this year's graduating cohort.

articles.summary_zh_html:
香港的新畢業生正面對日益不明朗的勞動市場，因為人工智能正逐步取代昔日曾作為踏入全職事業踏腳石的常規工作。據勞動市場專家指出，適合大學畢業生的全職職位空缺數目，已由二零二二年約八萬個，急劇下跌至去年僅三萬一千個，這一跌幅普遍被歸因於全城各辦公室迅速採用人工智能工具。

普遍認為，行政支援、文書工作及其他入門級職位——向來是年輕求職者最容易踏入職場的途徑——正被自動化系統性取代。一名專家直言警告：「年輕人願意學習及努力工作，已不再必然能夠找到工作」，凸顯職場上有關精英制度的傳統假設正受到考驗。勞工顧問委員會一名成員進一步警告，僱主日益重視即時生產力，令許多機構不願意為缺乏經驗的新人投資在職培訓。

然而，並非所有聲音都偏向悲觀。正如自動化威脅著某些職位，它同時亦正在將需求轉向新的技能組合：一項全球調查發現，僱主日益重視批判思考、數據分析及合乎道德的決策，多於單純的常規能力。評論者則認為，若缺乏針對性的再培訓計劃及政府支援，即使入門機會持續消失，亦可能出現經驗豐富的本地人才持續短缺的情況。

articles.headline: Hang Lung CEO Weber Lo steps down on October 1, hands over to successor
articles.summary_html:
Hang Lung Group, one of Hong Kong's most prominent property developers, has confirmed a significant leadership transitiona change from one state or stage to another過渡；轉變 at the top of the company. Weber Lo officially stepped down as Chief Executive Officer and executive director on 1 October, handing the role to Leo Tsoi Tak-lun, a veteran of more than three decades in retail and business management across Asia, who had joined the firm the previous month as CEO-designate to ensure a smooth handoverthe act of transferring control or responsibility交接；交班.

It is widely argued that such carefully staged successions reflect a broader trend among Hong Kong's family-controlled conglomerates, which have faced mounting pressure to future-proofto make something able to withstand future developments or needs為未來做好準備；具前瞻性 their leadership structures amid a challenging property market. Lo, who had led the group through a lengthy period of retail headwindsdifficult conditions that hinder progress in the retail sector零售業的不利因素 and shifting consumer habits, will remain with the company for a further year as Advisor to the Chair, lending continuity even as day-to-day decisions pass to his successor.

Nevertheless, analysts caution that leadership change alone will not resolve the structural challenges facing Hong Kong's real estate sector, including elevated interest rates and subdued mainland tourist spending. By the same token, some investors view Tsoi's extensive retail background as a potentially favourableadvantageous or beneficial有利的 sign, given the group's heavy reliance on shopping mall revenue. Critics contend that genuine recovery will depend less on who occupies the corner office than on whether the broader economy can regain momentumto start moving forward successfully again重新獲得動力；復甦.

vocab.sample: The company announced a carefully planned leadership transition for next year.
A smooth handover between the outgoing and incoming CEOs reassured investors.
The CEO-designate spent a month shadowing the outgoing chief executive before taking over.
The reshuffle reflects a broader generational leadership shift among family conglomerates.
The group navigated years of retail headwinds caused by changing shopping habits.
The outgoing CEO will stay on as advisor to the chair for continuity.
Analysts say leadership change cannot fix the sector's structural challenges alone.
Elevated interest rates have weighed heavily on the property market.
Subdued mainland tourist spending has hurt shopping mall revenues.
Investors viewed the appointment as a favourable sign for the group's retail strategy.
The broader economy will need to regain momentum before the sector fully recovers.
Hang Lung is one of Hong Kong's most prominent property developers.

phrases.en: hand the reins to an outsider with a retail pedigree
phrases.zh: 將大權交予擁有零售背景的外來接班人
phrases.sample: The group handed the reins to an outsider with a retail pedigree rather than an internal candidate.

phrases.en: signal continuity rather than a clean break
phrases.zh: 顯示延續性而非徹底的斷層
phrases.sample: Keeping the former CEO as an advisor signals continuity rather than a clean break.

phrases.en: stage a succession well before the market notices strain
phrases.zh: 在市場察覺壓力前已部署接班安排
phrases.sample: Family firms increasingly stage a succession well before the market notices strain.

phrases.en: lean on a new face to reset investor sentiment
phrases.zh: 借助新面孔重振投資者情緒
phrases.sample: The conglomerate is leaning on a new chief executive to reset investor sentiment.

phrases.en: weather a prolonged downturn in mall footfall
phrases.zh: 捱過商場人流長期低迷的困境
phrases.sample: The outgoing CEO weathered a prolonged downturn in mall footfall and tourist spending.

phrases.en: pin recovery hopes on more than a single appointment
phrases.zh: 將復甦希望寄託於不止一項人事任命
phrases.sample: Analysts say the group cannot pin recovery hopes on more than a single appointment.

phrases.en: insulate the business from a single leader's departure
phrases.zh: 令業務不過度受單一領導人離任的影響
phrases.sample: A staged handover helps insulate the business from the shock of a single leader's departure.

phrases.en: carry institutional memory into a new leadership era
phrases.zh: 將企業的經驗傳承帶入新的領導時代
phrases.sample: Staying on as advisor lets the outgoing CEO carry institutional memory into the new era.

phrases.en: brace for a sector still searching for a floor
phrases.zh: 為一個仍在尋底的行業做好準備
phrases.sample: The new chief executive must brace for a sector still searching for a floor.

phrases.en: reassure a market wary of abrupt change
phrases.zh: 安撫對突變感到不安的市場
phrases.sample: The gradual handover was designed to reassure a market wary of abrupt change.

phrases.en: bet on retail know-how to revive mall income
phrases.zh: 寄望零售經驗能重振商場收入
phrases.sample: Investors are betting on Tsoi's retail know-how to revive the group's mall income.

articles.summary_zh_html:
恒隆集團作為香港最具代表性的地產發展商之一，確認公司最高層出現重大的領導層過渡。羅義德於十月一日正式卸任行政總裁及執行董事一職，將大任交予蔡德銓——一位在亞洲零售及商業管理領域擁有逾三十年經驗的資深人士，他於上月已以候任行政總裁身份加入公司，確保交接工作順利進行。

普遍認為，這種精心安排的接班程序反映香港家族企業的廣泛趨勢——它們在充滿挑戰的地產市場下，正面臨日益增加的壓力，須為其領導架構未來做好準備。羅義德曾帶領集團走過一段長時間的零售業不利因素及消費習慣轉變的時期，他將再留任公司一年，擔任主席顧問，即使日常決策已交由其接任者負責，亦能提供延續性。

然而，分析師警告，單靠領導層更替無法解決香港地產業面對的結構性挑戰，包括偏高的利率及疲弱的內地旅客消費。同樣道理，部分投資者認為蔡德銓豐富的零售背景可能是一個有利的訊號，因為集團高度依賴商場租金收入。評論者則認為，真正的復甦與誰坐在高層辦公室的關係不大，反而取決於整體經濟能否重新獲得動力。

articles.headline: Hong Kong Windsurfers Claim Historic Double Gold at Asian Games
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's windsurfing squad delivered a watershed momenta turning point of great significance轉捩點；分水嶺 for the city's sporting history on Saturday, as teenage sailors Wong Tsz-ho and Cheung Tsz-yuet each claimed gold in the youth iQFoil events at the 20th Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. Their twin triumphstwo closely linked victories achieved together雙喜臨門；兩項同時勝利 propelled Hong Kong's gold tally into double figures for the first time since the territory began competing in the Games in 1954 — a milestone achieved barely an hour after tennis player Coleman Wong Chak-lam secured a record-equallingmatching a previous best achievement打平紀錄的 eighth gold in the men's singles.

Wong Tsz-ho put in a commanding displaya performance that dominates the competition壓倒性的表現 across eleven grueling rounds of racing, crossing the finish line first on six occasions to seal the boys' title. In the girls' event, 17-year-old Cheung Tsz-yuet proved equally dominant, winning nine of her races to clinchto secure something after a close contest終於奪得；鎖定 a podium finish many had anticipated after her encouraging showing at this year's world championships in Spain. Their victories meant Hong Kong had already surpassed its previous best gold haul of eight, a mark the delegation had reached three times before, in 2010, 2018 and 2023.

With the total medal count edging towards the all-time record of 53 set in Hangzhou three years ago, officials were quick to credit the breakthrough to sustained investment in grassroots pathwayssystems that identify and develop talent from a young age基層培訓途徑, insisting that identifying promising youngsters early and nurturing them through structured training has finally begun to translate into tangible resultsoutcomes that are concrete and measurable實質成果 on the international stage. Observers have nonetheless cautioned that converting isolated triumphs into a lasting sporting legacy will require continued funding long after the closing ceremony, so that the achievements of this golden generation do not prove to be a fleeting high pointa peak of success that quickly passes曇花一現；短暫的高峰.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港滑浪風帆代表隊在星期六為本港體壇歷史寫下重要一章，兩名少年風帆手王子浩及張芷月分別在日本愛知·名古屋第二十屆亞運會的青年iQFoil項目中奪得金牌。二人雙喜臨門的佳績，令香港自一九五四年參加亞運會以來，金牌數目首次踏入雙位數——而就在不足一小時前，網球手黃澤林剛剛在男子單打項目中奪得追平歷史紀錄的第八面金牌。

王子浩在十一輪艱苦的賽事中表現強勢，六次率先衝線，鎖定男子組冠軍寶座。女子組方面，十七歲的張芷月同樣技壓全場，贏得九場賽事，摘下不少人在她今年於西班牙世界錦標賽交出亮眼成績後已預料的獎牌席位。二人的勝利意味香港已超越過去八面金牌的最佳紀錄——該紀錄曾在二零一零年、二零一八年及二零二三年三度打平。

隨著獎牌總數漸漸逼近三年前杭州亞運會創下的五十三面歷史紀錄，官員紛紛將這次突破歸功於對基層培訓途徑的持續投放，強調及早發掘有潛質的年輕選手並透過系統化訓練加以培育，終於開始在國際賽場上轉化為實質成果。然而，有觀察者提醒，要將個別的勝利轉化為持久的體育遺產，閉幕禮過後仍須持續投放資源，否則這一代黃金選手的成就恐怕只會是曇花一現。

articles.source_url: https://www.hk01.com/社會新聞/60395835/外傭最低工資2026-外傭簽約-10-3起上調至-5220-膳食津貼不變
articles.headline: Hong Kong Raises Minimum Wage for Foreign Domestic Helpers to HK$5,220
articles.summary_html:
The Hong Kong government announced on Friday that the minimum allowable wagethe lowest salary an employer is legally permitted to pay法定最低工資 for foreign domestic helpers will rise by 2.35 per cent, from HK$5,100 to HK$5,220 a month, with the new rate applying to all contracts signed on or after October 3. The food allowance that employers must provide will remain unchanged at no less than HK$1,236 a month. The adjustment, the latest in an annual reviewa yearly process of checking and updating something一年一度的檢討 that has become something of a ritual for the city's roughly 380,000 households employing live-in helpers, arrives as the cost of domestic help continues to climb alongside broader living expenses.

Officials said the revised figure took into account Hong Kong's overall economic performance, prevailing labour market conditions, employers' ability to pay, and the basic livelihood needsthe essential requirements for a person to live decently基本生活需要 of helpers themselves. The government stressed that contracts signed before the cut-off at the old rate would still be processed, provided applications reach the Immigration Department within a grace periodextra time allowed before a rule takes full effect寬限期. Unlike previous years, when adjustments were sometimes frozen amid economic headwinds, this year's rise, though modest, signals a continuation of incremental increasessmall, gradual rises over time逐步的小幅加幅 rather than a pause.

The announcement has nonetheless reignited a familiar tug-of-wara struggle between two sides pulling in opposite directions拉鋸戰 between stakeholders. Helper unions, which had lobbied for a far steeper rise to as much as HK$6,670 citing persistent inflation, dismissed the increase as inadequate, while employer associations warned that even incremental rises strain household budgetsthe amount of money a family has to spend家庭開支預算 already squeezed by a sluggish economy. For the tens of thousands of dual-income familieshouseholds where both partners earn a salary雙職家庭 and elderly households that depend on helpers for childcare and caregiving, the episode is a reminder of how deeply this workforce is woven into the fabric of domestic lifedeeply and inseparably part of everyday home life深深融入家庭生活之中 in the city.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港政府星期五宣布，外籍家庭傭工的法定最低工資將由每月五千一百元上調百分之二點三五至五千二百二十元，新工資水平適用於十月三日或之後簽訂的所有合約。僱主須提供的膳食津貼則維持不變，每月不少於一千二百三十六元。這次調整是一年一度檢討機制下的最新安排，對本港約三十八萬個聘用住家外傭的家庭而言已幾近成為慣例，而外傭成本亦隨著整體生活開支上升而持續攀升。

官員表示，新工資水平已考慮香港整體經濟表現、現行勞工市場狀況、僱主的負擔能力，以及外傭本身的基本生活需要。政府強調，於截止日期前以舊工資水平簽訂的合約仍會獲處理，惟申請須在寬限期內送達入境處。與過往部分年度因經濟逆風而工資凍結不同，今年的升幅雖然輕微，卻顯示工資持續小幅上調，而非再次停滯不前。

不過，今次公布亦重新燃起各方之間一場熟悉的角力。外傭工會一直以持續通脹為理由，爭取大幅加薪至每月六千六百七十元，故斥今次升幅並不足夠；僱主組織則警告，即使是輕微的加幅，亦會令本已因經濟疲弱而捉襟見肘的家庭開支百上加斤。對於數以萬計依靠外傭照顧子女及長者的雙職家庭和長者住戶而言，這次爭議提醒了大眾，這批勞動力早已深深融入本港家庭生活的日常肌理之中。

articles.headline: Prosecution Opens Case in Abby Choi Murder Trial, Alleging Premeditated Plan
articles.summary_html:
Prosecutors opened their case on Thursday in the long-awaited murder trial over the killing of Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung, alleging that her former husband and his relatives had meticulously plannedprepared something with extreme care and attention to detail精心策劃 the crime well before her remains were discovered. Alex Kwong Kong-chi, his father Kwong Kau and his brother Anthony Kwong Kong-kit stand jointly charged with murder and with preventing the lawful burial of a body, more than three and a half years after Choi's dismembered remainsa body that has been cut into separate pieces被肢解的遺體 were found at a rented village house in Tai Po.

According to the prosecution, the trio rented the ground-floor property in the weeks before Choi's death and embarked on a series of purchases that betrayed their intentrevealed a hidden plan or motive暴露了他們的意圖: among the items acquired was an industrial meat grinder, and the court heard that Kwong Kau had also enquired about a bone grinder while making the purchase. Taken together with other equipment later recovered at the scene, prosecutors argued the shopping spree pointed unmistakably to a premeditated plana plan made and thought through in advance預謀計劃 to dismember and dispose of a body, rather than a crime committed in the heat of the momenta sudden burst of emotion without forethought一時衝動.

The trial, expected to run for 45 days, had already been delayed once after a juror was discharged on health grounds, forcing a replacement to be empanelledformally selected to serve on a jury獲遴選加入陪審團. Legal commentators note that the case has drawn intense public scrutinyclose and critical attention from the public公眾的高度關注 partly because it exposes how a bitter family dispute over property and finances could escalate into calculated brutalitygrow step by step into deliberate, extreme violence演變成有計算的殘暴行為, raising uncomfortable questions about domestic conflict, inheritance disputes and the adequacy of safeguards for individuals caught in deteriorating family relationships long before matters turn violent.
articles.summary_zh_html:
檢方星期四在萬眾期待的香港名媛蔡天鳳遇害案審訊中開案陳詞，指其前夫及其家人早於遺體被發現之前，已經精心策劃這場謀殺案。鄺港智、其父鄺球及其兄鄺港傑三人被控謀殺罪及阻止遺體合法埋葬罪，距離蔡天鳳被肢解的遺體在大埔一間租用的村屋內被發現，已逾三年半。

根據控方陳述，三人在蔡天鳳死前數星期租用該地下村屋，並連日購物，而這些購物行為正正暴露了他們的意圖：當中購買的物品包括一台工業用碎肉機，而法庭亦聽到鄺球在購買碎肉機時，亦曾問及碎骨機。結合現場後來起出的其他器具，控方指這連日的購物行為明確顯示，這是一場有預謀的肢解及棄屍計劃，而非一時衝動所犯下的罪行。

審訊預計將持續四十五天，早前已因一名陪審員以健康理由獲准退任，需要重新遴選替補陪審員而一度延後。法律評論員指出，此案備受公眾高度關注，部分原因在於案件揭示一場因財產及金錢而起的激烈家庭糾紛，竟可演變成有計算的殘暴行為，亦引起社會對家庭衝突、遺產糾紛，以及在關係惡化至演變成暴力之前，社會能否及時為相關人士提供足夠保障等問題的不安思考。

articles.headline: Nursing Job Market Row Deepens as Lo Chung-mau Urges Facts Over Rhetoric
articles.summary_html:
A seemingly routine radio phone-in call to the Chief Executive has snowballed into a public rowgrown quickly from something small into a major dispute演變成一場公眾爭議 over Hong Kong's nursing job market, after a caller identified only as Mr Kwok questioned whether an influx of non-locally trained nurses was crowding out fresh graduatestaking up opportunities that would otherwise go to new graduates擠走新鮮人畢業生 from the profession. The remark prompted Executive Council member Tommy Cheung Yu-yan to suggest the caller had been coached by a unionsecretly guided or instructed by a labour organisation受工會操控 pushing its own agenda, an accusation Kwok firmly rejected, insisting he held no grudge against mainland medical staff and describing himself as a committed supporter of the establishment.

Stepping into the fray, Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau urged all sides to anchor the debate in verified figuresbase an argument firmly on confirmed, factual data以核實數據作討論基礎 rather than hearsay, warning that unsubstantiated claimsstatements made without solid supporting evidence未經證實的言論 about the job market only deter prospective recruits and ultimately leave Hong Kong to bear the consequences of a worsening shortfall. Officials have repeatedly pointed to rising numbers of full-time nurses and a falling attrition ratethe rate at which staff leave a job or profession流失率 as evidence that recruitment reforms, including pathways for non-locally trained staff, are easing pressure rather than displacing local talent.

The episode lays bare a delicate balancing acta situation requiring careful management of competing needs微妙的平衡任務 facing the city: plugging an acute shortage of healthcare workers through imported talent while reassuring a new generation of local nursing graduates that their career prospects have not been sacrificed in the process. With training places having expanded sharply in recent years, how authorities reconcile these competing pressures is likely to shape not only the morale of the nursing workforce but also public confidence in the government's broader manpower planningthe strategic organisation of a workforce to meet future needs人力規劃.
articles.summary_zh_html:
一個看似平常的電台烽煙節目來電，演變成一場有關本港護士就業市場的公眾爭議。一名僅以「郭先生」身分受訪的來電者質疑，大量非本地培訓護士湧入會否擠走本地應屆畢業生的就業機會。行政會議成員張宇人聞言後暗示，該名來電者是受某工會操控以推動其自身議程，郭先生則堅決否認此說法，強調自己對內地醫護人員並無怨懟，並形容自己是堅定支持建制的愛國人士。

醫務衛生局局長盧寵茂亦加入爭論，呼籲各方應以核實數據作討論基礎，而非道聽途說，並警告有關就業市場的不實言論只會嚇怕有意入行的新血，最終令香港要自行承受人手短缺惡化的後果。官員多次強調，全職護士人數上升、流失率回落，正正證明包括容許非本地培訓人員執業等招聘改革，是在緩解人手壓力，而非擠走本地人才。

這場爭議揭示本港正面對一項微妙的平衡任務：既要透過輸入人才填補醫療人手的嚴重短缺，同時亦要讓新一代本地護士畢業生安心，確保他們的事業前景沒有因此犧牲。隨著近年培訓學額大幅增加，當局如何在這些互相競逐的壓力之間取得平衡，不但將影響護理行業的士氣，亦勢將左右公眾對政府整體人力規劃的信心。

articles.headline: Hong Kong's Autumn Art Auctions Top HK$2 Billion as Kusama Works Cool
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's three leading auction houses — Christie's, Sotheby's and Phillips — concluded their autumn sales from 28 to 30 September with a combined totalthe sum of several amounts added together總額 exceeding HK$2 billion, a notable rebound from the HK$1.3 billion recorded last spring. Christie's led the field with HK$956.5 million, up 17 per cent year on year, a result the house attributed to a 30 per cent influx of first-time buyersa sudden arrival of a large number of new participants新買家湧入 drawn to blue-chip names. The sale's top lot, Jean-Michel Basquiat's Ancient Scientist (1984), fetched HK$77 million, underscoring sustained demand for museum-grade worksartworks of a quality considered worthy of display in major museums具博物館級水準的作品.

Sotheby's matched its rival almost lot for lot, posting HK$956 million — a 35 per cent jump on its March series — with a 91 per cent sell-through ratethe proportion of lots offered that actually find a buyer成交比率 and five new artist records. Yoshitomo Nara's Present (1994) topped the house's combined sales at HK$71.1 million. Phillips, the smallest of the three, rounded out the season with HK$94.5 million and an even higher 96 per cent sell-through rate by value, suggesting buyers were highly selectivechoosing very carefully rather than buying indiscriminately非常挑剔 rather than universally bullish.

Not every lot fared so well. Yayoi Kusama's A-Pumpkin (YHP) (2011), estimated at HK$48 million to HK$68 million, met a muted responsea reaction that is noticeably weaker or quieter than expected反應冷淡 in what was the first major test of the artist's posthumous market since her death last month. Dealers said the result hints at buyer fatiguea loss of enthusiasm among buyers after repeated exposure to similar works買家興趣減退 towards an artist whose pumpkin motifs have flooded the market for years. Analysts nonetheless described the season as a sign that Hong Kong's art market, having weathered two subdued years, is regaining its footingbecoming stable and successful again after a period of difficulty重新站穩腳步 as a regional hub, even as collectors grow more discerning about what commands a premium.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港三大拍賣行——佳士得、蘇富比和富藝斯——於9月28日至30日完成秋季拍賣，總額超過20億港元，較去年春季拍賣錄得的13億港元明顯回升。佳士得以9.565億港元奪得頭籌，按年上升17%，拍行將此歸因於新買家湧入三成，吸引他們的是藍籌級名家作品。本季焦點拍品——尚·米榭·巴斯基亞（Jean-Michel Basquiat）1984年作品《Ancient Scientist》——以7700萬港元成交，印證市場對具博物館級水準的作品的持續需求。

蘇富比幾乎與對手勢均力敵，總成交額達9.56億港元，較今年三月拍賣上升35%，成交比率達91%，並刷新五位藝術家的拍賣紀錄。奈良美智（Yoshitomo Nara）1994年作品《Present》以7110萬港元成為該行組合拍賣的最高價拍品。三家拍行中規模最小的富藝斯則以9450萬港元為本季作結，按金額計的成交比率更高達96%，反映買家在落槌前非常挑剔，而非一味追捧。

並非所有拍品都表現亮眼。草間彌生（Yayoi Kusama）2011年作品《A-Pumpkin (YHP)》估價4800萬至6800萬港元，卻遇上反應冷淡的場面——這是她上月逝世後，其身後市場首次接受的重大考驗。有交易商指，結果反映買家對這位南瓜圖案已充斥市場多年的藝術家出現買家興趣減退的跡象。分析人士認為，經歷兩年低迷後，本季拍賣顯示香港藝術市場正重新站穩腳步，重拾區內樞紐地位，但同時藏家對何者值得溢價變得更為審慎。

articles.headline: 'Money Is Money': US and UK Firms Still Flocking to Hong Kong, Commerce Chief Says
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's commerce chief has brushed asidedismissed something as unimportant without much consideration不以為意 concerns that geopolitical tension is driving foreign capital away from the city, insisting that American and British firms are still setting up shop in growing numbers. Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau Ying-wah acknowledged that 2026 had been a testing yeara difficult period that puts someone's resolve or ability under pressure充滿考驗的一年 on the geopolitical front, but said the figures told a different story.

According to InvestHK, the government's investment promotion arma government body dedicated to attracting investment into a place投資推廣機構, 516 overseas and mainland Chinese companies set up or expanded operations in Hong Kong during the first eight months of the year. Mainland China accounted for the largest share at 307, followed by Singapore with 29, the US with 27 and Britain with 21. "Money is money. Businesspeople are very practical," Yau said, adding that firms are reassured once they see for themselves that the city remains stable and unencumberedfree from burdens or restrictions that would otherwise hold something back穩定且不受束縛.

Yau pointed to a decade-long trade surplus between Hong Kong and the United States as evidence that American companies have tangible commercial incentivesreal, concrete reasons related to profit or business advantage, as opposed to abstract ones實際的商業動機 to stay invested regardless of diplomatic friction. Critics, however, note that headline figures can mask underlying cautionhide a more careful or hesitant attitude that isn't obvious from the numbers alone掩蓋潛藏的審慎態度, since a rising company count does not necessarily reflect the scale or permanence of the investment involved. Still, with Hong Kong due to host the Apec Finance Ministers' Meeting later this month, officials are hoping to parlay the occasionuse an opportunity or event to achieve a further advantage藉此機會爭取更大優勢 into fresh pledges of investment from Western economies.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港商務及經濟發展局局長對有關地緣政治緊張局勢正令外資流走的憂慮不以為意，強調美資和英資企業仍陸續在港設業。局長丘應樺承認，就地緣政治而言，2026年是充滿考驗的一年，但他指數字說明了另一個故事。

據政府投資推廣機構「投資推廣署」統計，今年首八個月共有516間海外及內地企業在港開設或擴展業務，當中內地以307間佔最大份額，其次是新加坡29間、美國27間及英國21間。丘應樺說：「錢就是錢，商人是很實際的。」他續稱，企業一旦親身察覺本港仍然穩定且不受束縛，自然會安心前來投資。

丘應樺指出，港美之間長達十年的貿易順差，正是美資企業不論外交摩擦仍有實際的商業動機留港投資的證據。然而，有評論指相關數字或會掩蓋潛藏的審慎態度，因為企業數目上升未必反映投資的規模或持久性。即使如此，隨著香港將於本月稍後主辦亞太經合組織（APEC）財長會議，官員仍希望藉此機會爭取更大優勢，為西方經濟體爭取新一輪投資承諾。

articles.headline: Coleman Wong Clinches Hong Kong's First Asian Games Tennis Gold, Books Ticket to LA 2028
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's Coleman Wong delivered the city's first-ever Asian Games tennis gold medal on Saturday, defeating China's Wu Yibing 6-2, 6-4 in a lopsided finala contest in which one side wins by a clearly unequal margin一面倒的決賽 at the Aichi-Nagoya Games. The 22-year-old, who trains under the guidance of his mentor Rafael Nadal, needed just over an hour to seal the men's singles title, firing 16 aces while committing only a single double fault.

Wong did not face a single break point throughout the match, a serving masterclassan outstanding, almost flawless display of a particular skill發球示範式演出 that left his higher-ranked opponent with few answers. The victory also secures Hong Kong an automatic quota for the men's singles tennis event at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, a prize that until recently seemed firmly out of reach for a city with no traditionno established history or custom of success in a particular area毫無傳統 of producing world-class tennis players.

Local tennis officials hailed the win as a watershed momenta turning point after which things change significantly轉捩點 for a sport that has long lived in the shadow of swimming and cycling in Hong Kong's medal tables. Coaches now face the challenge of capitalising on the momenttaking full advantage of a favourable situation while it lasts把握時機 to recruit juniors to a sport that remains expensive and court space-starved in the city. Whether Wong's triumph can translate into a lasting boostlead to a benefit that continues over a long period, not just a short burst轉化為持久的推動力 for grassroots participation, rather than a brief surge of interest that fades once the headlines move on, will depend on whether funding and facilities follow the applause.

articles.headline: No Silver Bullet for Hong Kong's Falling Birth Rate, Editorial Warns
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong recorded just 29,700 births in the year to mid-2026, a 15.6 per cent year-on-year plungea sudden and severe fall or decrease急挫 that marks the lowest tally since records began in 1962. In the first eight months of this year alone, only 19,255 babies were born, a 10 per cent drop on the same period last year, intensifying pressure on a government that has staked considerable political capital on reversing the trend.

Officials have responded by extending a baby bonus scheme for three more years, continuing to award HK$20,000 for a first child while raising the payout for a second or subsequent child to HK$30,000. Yet with more than 40 per cent of the original scheme's funds left unclaimednot taken up or collected, despite being available未被領取, commentators question whether cash alone can shift deep-seated attitudeschange beliefs or habits that are firmly established and hard to alter改變根深蒂固的觀念 towards parenthood. A survey by the Federation of Youth Groups found only 36.5 per cent of respondents aged 13 to 29 were even interested in having children, with 30.6 per cent ruling it out altogethercompletely, with no exception完全.

An editorial response argues the government is right to treat handouts as only one strand of a wider strategy, since the real deterrentsthings that discourage someone from doing something阻嚇因素 to having children in Hong Kong lie elsewhere: cramped housing, long working hours and a shortage of affordable childcare. Unless these structural barriersdeep, systemic obstacles built into how a society or economy works, not just surface problems結構性障礙 are addressed in tandem with financial incentives, the city risks pouring billions into a scheme that treats the symptom while leaving the underlying cause untouchednot dealing with the root problem that actually produces an effect未觸及根本原因.

官方改為將新生嬰兒獎勵金計劃延長三年，繼續向首生子女發放2萬元，第二胎或以後子女則提高至3萬元。但原有計劃中超過四成款額未被領取，評論者質疑僅靠金錢是否能真正改變根深蒂固的觀念。香港青年協會一項調查發現，13至29歲受訪者中，僅36.5%表示有興趣生育，而30.6%則完全排除這個可能性。

一篇評論文章指出，政府正確地將獎金視為整體策略的其中一環，因為真正令香港人生育的阻嚇因素其實在其他地方：狹居、工時長和可負擔託兒服務不足。若不將這些結構性障礙與金錢激勵同步解決，本港即使投入巨資推行計劃，亦只會治標而未觸及根本原因。

articles.headline: MAMAMOO's Cantonese-Powered Comeback Packs Kai Tak Arena
articles.summary_html:
Four years after their last Hong Kong concert, the South Korean girl group MAMAMOO returned to a sold-outwith every ticket purchased門票售罄的 Kai Tak Sports Park Arena on 4 October as part of their 2026 World Tour <4WARD>. The four members — Solar, Moonbyul, Wheein and Hwasa — ended a three-year hiatusa pause or break in activity暫停演出 from performing in the city, delivering a two-hour set that blended their signature harmonies with solo showcases.

What distinguished the night was the group’s deliberate effort to build rapporta close, harmonious relationship默契 with their local fan base. Between songs, the members practised Cantonese phrases, including the internet slang term “laugh to death” (笑死), prompting delighted cheers from an audience eager to see international stars pay homagespecial honour or respect shown publicly致敗 to local culture. Local singers Kayee Tsang and Serrini were spotted in the crowd, with both later sharing photographs on social media, lending the concert an added layer of celebrity endorsement that further amplified its online buzz.

The concert also underscored Kai Tak’s rapid emergence as a live-music huba central venue hosting many concerts現場音樂樞紐 for the region, drawing international acts that once bypassed the city in favour of larger markets. Commentators noted that the continued dominance of Korean pop acts on Hong Kong stages has reignited debate over whether homegrown Cantopop can recapture similar commercial cloutthe power to influence sales or spending商業影響力 among younger audiences. For students, the episode offers a case study in cultural soft power: a touring act’s willingness to localise its performance, even through a single slang phrase, can generate disproportionate goodwill and media coverage, illustrating how cultural exchangemutual sharing of customs between groups文化交流 increasingly functions as a marketing strategy in the global entertainment industry.

當暇最令人印象深刻的，是組合刻意興本地樂辷建立默契的用心。成員在歌曲之間練習廣東話詞句，包括網絡潮語「笑死」，逋得全場樂辷歡呼不已，為能見證國際巨星向本地文化致敗而感到雀躍。歌手鄭欣宜及Serrini亦現身觀眾席，二人事後均在社交媒體分享合照，為演唱會添上明星加持的話題性，進一步帶動網上熱議。

articles.headline: Independent Journalist Released on Bail After Sedition Arrest
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong police arrested Tang Ho-wing, founder of the independent outlet Boom News, on 30 September on suspicion of acting with "seditiousintended to incite rebellion against authority漜動性的 intention", making him the first journalist publicly known to be detainedheld in custody by authorities被拘留 under this charge since the city’s homegrown national security law took effect in 2024. The arrest was linked to Boom News’ coverage of a small gathering on 31 August, where participants held yellow umbrellas to commemoratehonour the memory of an event紀念 the seventh anniversary of a 2019 police operation at Prince Edward MTR station.

Tang was released on bail on 2 October after roughly 48 hours in custody, though he must report back to police at a later date while inquiriesofficial investigations調查 continue. The Hong Kong Journalists Association, a press union, warned that if reporters can be arrested merely for being present at newsworthy events, "all frontline reporters will inevitably bear the same risks" when covering public gatherings in future, raising concerns about the chilling effectdiscouragement of lawful activity through fear寒蝉效應 on independent reporting.

Press freedom advocates argue the case illustrates a widening gap between official assurances that journalism remains protected and the practical experience of reporters covering sensitive anniversariesdates marking a significant past event each year周年紀念日. Authorities maintain that the arrest concerned conduct rather than reporting itself, insisting that genuine news-gathering remains lawful. For students of current affairs, the episode offers a timely example of how legal definitions of seditionspeech or action inciting rebellion漜動罪 can be contested, and how such ambiguity may encourage self-censorshiprestraining oneself from expression without being told to自我審查 among journalists wary of crossing an unclear line.
articles.summary_zh_html:

鄒皖文於10月2日，即被拘留約48小時後，獲允保釋候查，但須在稍後日子向警方到報，而相關調查仍在進行。香港記者協會（一個新聞工作者團體）警告，若記者僅因在場採訪具新聞價值的事件便可被捕，「所有前線記者日後報道公眠活動時，難免同樣面对風險」，令人關注事件會对獨立報道造成寒蝉效應。

新聞自由倡議者認為，事件反映官方一再保證新聞工作受到保障，與記者在報道敏感周年紀念場合時的實际處境之間，存在日益擴大的落差。當局則堅稱，被捕原因在於相關行為而非採訪本身，強調真正的新聞採集活動仍然合法。对於修讀時事科目的學生而言，此案正好說明法律上对「漜動罪」的定義可以存在爭議，而這種含模之處，或會令擔心黜越模糊界線的記者傾向自我審查。
